guides.facebook:
1. Yiya kwiakhawunti yakho ye-Meta Business / Developers.
2. Yenza i-Page Access Token enemvume ye-pages_manage_posts.
3. Kopa i-Page ID yakho (kwi-About/Settings yePhepha) kunye netokheni ngezantsi.
guides.x:
1. Yiya kwi-developer.x.com uvule i-app yakho.
2. Yenza itokheni yokufikelela yomsebenzisi ye-OAuth 2.0 enomda we-tweet.write.
3. Ncamathisela itokheni ngezantsi.
guides.linkedin:
1. Yiya kwi-linkedin.com/developers uvule i-app yakho.
2. Fumana itokheni yokufikelela enomda we-w_member_social.
3. Ncamathisela i-URN yombhali wakho (urn:li:person:XXXX) kunye netokheni ngezantsi.
guides.instagram:
1. I-Instagram yakho kufuneka ibe yiakhawunti yeBhizinisi enxulunyaniswe ne-Facebook Page.
2. Fumana itokheni enemvume ye-instagram_content_publish.
3. Ncamathisela i-ID yomsebenzisi we-Instagram kunye netokheni ngezantsi.
guides.whatsapp:
1. Seta i-WhatsApp Cloud API kwi-Meta.
2. Kopa itokheni yakho yokufikelela esisigxina.
3. Ncamathisela inombolo yomamkeli (enekhowudi yelizwe) kunye netokheni ngezantsi.

ext_hint.whatsapp: Inombolo yefowuni yomamkeli enekhowudi yelizwe, umzekelo 27821234567

report_sources.projects: Kwiiprojekthi ngokwazo — Iiprojekthi, uze uvule enye.
report_sources.work: Kwiphepha loMsebenzi lweprojekthi nganye, apho kwakhiwa isakhiwo nemisebenzi yaso.
report_sources.dependencies: Kwi-Umsebenzi → Nxulumanisa imisebenzi, apho umsebenzi omnye wenziwa ulinde omnye.
report_sources.schedule: Ibalwa ngumcwangcisi ngokusekelwe kubude bemisebenzi nokunxulumana kwayo. Yiqhube kwiphepha leShedyuli leprojekthi.
report_sources.baseline: Ithelekisa namhlanje nomgca osisiseko ogciniweyo. Gcina omnye kwiphepha leShedyuli leprojekthi.
report_sources.recurrence: Kumgaqo wokuphindaphinda ngaphakathi komsebenzi, kwiphepha loMsebenzi.
report_sources.evidence: Kwirejista yobungqina — usetyenziso lwasentsimini, abathumeli bemodyuli ne-API yokungenisa.
report_sources.figures: Isuselwa kubungqina. Jonga iphepha lamanani leprojekthi ukuze ufumane imigaqo engemva kwenani ngalinye.
report_sources.timesheets: Kwi-Unikezelo → Ixesha kwiprojekthi. Yongeza abantu kuqala kwithebhu yaBantu — iiyure zibhaliswa ngelungu.
report_sources.assignments: Kwi-Umsebenzi, ngokunika ilungu umsebenzi, ngepesenti yokwabiwa. Yongeza abantu kuqala kwi-Unikezelo → Abantu.
report_sources.labour: Iiyure ezivunyiweyo × umlinganiselo. Beka umlinganiselo xa ubhalisa iiyure kwi-Unikezelo → Ixesha; kubalwa iiyure ezivunyiweyo kuphela.
report_sources.costs: Kwi-Unikezelo → Iindleko kwiprojekthi, apho kurekhodwa izinto, izixhobo nabaqhathi abaphantsi. Kubalwa kuphela okuvunyiweyo nokuhlawulweyo.
report_sources.approvals: Zenziwa ngokuzenzekelayo xa iiyure okanye iindleko zithunyelwe. Ukuba ngubani ogqibayo kusetwa kwi-Useto → Indlela yokuvuma.
report_sources.links: Kwiphepha leprojekthi, ngokudibanisa irekhodi kwenye imodyuli — isixhobo, i-oda lokuthenga, ikontrakthi.
report_sources.registers: Kubhalwe kuluhlu lweprojekthi lwemingcipheko, iingxaki notshintsho

registers.root_cause_required: Esi sisiganeko okanye ingxaki ebalulekileyo, ngoko unobangela wokwenyani kufuneka ubhalwe phambi kokuvalwa.
registers.impact_note: Chaza into ekwenzayo ebungakananini, kwiindleko, kwixesha nakumgangatho. Yishiye ingenanto indawo ukuba awazi ngokwenene — u-0 ongawuthethiyo unciphisa utshintsho kanye ngexesha umntu elivumayo.
registers.realise_note: Umngcipheko uhlala kuluhlu njengowenzekileyo, kwaye ingxaki entsha ikhomba emva kuwo — olo nxulumano bubungqina bokuba wayekho owawubonayo usiza.
registers.confirm_submit_body: {code} iya kuye nabani na ovuma utshintsho kule projekthi. Awuyi kukwazi ukuyihlela ngelixa isekubo.
registers.confirm_implement_body: {code} iyasetyenziswa kwaye kuthatyathwa isiseko, ukuze ifuthe layo kwishedyuli lihlale linokulinganiswa emva koko.
registers.needs_root_cause: Isiganeko okanye ingxaki ebalulekileyo kufuneka ibhale unobangela wayo wokwenyani.
registers.no_flow_auto: Akukho mkhondo wokuvuma owenzelwe izicelo zotshintsho kule ndawo yokusebenza, ngoko lubhalwe njengoluvunyiweyo.

portfolio.title: Iphothifoliyo
portfolio.subtitle: Iinkqubo neeprojekthi, noko bakuchithayo.
portfolio.portfolio_hint: Iqela leenkqubo neeprojekthi ezikhuphisana ngemali efanayo.
portfolio.programme_hint: Iqela leeprojekthi ezizisa isiphumo esinye kunye.
portfolio.empty_body: Inkqubo liqela leeprojekthi ezizisa isiphumo esinye — isibhedlele: isakhiwo, i-IT nabasebenzi. Iphothifoliyo liqela leenkqubo neeprojekthi ezikhuphisana ngemali efanayo. Zombini azinyanzelekanga: ukuba usebenza imisebenzi engenanxulumano, awuyidingi nanye.
portfolio.unassigned_sub: Ziboniswa ukuze isixa esingasentla singaziphosi ngokuthe cwaka.
portfolio.budget_hint: Okunokuchithwa yile phothifoliyo. Ngaphandle kwako akukho nto yokuthelekisa nayo.
portfolio.outcome_hint: Isivakalisi esinye. Inkqubo engenasiphumo sinye yiphothifoliyo phantsi kwelinye igama.
portfolio.assign_note: Iprojekthi ekwinkqubo ithatha iphothifoliyo yaloo nkqubo ngokuzenzekelayo — iimpendulo ezimbini kwi-“yeyiphi iphothifoliyo” yindlela isixa esiyeka ngayo ukuhlangana.

templates.title: Iitemplethi zeprojekthi
templates.subtitle: Apho iprojekthi entsha inokuqala khona, ukuze iinxalenye abantu abazilibalayo zibe sele zikho.
templates.capture_sub: Guqula umsebenzi ohambe kakuhle ube yindawo yokuqala yolandelayo.
templates.capture_note: Imihla igcinwa njengezithuba ukusuka ekuqaleni kweprojekthi, hayi njengemihla yekhalenda — itemplethi enemihla yokwenene ichanekile ngemini ebhalwa ngayo kwaye iphosakele zonke iintsuku ezilandelayo.
templates.none_hint: Thatha iprojekthi ehambe kakuhle, ize elandelayo iqale kuyo.
templates.sub_type_hint: Izindlu, iindlela, i-ERP, iphulo — nokuba abantu bakubiza njani.
templates.confirm_remove_body: {name} ayisayi kuphinda inikezelwe. Iiprojekthi ezidalwe kuyo azichukunyiswa.
templates.confirm_hide_body: {name} yitemplethi ethunyelweyo, ngoko ifihlwa endaweni yokususwa — ukususa kungabuya kuhlaziyo olulandelayo.
templates.start_from_sub: Le projekthi ayikabi nasicwangciso, ngoko esinye sinokubekwa phezu kwayo.

gates.title: Amasango amanqanaba
gates.subtitle: Okumele kube yinyaniso phambi kokuba le projekthi iqhubele phambili.
gates.criteria_hint: Kubhalwe phambi kwesigqibo, hayi emva kwaso.
gates.waiver_needs_reason: Isango eliyekelelweyo kumele lichaze ukuba kutheni. Ukutsiba elinye ngaphandle kwesizathu yingxelo esuswa kancinci-kancinci.
gates.none_hint: Ngaphandle kwelinye, inqanaba lilebhile umntu ayitshintshayo.

site_records.title: Iingxelo zesiza
site_records.subtitle: Imiyalelo, uvavanyo, uhlolo nokugqitywa — amaphepha ibango elithethelelwa ngawo.
site_records.instructions_sub: Oko waxelelwa ukuba wenze, nini, kwaye ngubani
site_records.completion_sub: Ngokwenzeka, ngamacandelo nangokugqibela — izatifikethi ezikhulula imali ebanjiweyo
site_records.unconverted_title: Imiyalelo engu-{count} ebangwe njengotshintsho kodwa engazange yenziwe ibe lutshintsho
site_records.unconverted_body: Kulapho imali ilahleka khona ekugqibeleni kwe-akhawunti. Yenzeni ibe lutshintsho, okanye nisuse ibango.
site_records.no_instructions_hint: “Nisixelele” yingxoxo kuphela xa kukho isalathiso nomhla.
site_records.no_inspections_hint: Ukuphoswa lolunye kuguqula umsebenzi ogqityiweyo ube ngumsebenzi omele uphinde uvulwe.
site_records.no_completion_hint: Ukugqitywa ngokwenzeka kuqalisa ixesha leentsilelo kwaye ngesiqhelo kukhulula isiqingatha semali ebanjiweyo.
site_records.issued_by_hint: Injineli okanye ummeli womthengi — ngesiqhelo asingomntu one-akhawunti apha.
site_records.variation_hint: Bhala uluvo lwakho ngoku, hayi kwiinyanga ezizayo xa i-akhawunti iphikiswa.
site_records.instruction_sub: Kufayilwe phambi kokuba nabani na avume ukuba lutshintsho na — koko okuyinjongo yako.
site_records.element_hint: “Islabhu somgangatho ophantsi, indawo 3” — okwaneleyo ukuyifumana kwakhona.
site_records.fail_raises_ncr: Uvavanyo olusilelayo luvula ukungahambelani nemigaqo ngokuzenzekelayo. Ukugalelwa oluvela kuko sekugqunyiwe, ngoko oku akushiywa kwinkumbulo yomntu.
site_records.requested_for_hint: Uhlolo olufunwa namhlanje emva kwemini asilosaziso.
site_records.outstanding_hint: Uluhlu olunamathiselwe kwisatifikethi. Ukugqitywa ngokwenzeka kukhutshwa umsebenzi usaseleyo — oko kuqhelekile.
site_records.certify_sub: Oku kukhulula imali ebanjiweyo kwaye kuqalisa iwotshi yeentsilelo.
site_records.certify_note: Ukugqitywa ngokwenzeka kwaliwa ngelixa kukho intsilelo ebalulekileyo okanye ukungahambelani nemigaqo okuvulekileyo kuluhlu — ukuqinisekisa phezu kwako kulahla ithuba lokukulungisa.
site_records.completion_blocked: Zikho iintsilelo ezibalulekileyo okanye ukungahambelani nemigaqo okuvulekileyo okungu-{count}. Ukugqitywa ngokwenzeka akunakuqinisekiswa phezu kwako.

meetings.title: Iintlanganiso
meetings.subtitle: I-ajenda, imizuzu, ukuba ngubani obekhona, noko kufuneka kwenziwe ngako.
meetings.project_hint: Izenzo zinokuba yimisebenzi kwiprojekthi kuphela, ngoko intlanganiso engenayo igcina izenzo zayo kwimizuzu.
meetings.minutes_outstanding_title: Iintlanganiso ezingu-{count} ezibanjiweyo ngaphandle kokusasazwa kwemizuzu
meetings.minutes_outstanding_body: Kulapho izigqibo zinyamalala khona ngokuthe cwaka.
meetings.agenda_hint: Ithunyelwa phambi kwentlanganiso; iba sisakhelo semizuzu.
meetings.minutes_note: Ubukho bubhalwa nemizuzu ngenjongo: “kwavunyelwana kwintlanganiso yesiza” yingxoxo kuphela ukuba ingxelo ithi ngubani owayekhona ukuvuma.
meetings.actions_note: Izenzo ziba yimisebenzi kwiprojekthi — isenzo esiphila kwimizuzu kuphela sisenzo esingasetyenzwa mntu.
meetings.confirm_remove_body: “{title}” nemizuzu yayo iyasuswa. Izenzo esele zidalwe zihlala njengemisebenzi.

agile.title: Ii-sprint noluhlu olulindileyo
agile.subtitle: Amabali yimisebenzi eqhelekileyo, ngoko ibhodi, ishedyuli namaphepha exesha asasebenza onke.
agile.backlog_sub: Izinto ezingacwangciswanga zihlala ezantsi — into engabekwanga phambili mntu asiyoyona ibalulekileyo.
agile.epics_sub: Umsebenzi odlula ii-sprint. Inkqubela ngamabali ayo, hayi uqikelelo olwahlukileyo olunokungavumelani nawo.
agile.no_active_hint: Cwangcisa enye, faka amabali kuyo, uze uyiqalise.
agile.no_goal: Akukho njongo ibekiweyo — i-sprint engenayo yibhokisi lexesha nje.
agile.goal_hint: Isivakalisi esinye. Ukuba awukwazi ukusibhala, i-sprint ayinanjongo.
agile.revision_hint: Ngaphandle kwayo, “kwakukho ntoni kule nguqulelo” luqikelelo kwiinyanga ezintandathu ezizayo.
agile.close_note: Amabali angagqitywanga abuyela kuluhlu olulindileyo, hayi phambili kwi-sprint elandelayo — ukuwadlulisela ngokuzenzekelayo yindlela i-sprint elandelayo eqala ngayo izele phambi kokuba nabani na ayicwangcise.
agile.one_at_a_time: Enye i-sprint sele iqhubeka kule projekthi. Ezimbini kanye-kanye zenza isantya negrafu yokutsha kungacaci.

portal.title: Iiprojekthi zakho
portal.subtitle: Okwenzekayo kwimisebenzi yakho, noko kufuna wena.
portal.empty_body: Le portal ibonisa iiprojekthi odityaniswe kuzo njengomthengi okanye njengekhontraka. Ukuba usebenza apha, iiprojekthi zakho zingaphantsi kwe-Iiprojekthi.
portal.progress_note: Eli lelona nani libonwa liqela elihambisayo — alibalwa ngokwahlukileyo kuwe.
portal.time_sub: Kudlula kumvumo ofanayo nowephepha lexesha lomnye wonke.
portal.documents_sub: Yonke into kulo msebenzi onokuyibona, nendawo yokusithumelela into
portal.rate_sub: Isilinganiso esinye ngenyanga — siya ngqo kwiqela elihambisayo.
portal.rate_dialog_sub: Ukunyaniseka kuluncedo kunobubele. Akukho mntu ulinganiswa ngoku ngamnye.
portal.my_invoices_sub: Lungiselela ityala lomsebenzi wakho uze ulithumele kumphathi weprojekthi.
portal.cinvoice_empty: Yongeza ubuncinane umqolo omnye, okanye ncamathisela ityala lakho, phambi kokulithumela.
portal.cinvoice_sent: Eli tyala sele lithunyelwe kwaye alinakutshintshwa.
portal.my_contracts_sub: Oko usebenza phantsi kwako kulo msebenzi.
portal.raise_request_sub: Iya ngqo kubantu abaqhuba le projekthi.

assistant.title: Umncedisi
assistant.subtitle: Oko idatha ithi kufuna ingqalelo yakho, noncedo ngokubhala.
assistant.all_clear_hint: Yonke iprojekthi esebenzayo iyanika ingxelo, ingaphakathi kwezalathisi zayo, kwaye ayinazo izigqibo ezibambekileyo.
assistant.draft_sub: Amanani athatyathwa kwiprojekthi; imodeli ibhala amagama ajikelezileyo kuphela.
assistant.draft_warning: Uyilo. Lufunde phambi kokuba ulithumele — amanani ayinyaniso, izivakalisi azikabi ngezakho.
assistant.no_provider: Akukho mboneleli we-AI omiselweyo kule ndawo yokusebenza, ngoko ukubhala akufumaneki. Konke okungasentla kubalwa kusuka kwidatha yakho kwaye akufuni omnye.
assistant.slipping_detail: {name} izuze u-{spi} wexabiso ebicwangcise ukulizuza ngoku.
assistant.overloaded_detail: Iiyure ezingu-{hours} ezicwangcisiweyo kwinyanga yeeyure ezingu-{capacity}, kwiiprojekthi ezingu-{projects}.
assistant.silent_title: Iiprojekthi ezisebenzayo ezingu-{count} azinikanga ngxelo iiveki ezimbini
assistant.silent_detail: Iprojekthi enganiki ngxelo asiyoprojekthi ehamba kakuhle — yileyo akukho mntu unokuthetha nto ngayo.
assistant.risk_title: Imingcipheko ephezulu engu-{count} engenako ukunciphisa okubhaliweyo
assistant.risk_detail: Ineenqaku ezingama-15 okanye ngaphezulu, kwaye akukho nto ibhaliweyo ngoko kwenziwayo.
assistant.change_title: Izicelo zotshintsho ezingu-{count} ezilinde ngaphezu kweveki
assistant.change_detail: Zingenisiwe kodwa zingekagqitywa. Isicwangciso nesigqibo ziyahlukana.

alerts.deadline_title: Imisebenzi engu-{count} ephela kwiintsuku ezingu-{days} ezizayo
alerts.overdue_title: Imisebenzi engu-{count} esele igqithe umhla wayo
alerts.overdue_detail: Isavulekile, kwaye imihla ekwisicwangciso ayisathethi nto.

equipment.title: Uhlolo lwezixhobo
equipment.sub: Uhlolo phambi kokusetyenziswa — ixabiso lulandelelwano olungaphazamisekanga, hayi olunye lwazo
equipment.identifier_hint: Yiskene okanye uyichwetheze. Ikhowudi engahambelaniyo nanto isefayilini isafanelekile ukubhalwa.
equipment.signed_hint: Igama lakho, ixesha nedilesi yakho kuyabhalwa — kufana nokutyikitya uxwebhu.

contractors.title: Ii-invoyisi zabakhontraki
contractors.subtitle: Oko abakhontraki bakuthumeleyo ngomsebenzi kwiiprojekthi zakho.
contractors.markup_hint: Akunyanzelekanga, kwaye ayiboniswa umthengi okanye umkhontraki. Yishiye ingenanto ukuba ayikho.
contractors.reject_sub: Umkhontraki uboniswa isizathu sakho, ngoko bhala into anokuthatha amanyathelo ngayo.
contractors.no_email: Lo mkhontraki akanadilesi ye-imeyile, ngoko ikontrakthi ayinakuthunyelwa.
contractors.not_submitted: Yi-invoyisi engenisiweyo kuphela enokuvunywa okanye yaliwe.
contractors.register_sub: Wonke umntu owenza naye ikontrakthi, nako konke ngaye.
contractors.add_sub: Igama labo nendlela yokubafumana. Banike iprojekthi baze bafumane ufikelelo kwiportal ukuze bakubhatalise.
contractors.from_suppliers: Ezi ziirekhodi zakho zabathengisi. Ukongeza omnye apha kumfaka naku-Supplier Management.
contractors.field_email_hint: Apho isimemo sabo seportal siya khona.
contractors.field_project_hint: Akunyanzelekanga. Bamenywa kwiportal xa sele bekumsebenzi.
contractors.on_projects: iiprojekthi ezingu-{count} | iprojekthi enye | iiprojekthi ezingu-{count}
contractors.our_signatory_hint: Baxelelwa kwi-app, kwaye ikontrakthi ilinde isiginitsha yabo apha.

contracts.title: Iikontrakthi
contracts.subtitle: Iikontrakthi zeprojekthi — zibhalwa, zilungiswa, zihlolwa kwaye zisayinwa apha.
contracts.draft_sub: Qala kwenye yeetemplethi zakho, okanye ungaqali nto.
contracts.template_hint: Iitemplethi zakho zeprojekthi. Yishiye ingenanto ukuze uzibhalele imiqathango.
contracts.title_hint: Yishiye ingenanto ukuze ithiywe ngokomkhontraki neprojekthi.
contracts.no_body_hint: Yilungise ukuze ubhale imiqathango, okanye ubhale elandelayo ngetemplethi.
contracts.amend_sub: Susa imiqathango engasebenziyo, okanye utshintshe amaxabiso. Oku kubhala inguqulelo entsha.
contracts.amend_withdraws: Le kontrakthi iphumele ukusayinwa. Ukuyilungisa kurhoxisa iisiginitsha esele zicelwe, kwaye amaqela aza kucelwa ukuba asayine inguqulelo entsha.
contracts.change_note_hint: Kubhalwe kule nguqulelo — “kususwe umqathango 7, akukho zixhobo kweli candelo”.
contracts.submit_explainer: Oku kuya kuye nabani na inkampani yakho emmiselayo ukuvuma iikontrakthi. Ukuba akukho manyathelo okuvuma amiselweyo, iphawulwa njengevunyiweyo kwaye ilungele ukusayinwa.
contracts.signature_stale: Isayinwe kwinguqulelo yangaphambili. Amagama atshintshile ukususela ngoko.
contracts.type_your_name_hint: Ukuchwetheza igama lakho apha yisiginitsha yakho.
contracts.decline_reason_hint: Elinye iqela liyakubona oku, kwaye kufuneka likwazi ukuthatha amanyathelo.
contracts.send_explainer: {contractor} usayina kuqala, emva koko umntu omkhethayo ngezantsi asayine naye.
contracts.not_submittable: Luyilo okanye ikontrakthi ealiweyo kuphela enokungeniswa ukuze ihlolwe.
contracts.not_sendable: Ikontrakthi evunyiweyo okanye eluyilo kuphela enokuthunyelwa ukuze isayinwe.
contracts.no_counterparty: Le kontrakthi ayinaye umkhontraki, ngoko ayinakuthunyelwa.
contracts.already_decided: Le siginitsha sele inikiwe okanye yaliwe.
contracts.no_signatory_email: Umsayini okhethiweyo akanadilesi ye-imeyile, ngoko ikontrakthi ayinakuthunyelwa.
contracts.mail_signature_line: Utyunjwe ukuba usayine ikontrakthi {number} no-{contractor} kwi-{project}.
contracts.member_hint: Ukuba ikontrakthi ingubani. Kuyafuneka phambi kokuba ithunyelwe ukuze isayinwe.
contracts.no_contractors_on_project: Abakho abakhontraki kule projekthi — yongeza omnye kuqala kwiskrini sabakhontraki abancinci.
contracts.name_alongside_drawing: Your name in text as well, so the record stays legible.
contracts.reopen_reason_hint: Every party who signed is told this.
contracts.reopen_warning: This contract is signed. Reopening tells everybody who signed, returns it to draft, and it must be signed again.
contracts.not_reopenable: Only a signed contract can be reopened.
contracts.reopen_reason_required: Say why the contract is being reopened.
contracts.not_yours_to_amend: This contract is not yours to change.
contracts.bad_signature_image: That signature could not be read.
contracts.signature_too_large: That signature image is too large.
contracts.mail_reopened_line: Contract {number} on {project} has been reopened for amendment.
contracts.mail_reopened_resign: The wording will change, so it will come back to you to sign again.
contracts.inapp_reopened: Contract {number} has been reopened for amendment.
contracts.need_drawing: Draw your signature above, or switch to Type.
contracts.no_document: Akukho xwebhu lenziweyo kule khontrakthi okwangoku.
contracts.bad_signed_pdf: Elo xwebhu elityikitywe alikwazanga kufundwa njenge-PDF.
contracts.amendment_would_drop_tables: Olu tshintsho luya kucima iitafile ezingama-{n} kwikhontrakthi — umhleli akanakuzigcina. Hlela amagama kwenye indawo, okanye ucele ukuba itafile itshintshwe kwitemplate.
contracts.sign_steps: Khetha okanye zoba utyikityo, cofa apho lufanele ukuba lube kwiphepha, uze utyikitye.
contracts.need_a_signature: Khetha utyikityo olugcinweyo, okanye zoba olunye.
contracts.place_it_on_the_page: Cofa kwiphepha apho utyikityo lwakho lufanele ukuba lube.
contracts.signing_failed: Ikhontrakthi ayikwazanga kutyikitywa. Nceda zama kwakhona.
contracts.counterparty_has_no_login: Lo mqhubi akanakho ukungena okwangoku, ngoko ebengenakuze atyikitye. Mmemele kwiphotali kuqala.
contracts.signatory_cannot_sign: Eli qela alinakho ukungena, ngoko alinakutyikitya. Limemele kwiphotali, uze uthumele ikhontrakthi kwakhona.

contract_templates.title: Iitemplethi zeekontrakthi
contract_templates.subtitle: Amagama le nkampani ithi yenze ngawo iikontrakthi ezincinci. Agcinwa apha, kwi-Project Management.
contract_templates.form_sub: Bhala imiqathango eqhelekileyo kanye, uze uyilungise ngokomkhontraki ngamnye xa ubhala.
contract_templates.none_hint: Bhala enye, okanye ufakele iseti yokuqala nge-pm:contract-templates:install.
contract_templates.import_is_a_copy: Ukungenisa kuthatha ikopi. Ukuyihlela apha akuze kutshintshe eyantlandlolo, kwaye ihlala ingeyakho ukuba i-Contract Management isusiwe.

steps.title: Iikholam zebhodi
steps.subtitle: Nika amagama amanyathelo umsebenzi wenu odlula kuwo ngokwenene. Inyathelo ngalinye linentsingiselo efundwa yiyo yonke imodyuli — inkqubela, ukugqitywa namabango konke kulandela intsingiselo, kungekhona igama.
steps.needs_done: Inyathelo elinye kufuneka libalwe njengeGqityiwe, kungenjalo akukho nto kule bhodi inokugqitywa.
steps.will_move: Imisebenzi engu-{count} ikwinyathelo olisusileyo. Iza kuya kwikholam yokuqala.
steps.too_many: Ibhodi ilinganiselwe kwiikholam ezingu-{max}; ngaphezulu koko akukho bani unokuyifunda.
steps.bad_category: U-“{label}” kufuneka abalwe njengenye yeemeko ezakhelwe ngaphakathi.

reminders.mail_subject: Imisebenzi yakho: {due} ifuneka namhlanje, {overdue} sele idlulile

billing.no_accounting: I-Accounting ayifakwanga, ngoko akukho nto inokubhatalwa kwiledija.
billing.no_party: Akukho mthengi wezibalo ohambelana no-"{client}" — yenza omnye, okanye udibanise iikopi.

data_sources.title: Imithombo yedatha
data_sources.subtitle: Imithombo le nkampani eqinisekisa ngayo ababoneleli, oko umthombo ngamnye unokukuphendula, nokuhlolwa okungekho mntu unokukuphendula okwangoku.
data_sources.ledger_broken: Umxokelelwane wobungqina awuhambelani kungeniso {at} ({reason}). Phatha ubungqina obuchaphazelekayo njengobungaqinisekiswanga de kuphandwe.
data_sources.coverage_help: Lonke uhlolo le modyuli iyaziyo ukulwenza, nokuba ngubani olwenzayo namhlanje. Uhlolo olungenamthombo alutsitywa — lurekhodwa njengolungafumanekiyo de kubekho umntu olwenzayo arekhode oko akufumeneyo.
data_sources.manual_notice: Uhlolo olungu-{count} alunamthombo ucwangcisiweyo, ngoko umntu kufuneka alwenze arekhode oko akufumeneyo.
data_sources.enable_help: Ngelixa oku kuvaliwe, uhlolo ebeluza kuluphendula lurekhodwa njengolungafumanekiyo endaweni yokuba lupasise.
data_sources.credentials_help: Zifihliwe apho zigcinwe khona kwaye azize zibuyiselwe kwesi sikrini. Yongeza isitshixo ukuze usitshintshe; izitshixo ongazichweteziyo ziyagcinwa.
data_sources.default_for_help: Xa imithombo engaphezu komnye inokuphendula uhlolo, lo ubuzwa kuqala.
data_sources.monthly_quota_help: Imithombo ehlawulelwayo ibiza imali ngomnxeba ngamnye. Xa isabelo sesiphelile, uhlolo lurekhodwa njengolungafumanekiyo endaweni yokukuhlawulisa.
data_sources.endpoints_help: Idilesi enikwa yiakhawunti yakho egunyazisiweyo kuhlolo ngalunye. Iindawo zokugcwalisa zigcwaliswa kusuka kumboneleli.
data_sources.endpoint_hint: Iindawo zokugcwalisa: registration_number, company_name, vat_number, tax_reference_number, account_number, reference
data_sources.manual_provider_note: Ihlala ifumaneka. Umntu wenza uhlolo emthonjeni arekhode oko akufumeneyo — kungena kwilog yokujonga efanayo, nangeningeniso lobungqina elifanayo, kubhalwe egameni lakhe.
data_sources.profiled: Uhlolo olungu-{count} selusazi apho lufowuna khona. Faka iinkcukacha zakho zokungena luze lusebenze — iintsimi ezingezantsi zezekhontrakthi eyahlukileyo kuphela.

verifications.title: Uphando olunzulu
verifications.outstanding: Uhlolo olungu-{count} lusafuna ingqwalasela phambi kokuba lo mboneleli athathwe njengoqinisekisiweyo.
verifications.record_help: Kuhlolo oluzenzeleyo emthonjeni. Lugcinwa nomkhondo wobungqina ofanayo nolwenziwe ngumatshini, lubhalwe egameni lakho — ukuze kungabikho mntu oluthatha njengempendulo eqinisekiswe ngumatshini kamva.
verifications.observed_help: Chwetheza oko umthombo okubonise ngokwenene. Kuthelekiswa noko umboneleli asixelele kona, ibala ngebala, ukuze umahluko ufunyanwe endaweni yokwamkelwa ngokuthemba.
verifications.pin_held: I-PIN ibanjelwe lo mboneleli, ngoko imeko yabo yokuthobela irhafu inokuqinisekiswa.
verifications.pin_missing: Akukabikho PIN. I-PIN ye-TCS yomboneleli yimvume yabo yokuba uqinisekise imeko yabo yokuthobela irhafu.
verifications.pin_help: Igcinwe ifihliwe, isetyenziselwa kuphela ukuqinisekisa imeko yokuthobela irhafu. Uqinisekiso lurekhoda oko i-SARS ekuthethileyo ngexesha ekubuzwe ngalo — kungoko oku kungekokulayisha isatifikethi.

errors.no_source: Akukho mthombo ucwangciselwe u-{check}, ngoko alunakwenziwa ngokuzenzekelayo. Rekhoda uhlolo ngokwakho, okanye ucwangcise umthombo phantsi kwe-Cwangcisa → Imithombo yedatha.

ownership.title: Ubunini
ownership.no_ubos: Akukho mntu wemvelo ufunyenweyo okwangoku. Ude umxokelelwane ufike ebantwini, akukho mntu unokuhlolwa — inkampani ayinakohlwaywa kwaye ayinakuba yi-PEP.
ownership.diagram_alt: Umzobo wobunini. Ulwazi olufanayo lukwitheyibhile engezantsi kwawo.
ownership.table_caption: Onke amasabelo obunini arekhodiweyo. Le theyibhile ngumfanekiso opheleleyo — umzobo ongentla ubonisa ubudlelwane obufanayo.
ownership.as_at_help: Umhla apho esi sabelo sasiyinyaniso ngawo. Irekhodi lobunini elingenamhla lilibango elingaphathelele kwixesha elithile.
ownership.unallocated: {entity}: u-{missing}% wezabelo azichazwanga. Ukho ozibambileyo ongakhankanywanga.
ownership.unstated_stakes: {entity}: amasabelo angu-{n} arekhodwe ngaphandle kobungakanani, ngoko izabelo azinakucaciswa.
ownership.over_allocated: {entity}: amasabelo axeliweyo afika ku-{declared}%, engaphezu kwenkampani iyonke.
ownership.related_help: Ababoneleli abanomntu okanye inkampani ebambileyo efanayo nalo. Ngokufuthi akunatyala — kwaye kwakhona yindlela iqela elinye elifaka ngayo ithenda phantsi kwamagama amathathu.
ownership.owns_what_help: Umboneleli ngokwakhe, okanye inkampani ephakamileyo kumxokelelwane.
ownership.compare_help: Faka abanini abaxhamlayo kanye ngendlela irejista ibadwelisa ngayo. Bathelekiswa nabantu umxokelelwane walo mboneleli ofika kubo — umsantsa phakathi kwezi ludwe zimbini luluphawu olufunyenweyo.

risk.title: Uvavanyo lomngcipheko
risk.never_assessed: Lo mboneleli akakavavanywa. De kwenziwe oko, akukho nto ithi apha ukuba kukhuselekile na ukuthengiselana nabo.
risk.trend_alt: Ukutyibilika kwamanqaku omngcipheko kuvavanyo olungu-{n} lokugqibela.
risk.gates_pass: Onke amasango okuvuma ayaphumelela. Lo mboneleli unokuvunywa ngaphandle kophononongo olongezelelweyo.
risk.tier_unset: Alikamiselwa — ubudlelwane bubo obugqiba ukuba kufuneka uphando olungakanani.
risk.tier_help: Phendula ngobu budlelwane, hayi ngenkampani ngokubanzi. Umboneleli ofanayo unokuba linqanaba 1 kwizinto zokubhala aze abe linqanaba 4 kudibaniso lwemivuzo.
risk.record_hit_help: Kukungqinelana okufumene kuludwe olupapashiweyo. Kubalwa ngokuchasene nomboneleli kwaye kubekwa esweni kanye njengoko okulandwe ngumatshini.
risk.subject: Kuhloliwe
risk.reason_help: Kuyafuneka xa ususa ukungqinelana. Kunyaka ozayo, ukukhatywa okungachazwanga akunakwahlulwa kunokucofa ngempazamo.

reputation.title: Udumo nokubekwa esweni kwezonxibelelwano
reputation.no_source_notice: Akukho mthombo weendaba okanye wezonxibelelwano ucwangcisiweyo, ngoko akukho nto inokukhangelwa ngokuzenzekelayo. Umboneleli obengenakukhangelwa mntu makangathathwa njengalowo kungafunyanwanga nto ngaye.
reputation.no_coverage: Akukho nto ikhangelweyo ngalo mboneleli okwangoku. Oko akuloxwebhu olucocekileyo — kukungabikho kwalo.
reputation.needs_review_notice: Ukukhankanywa okungu-{n} akukwazanga ukunxulunyaniswa nalo mboneleli ngokuqinisekileyo. Akubalwa de kubekho oqinisekisa ukuba yinkampani echanekileyo.
reputation.attributed: Siqinisekile ngo-{n}% ukuba oku kumalunga nalo mboneleli
reputation.attribution_warning: Siqinisekile ngo-{n}% kuphela ukuba oku kukhankanywa kumalunga nalo mboneleli. Qinisekisa ukuba yinkampani echanekileyo phambi kokuba ukuphathe njengokufunyenweyo.
reputation.reason_help: Kuyafuneka xa ususa okufunyenweyo. Kunyaka ozayo, ukukhatywa okungachazwanga akunakwahlulwa kunokucofa ngempazamo.
reputation.watching_help: Umboneleli akafane abizwe ngegama elikwi-invoyisi yakhe. Iimpawu zorhwebo, amagama orhwebo, iiwebhusayithi neeakhawunti zamaqonga zonke ziyakhangelwa, kunye nabalawuli bangoku nabanini abaxhamlayo.
reputation.nothing_watched: Igama elibhalisiweyo kuphela, igama lorhwebo nabantu bangoku.
reputation.watch_help: Yongeza uphawu lorhwebo, iwebhusayithi okanye iakhawunti yeqonga. Iiakhawunti zahlukene ngeqonga, kuba igama elifanayo kumaqonga amabini ziiakhawunti ezimbini ezahlukeneyo.

passport.health_help: Indlela obuhamba ngayo obu budlelwane — ukuhanjiswa, amaxwebhu, ukusabela.
passport.health_unknown: Kusekhona ixesha lokutsho. Akukho nto icelwe kubo kwaye akukho nto ihanjisiweyo okwangoku.
passport.never_assessed: Akuzange kuvavanywe. Akukho nto ithi apha ukuba kukhuselekile na ukuthengiselana nalo mboneleli.
passport.not_searched: Akukhangelwanga. Oko kukungabikho kwerekhodi, hayi irekhodi elicocekileyo.
passport.needs_a_person: Akukho mthombo ucwangcisiweyo; umntu kufuneka akuhlole
passport.conditions_lapsed: Imiqathango ibifuneka nge-{date} kwaye ayizalisekiswanga. Olu vumo alufanele luthenjwe.
passport.no_ubos: Akukho mntu wemvelo ufunyenweyo. Ude umxokelelwane ufike ebantwini, akukho mntu unokuhlolwa.
passport.moves_to: Idlulisela ityala ku-{state}. Esi sisigqibo se-{slot}.
passport.conditions_due_help: Uvumo olunemiqathango olungenamhla wokugqibela luvumo nje.
passport.override_help: Ukudlulisa kurekhodwa etyaleni kunye noko bekungaphumeleli ngelo xesha.

monitoring.title: Ibhokisi yokubekwa esweni
monitoring.subtitle: Yonke into kubo bonke ababoneleli engekajongwa mntu — utshintsho kwimithombo, okufunyenweyo kumajelo eendaba, nokungqinelana kohlolo.
monitoring.due_help: Ababoneleli abanohlolo oludlulelwe lixesha. Lo ngumsebenzi ekungekho mntu waziswe ngawo — umbuzo ongaphendulwanga awuyeki ukuba ngxamisekile ngokungahoywa.
monitoring.note_help: Kuyafuneka xa ukhaba. Kunyaka ozayo, ukukhatywa okungachazwanga akunakwahlulwa kunokucofa ngempazamo.
monitoring.swept: Kuhlolwe uhlolo olungu-{checks}; kufunyenwe utshintsho olungu-{changes}.
monitoring.no_sources: Akukho mthombo ucwangciselwe naluphi na uhlolo olufunekayo, ngoko akukho nto iphinde yenziwa. Imisantsa irekhodiwe endaweni yokufihlwa.
monitoring.runs_no_source: Ukubekwa esweni okungu-{n} akufumananga mthombo ucwangcisiweyo kokungenani kuhlolo olunye.
monitoring.cases_help: Amatyala okuphonononga alindele umntu. Adlulileyo kuqala.

ai.title: IGosa Lokhuseleko le-AI
ai.subtitle: Iidrafti ezilungiswe ngumncedisi, zilinde isigqibo somntu.

ai.chat_scope: Iimpendulo zivela kwiirekhodi ze-SHEQ nakwizinto zesalathiso zale nkampani. Akukho nto apha itshintsha irekhodi.

ppe.title: PPE
ppe.subtitle: Okukhutshiweyo, kubani, nokuba kufuneka kutshintshwe nini.
ppe.empty_catalogue: Akukho nto kwikhathalogu okwangoku, ngoko akukho nto inokukhutshwa. Sebenzisa u-“Lawula ikhathalogu nesitokhwe” ukongeza izinto ezikhutshwa yile nkampani — iibhutsi, iminqwazi yokhuselo, iiglavu — uze umisele ukuba zingaphi ezikwishelufu.

medical.clinical_warning: Inkcazelo yempilo phantsi kwe-POPIA s26. Ukuyifunda kubhalwa kwi-akhawunti yakho.
medical.record_note: Uvavanyo olwenziweyo. Iinkcukacha zonyango zigcinwa zodwa kwaye zifundwa kuphela ngabo banelungelo.
medical.expires_hint: Yishiye ingenanto ukuze kusetyenziswe ixesha lokusebenza elimiselwe olu vavanyo.
medical.restrictions_hint: Kuyafuneka. Isithintelo esingabhalwanga sishiya umphathi eqikelela.
medical.clinical_encrypted: Ifihliwe apho igcinwe khona kwaye ifundwa kuphela ngabo banelungelo leenkcukacha zonyango.

contractor.drop_hint: Ezininzi ngaxeshanye, okanye i-zip enye ephethe yonke ifayile yokhuseleko — ivulwa ibe lixwebhu elinye ngefayile nganye.
contractor.photo_hint: Indlela indlu yesango iyazi ngayo ukuba umntu esangweni ngulo mntu osekurhijistareni.
contractor.not_linked: Ayinxulumaniswanga nerekhodi loLawulo lwabaThengisi, ngoko ifayile yabo yokhuseleko nerekhodi labo lorhwebo akunakufundwa ngokuthelekiswa.
contractor.no_assessment: Akukho uvavanyo lwe-SHEQ olwenziweyo kwicala lorhwebo.
contractor.set_aside_note: Ixwebhu lihlala kwifayile njengobungqina kwaye liyeka ukubalwa kuthobelo. Sebenzisa oku ukulungisa umhla wokuphela ongalunganga: ukuncamathisela isatifikethi esifanelekileyo akwanelanga ngokwayo, kuba uvavanyo lugcina naliphi na ixwebhu eliphela mva.
contractor.set_aside_hint: Kubhalwe egameni lakho. Umphononongi obuza ukuba kutheni isatifikethi liyeke ukubalwa ufunda oku.
contractor.pass_hint: Isango liyiskena kwaye lifumana impendulo ebukhoma. Ikhowudi ayiphethe nto ngaphandle kwesalathisi — akukho nombolo kasazisi, akukho nkcukacha zonyango, akukho satifikethi — ngoko ihlala ikhuselekile ukuprinta, ukufota nokudlulisa.
contractor.worker_site_hint: Yishiye ingenanto ukuze ilandele indawo yomsebenzi yomkhontraki.
contractor.pass_rotate_warning: Ikhadi eliprintiweyo liyeka ukusebenza ngoko nangoko kwaye kufuneka likhutshwe elitsha. Sebenzisa oku xa ikhadi lilahlekile okanye umntu emkile.
contractor.sites_hint: Ukuvunywa kwenye indawo akukhona ukuvunywa kwenye. Indawo evimba lo mkhontraki iyamala apho nokuba ifayile yakhe ithini kwezinye iindawo.
contractor.sites_none: Azikho iindawo ezisebenzayo ekufuneka kugqitywe ngazo okwangoku.
contractor.site_conditions_hint: Iprintwa kwisigqibo sesango xa ikhadi labo liskenwa apha. Umzekelo: bakhatshwe ngamaxesha onke, ngemini kuphela.
contractor.site_reason_hint: Kutheni le ndawo igqibe ngolo hlobo.
contractor.site_reason_required: Kuyafuneka. Ukuvinjwa okungenasizathu akukho mntu unokukususa.
contractor.site_block_warning: Oku kubamala kule ndawo kuphela, kwaye kubamala nokuba ithini imeko yabo yenkampani iphela.

files.drop_hint: okanye cofa ukukhetha. I-zip ivulwa ibe lirekhodi elinye ngefayile nganye engaphakathi.

library.title: Ithala lamaxwebhu
library.subtitle: Iinkqubo ezisebenzayo, njengoko zisebenza kuwe
library.owing: Amaxwebhu angama-{count} alinde ukuba ungqine ukuba uwafundile.
library.watermark_note: Ikopi nganye iphatha uguqulelo lwayo, umhla wokupapasha nophawu lokuba yikopi engalawulwayo. Ikopi eprintiweyo isebenza kuphela ngomhla eyaprintwa ngawo.

exposure.title: Iiyure Ezisebenzileyo
exposure.subtitle: Ukuvezwa apho lonke izinga lokwenzakala lahlulwa ngako
exposure.site_hint: Yiyeke ingazalisiwe kwinkampani iphela. Bamba ngendawo kuphela ukuba unika ingxelo ngendawo.
exposure.basis_hint: Apho inani livela. Nantoni na ngaphandle kwenani elifakwe ngesandla yenza amazinga enyanga aphicothwe.
exposure.estimated_note: Iinyanga ezingama-{count} zixhomekeke kwinani elifakwe ngesandla, ngoko amazinga azo ngoqikelelo.
exposure.missing: Iinyanga ezingama-{count} azinaziyure, ngoko i-LTIFR, i-TRIR, i-DIFR nezinga lobukhali azinakubalwa kuzo.
exposure.footnote: Amazinga ngeeyure ezingama-200 000 ezisebenzileyo. Inyanga engenaziyure iyekwa ngaphandle kwizinga lonyaka endaweni yokubalwa njengo-0.

mine.title: Apho Ndimi
mine.subtitle: Amatikiti am, uvavanyo lwempilo nokufunda, njengoko inkqubo inako
mine.no_record: Akukho rekhodi labasebenzi lakho okwangoku, ngoko akukho nto kwifayile enokubonisa. Cela lowo wamisela i-akhawunti yakho ukuba akufake kuluhlu lwabaqeshwa — kude kube ngoko, inkqubo ayinakukuxelela apho umi, kwaye ayizokuqashela.
mine.nothing_on_file: Akukho nto ibhaliweyo ngakho okwangoku, kwaye akukho nto ifunwe kuwe. Oku akufani nokuthobela — kuthetha ukuba akukho nto emayihlolwe.
mine.blocking: {count} kumatikiti akho liphelelwe lixesha kwaye likuthintela ukusebenza. Akunakukhutshelwa mvume okanye usayinwe emsebenzini de lihlaziywe.
mine.gaps_hint: Oku kufunwe kuwe kwaye akukho rekhodi ngako. Itikiti eliphelelwe lixesha lifuna uhlaziyo; oku kufuneka kulungiselelwe.
mine.induction_not_current: Ukwaziswa kwakho kwindawo akusekho sexesheni. Unokubuyiswa esangweni.
mine.unacknowledged: Iinkqubo ezingama-{count} zilinde ukuba ungqine ukuba uzifundile
mine.footnote: Eli lirekhodi elinye elifundwa ziincwadi zorhijistara nesango. Ukuba into ethile apha ayilunganga, ayilunganga ndawo zonke — xelela igosa lakho lokhuseleko endaweni yokusebenza ngqa kuyo.

matrix.title: Imatriki Yobuchule
matrix.subtitle: Ngubani ofanelekileyo kweyiphi into, naphi apho sisilele
matrix.no_gaps: Bonke ubuchule obufunekayo buphethwe ngabo bonke abo bufunwa kubo.
matrix.capped: Ibonisa abantu abangama-{shown} kuma-{total}. Igridi ibanzi ngokwendalo, ngoko inqunyelwe.
matrix.nothing_required: Akukho buchule obusele bufunwe kuye nabani na. Oku akufani nokuba wonke umntu uthobele — kuthetha ukuba akukho nto enokuhlolwa ngayo.
matrix.footnote: Iimfuno ezincanyathiselwe kwindima, kwisebe okanye kwindawo zisonjululwa apho loo meko yaziwayo; le gridi ibonisa ezo zincanyathiselwe kubantu ngqo. Itikiti eliphelelwa lixesha lisabalwa njengeliphethweyo — lisebenza namhlanje.

safety_file.title: Ifayile Yokhuseleko
safety_file.subtitle: Icandelo ngalinye elifunwa ngulo msebenzisi wendawo, nokuqulethwe kwelinye nelinye.
safety_file.nothing_required: Akukho candelo elifunwayo okwangoku, ngoko ifayile ayinakuba igqibeleleyo okanye ingagqibelelanga. Khetha iprofayili yeshishini lakho uze uyilungise — yiloo nto echaza ukuba amaphi amacandelo abalulekile apha.
safety_file.complete: Lonke icandelo elifunwayo lizalisekisiwe. Le fayile ayifuni ikopi yephepha.
safety_file.history_count: {count} ezirekhodiweyo. Eli candelo lilimbali kunokuba libubungqina, ngoko akunyanzelekile ukuba lizaliswe.
safety_file.drop_hint: Yehlisa izatifikethi apha. Ifolda ye-zip ivulwa ibe lixwebhu elinye ngefayile nganye.
safety_file.reason_hint: Kubhalwe egameni lakho, kwaye umqhubi wekhontrakthi uxelelwa ukuba kuthetha ntoni.
safety_file.valid_until_hint: Yiyeke ingazalisiwe ukufumana iinyanga ezingama-{months} ukusuka namhlanje. Iphuma kumvume ngalo mhla nokuba ukhona ovula isikrini okanye akakho.
safety_file.reject_hint: Umqhubi wekhontrakthi kufuneka axelelwe ukuba makalungise ntoni. Ukwaliwa okungenasizathu kuqalisa umnxeba kunokuba kuqalise ixwebhu elilungisiweyo.
safety_file.warning_days_hint: Yiyeke ingazalisiwe ukusebenzisa okumiselweyo. Yimisele ngexesha elifunekayo ngokwenene ukutshintsha eli xwebhu.
safety_file.site_hint: Yiyeke ingazalisiwe apho lusebenza kuzo zonke iindawo. Ixwebhu lendawo ethile akufuneki livalele umqhubi wekhontrakthi kwezinye iindawo.
safety_file.activities_hint: Yiyeke ingazalisiwe apho lusebenza kuwo wonke umsebenzi. Itikiti lokuphakamisa libalulekile ekuphakamiseni, kungekhona ekupendeni.
safety_file.filed_as_hint: Lunikezelwe kuthetha ukuba lufikile kwaye kusafuneka luhlolwe ngumntu. Alunelisi nto de lwamkelwe.

state_hint.DRAFT: Akukho mntu usacelwe ukuba ajonge le fayile.
state_hint.SUBMITTED: Ingenisiwe kwaye ilinde umntu oza kuyithabatha.
state_hint.APPROVED: Umntu onobuchule wamkele le fayile. Iyeka ukusebenza ngomhla ongezantsi.
state_hint.SUSPENDED: Ayialiwa, kodwa ayisebenzi nayo. Abantu bayo bayalelwa esangweni.
state_hint.EXPIRED: Imvume iphelelwe lixesha. Kufuneka ingeniswe ifayile entsha.

move_hint.submit: Inikezela ifayile kuye nabani ophonononga iifayile zabaqhubi bekhontrakthi apha. Ayinakungeniswa lo gama icandelo elifunwayo lingazalisekisiwe.
move_hint.request_changes: Iyibuyisa noluhlu lwalo kufuneka kutshintshe. Okulandelayo okungeniswa ngumqhubi wekhontrakthi luguqulelo olutsha, kwaye olu lugcina isizathu sakho.
move_hint.approve: Yamkela ifayile njengokumi kwayo namhlanje. Imvume yingxelo malunga namaxwebhu akuyo ngalo mhla, ngoko iphatha umhla wokuphela.
move_hint.suspend: Imisa imvume ukusebenza ngaphandle kokwala ifayile. Abantu bayo bayalelwa esangweni ide ibuyiselwe.

safety_file.rules_hint: Sisigqibo sakho, kungekhona sohlelo. Yonke imiqathango engezantsi iyahlolwa kwaye ixelwe nokuba kunjani; ezi zitshixo zigqiba ukuba eziphi kuzo ezala ngokwenene umqhubi wekhontrakthi esangweni. Zisebenza kuwo wonke umqhubi wekhontrakthi, kuba ukuzisebenzisa ngokungalinganayo kuyinto eyenza umngeni esangweni uphumelele.

status_hint.COMPLIANT: Konke okufunwayo kusefayileni, kusexesheni kwaye kwamkelwe.
status_hint.EXPIRING: Akukho nto ilahlekileyo, kodwa into ethile iphelelwa lixesha kungekudala.
status_hint.NON_COMPLIANT: Into ethile efunwayo ayilungile. Ukhethe ukungaleli ukungena ngenxa yayo.
status_hint.PENDING_APPROVAL: Ifayile ikumphononongi. Akukho nto ilahlekileyo — akukho mntu useyamkele.
status_hint.SUSPENDED: Umntu unqumamise le fayile. Oko kudlula konke okubalwe.

rule.MISSING_MEDICAL: Umsebenzi ufuna isatifikethi sokufaneleka kwaye akukho siphathwayo
rule.MISSING_METHOD_STATEMENT: Umsebenzi ufuna ingxelo yendlela kwaye akukho egciniweyo
rule.MISSING_PERMIT: Umsebenzi ufuna imvume yokusebenza kwaye akukho evuliweyo
rule.MISSING_EQUIPMENT_CERTIFICATE: Umsebenzi ufuna isatifikethi sezixhobo kwaye akukho sigciniweyo

safety_file.always_blocks: ihlala yalela, kwaye ayicinywa apha. Indawo yomsebenzi igqiba ngesango sayo.

activities.title: Imisebenzi
activities.subtitle: Umsebenzi owenziwa kwindawo yomsebenzi, nokuba uhlobo ngalunye lufuna ntoni ukuze luvunyelwe.
activities.name: Igama
activities.code_hint: Oko kuthunyelwa sisifundi sekhadi, imvume okanye i-API. Oonobumba abakhulu, kungabikho zithuba.
activities.requires_hint: Ubungqina ekufuneka umntu abe nabo. Umsebenzi ongenabo obunye baku oku walelwa lo msebenzi ngegama.
activities.high_risk_hint: Kuwuphawula ukuze kujongwe kabini. Isango lisebenza ngoko umsebenzi okufunayo, hayi ngale nto.
activities.permit_hint: Imvume kufuneka ivulwe ngaphambi kokuba lo msebenzi uqale.
activities.retire_body: Ayisanikezwa. Iimvume neziganeko zokungena esele zibhaliwe ngayo zihlala zifundeka, kwaye ikhowudi inokusetyenziswa kwakhona kamva.
activities.empty_body: Ide umsebenzi uthi ufuna ntoni, isango elibuzwa ukuba “ngaba lo mntu angasebenza phezulu” alinanto yokujonga kwaye lidlulisa wonke umntu. Qala kuluhlu lwaseMzantsi Afrika oluzayo uze utshintshe oko ngamnye akufunayo.
activities.unstaffed: Imisebenzi engu-{n} ekungekho mntu kule ndawo ufaneleka kuyo okwangoku. Mhlawumbi izatifikethi kufuneka zilandelwe, okanye imfuno ayichanekanga.
activities.advisory_body: Umntu ongenabo ubungqina obufunekayo uyadluliswa kwaye isikhewu sibhalwe phantsi. Vula u-“Ikhono elingekho lomsebenzi” kwimithetho yokuvala abakhontraki ukuze kwaliwe endaweni yoko.

attendance.title: Kwindawo yomsebenzi
attendance.subtitle: Ngubani olapha ngoku, ngubani ongenileyo waphuma, nongazange aphume ngokusesikweni.
attendance.long_stays_hint: Abantu abangu-{n} sele bekule ndawo ixesha elingaphezu kweeyure ezingu-{hours}. Itshifti yasebusuku nayo ikhangeleka njalo — kodwa nendawo apho kungekho mntu uphumayo ngokusesikweni.
attendance.when_hint: Yishiye ingenanto ukuze ibe ngoku. Ixesha eligqithileyo liyamkelwa, ukubhala uluhlu lwephepha; elizayo alamkelwa.
attendance.manual_note: Kubhalwa njengokufakwe ngesandla, ukuze uphicotho-zincwadi lukwazi ukukwahlula ekuskeneni. Isifundi esingasebenziyo asisosizathu sokushiya umntu kuluhlu.
attendance.monitor_only: Ngewawaliwe — eli sango likwimo yokubeka esweni.

overrides.title: Ukufikelela kwexeshana
overrides.subtitle: Ngubani odluliselwe esangweni ekungafanelekanga adlule kulo, nangegunya likabani.
overrides.explainer: Ukugqitha kuvumela umntu ofayile yakhe ingekho mgangathweni. Kwenzelwe ukuba kube lula ukukunika — umkhontraki onomsebenzi nongenandlela yokungena kungendlela abantu abangena ngayo ngegama lomnye — kwaye kukhuselekile kuba konke kudweliswe apha nesizathu salo, umvumi walo nokuphela kwalo. Akukho nalinye elinokuqhuba ngaphezu kweentsuku ezingu-{days}.
overrides.grant_warning: Oku kungenisa kwindawo yomsebenzi umntu obeya kwaliwa. Kubhalwa ngegama lakho, nangegama lomvumi omchazayo.
overrides.ending_soon_hint: Ukugqitha okungu-{n} kuphela kwiintsuku ezimbini. Kuhlaziye okanye kuyeke kuphelelwe — kodwa gqiba, endaweni yokukufumanisa esangweni.
overrides.reason_hint: Oko umntu okuphononongayo kwiinyanga ezintandathu aya kusebenzisa. Ubuncinane oonobumba abalishumi.
overrides.conditions_hint: Oko kufuneka bakwenze ngelixa isebenza. Iprintwa kwisigqibo sesango xa ikhadi labo liskenwa.
overrides.starts_hint: Yishiye ingenanto ukuze iqalise ngoku. Ukugqitha kokuvalwa komsebenzi kunokulungiselelwa ngaphambi kosuku.
overrides.ends_hint: Kuyafuneka, kwaye ubuninzi iintsuku ezingu-{days} ezizayo. Kuzivala ngokwako.
overrides.site_hint: Yishiye ingenanto kuzo zonke iindawo. Ukuyinciphisa kukhetho olukhuselekileyo.
overrides.approver_hint: Umntu okugunyazileyo, ukuba ayinguwe. Yishiye ingenanto kwaye kubhalwe ngegama lakho.
overrides.revoke_body: Isango libuyela apho bekukhona, ngoko nangoko. Nabani na othembele koku ukuze angene kwindawo ngomso uya kwaliwa.

portal.title: Ukuthobela kwakho ukhuseleko
portal.subtitle: Oko u-{host} akufunayo kuwe phambi kokuba abantu bakho basebenze kwiindawo zabo.
portal.not_a_contractor_body: Awukho kuluhlu lwabakhontraki balo mthengi, ngoko akukho zimfuno zokhuseleko kwiakhawunti yakho. Ukuba abantu bakho basebenza kwiindawo zabo, bacele bakufake.
portal.score_explained: Inqaku elinye kuxwebhu ngalinye, kwifayile yakho yokhuseleko, nakwisazisi somntu ngamnye.
portal.nothing_required: Lo mthengi akakaceli nto kuwe okwangoku.
portal.nothing_outstanding: Akukho nto iseleyo. Uhambelana nazo zonke iimfuno.
portal.no_workers: Akukho namnye kubantu bakho okuluhlu lwalo mthengi okwangoku.
portal.review_note: Nantoni na oyithumelayo iyaphononongwa phambi kokuba ibalwe. Iya kubonakala ilindele uphononongo de bayamkele, ungathembeli kuyo esangweni ngaphambi koko.
portal.file_hint: I-PDF, umfanekiso okanye uxwebhu lwe-Word, ukuya kwi-20 MB.
portal.upload_done: Kuthunyelwe. Baya kukuphonononga kwaye kuya kubalwa xa sekwamkelwe.

notices.title: Izaziso zabakhontraki
notices.subtitle: Oko le nkqubo ikuxelela abakhontraki bakho, apho kuya khona, noko kuhambe ngokwenene.
notices.channels_hint: I-imeyile ebhalisiweyo yenkampani encinci idla ngokuba yeyomphicothi-zincwadi, ejongwa kanye ngeveki. Inombolo kwirekhodi elinye idla ngokuba yeyomphathi wendawo yomsebenzi.
notices.none_selected: Akukho nto iya kuthunyelwa kubakhontraki. Baya kufumanisa esangweni.
notices.what_we_send_hint: Sonke isaziso le nkqubo isithumela umkhontraki, noko sikubangelayo.
notices.unreachable_body: Abanayo idilesi kwiindlela ozikhethileyo, ngoko akukho nasinye kwezi zaziso esibafikelelayo. Akukho mposiso iboniswayo — nje abaxelelwa, de kubekho ohlehliswayo esangweni.

when.worker_blocked: Xa umntu ehlehliswa ngokwenene, kungekhona kwimo yokubeka esweni
when.induction_required: Rhoqo ngeveki, njengoluhlu olunye endaweni yomyalezo ngamnye
when.competency_expiring: Ukusuka kwiintsuku ezingu-30 ngaphambili, nakanye emva kokuphela

reason.worker_unknown: Umntu akakho kuyo nayiphi na irosta

schemes.title: Izikimu zokuthobela namasango emisebenzi
schemes.subtitle: Izikimu umbutho wakho osebenza phantsi kwazo (GLOBALG.A.P., SIZA, ezendalo, ikhowudi yekhasimende), ezamkelwa kwindawo nganye kwirejista yezomthetho — noohlolo ekufuneka luphumelele phambi kokuba uhlobo oluthile lomsebenzi luqale.
schemes.name: Igama
schemes.gates_hint: Umsebenzi awunakuqala de uhlolo, olwenzelwe loo msebenzi, luphumelele.

no_company.title: Akukho nkampani isebenzayo
no_company.body: Idatha yolawulo lwezothengo yeyenkampani. Khetha inkampani ofuna ukusebenza kuyo.
no_company.body_self_hosted: Akukho nkampani esekiweyo kule nkqubo okwangoku. Iirekhodi apha zezenkampani, ngoko yenza enye phantsi kweZicwangciso phambi kokusebenzisa imodyuli.

common.title: Isihloko
common.name: Igama
common.comment_optional: Ayinyanzelekanga, kodwa iyamnceda lowo uya kuyifunda kamva.
common.form_errors: Nceda ulungise iingxaki ezingu-{n} phambi kokuqhubeka:

planning.title: Ucwangciso lokuthenga
planning.subtitle: Izicwangciso zonyaka, iimfuno kunye nemeko yohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali

documents.title: Amaxwebhu
documents.subtitle: Uluhlu olunye, oluqhotyoshelwe naphi na apho lusebenza khona

analytics.title: Uhlalutyo lokuthenga
analytics.subtitle: Indlela imodyuli iphela esebenza ngayo, kungekhona nje into eyichithileyo

dashboard.title: Ulawulo lokuthenga
dashboard.subtitle: Ucwangciso, iithenda, ukuphambuka nokuthobela kwindawo enye

planning.title: Izicwangciso zokuthenga
planning.subtitle: Iimfuno zokuthenga zonyaka zombutho
planning.new_plan_hint: Isicwangciso sihlanganisa iimfuno zonyaka wezimali zesebe okanye iprojekthi enye.
planning.create_plan_hint: Isicwangciso siqala njengeyilo. Yongeza iimfuno phambi kokusingenisela uphononongo.
planning.no_lines: Akukho mfuno ibhaliweyo kwesi sicwangciso okwangoku.
planning.cancel_hint: Ukurhoxisa kukhulula naliphi na uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali olubanjelwe imigca yesi sicwangciso.
planning.no_budget_module: ULawulo lweSabelo-mali alufakwanga, ngoko akukho sabelo-mali sinokuqhotyoshelwa. Isicwangciso siyasebenza ngaphandle kwaso.
planning.no_budget_position: Akukho sabelo-mali siqhotyoshelweyo, okanye uLawulo lweSabelo-mali alufakwanga, ngoko imeko yezimali ayinakuboniswa.
planning.over_budget: Esi sicwangciso sigqithisa uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali olukhoyo ngo-{amount}.
planning.delayed_subtitle: Sele udlulile umhla wethenda okanye wokunikezela kwaye ayikanikezelwa
planning.upcoming_empty: Akukho nto ifunekayo kwiintsuku ezingama-60 ezizayo.

tenders.title: Uphononongo lweethenda
tenders.subtitle: Ukuqalisa, uhlolo, ulungiso nesindululo sokunikezela
tenders.initiate_hint: Uphononongo lwethenda lunekomiti yalo, imilinganiselo, izicelo nesindululo.
tenders.create_review_hint: Imilinganiselo nekomiti zicwangciswa emva koko, phambi kokuba uhlolo luvulwe.
tenders.plan_line_hint: Ukukhetha umgca wesicwangciso kuthatha iinkcukacha zawo.

methodologies.WEIGHTED_hint: Wonke umlinganiselo ulinganiswa ube linqaku elinye
methodologies.TWO_ENVELOPE_hint: Isango lobuchwephesha kuqala, ixabiso livulwe kuphela kwabo baphumeleleyo

tenders.weights_must_total: Ubunzima bexabiso nobokhetho kufuneka bube ngu-100; buyi-{total}.
tenders.no_committees: Akukho komiti isebenzayo okwangoku — yenza enye phambi kokuba uhlolo luvulwe.
tenders.approval_level_hint: Umbhalo okhululekileyo: inqanaba legunya elifunwa lolu nikezelo.
tenders.frozen_explainer: Imilinganiselo yatyhidwa ngomhla we-{at}, xa uhlolo lwavulwa. Utshintsho ngoku lufuna isicelo sotshintsho lwemilinganiselo esivunyiweyo.
tenders.no_evaluators: Akukho bahloli babelweyo. Yabela ikomiti kuqala.
tenders.coi_outstanding_body: Uhlolo alunakuvulwa de lonke ilungu elivotayo libhengeze kwaye nalo naluphi na ungquzulwano olubhengeziweyo lusonjululwe.
tenders.no_recommendation: Akukho sindululo senziweyo. Vuma amanqaku kulungiso kuqala.
tenders.recommended_supplier_hint: Ngokuzenzekelayo yisicelo esiphezulu; tshintsha ukuba ikomiti indulula ngenye indlela.

tenders.preference_framework_hint: Sizalisa ukwahlulwa kwexabiso nokukhetha okumiselwe ngumthetho.

tenders.converted_at: Kuguqulwe ngo-{rate} {from} ukuya ku-{to} ngomhla we-{date}

evaluations.title: Uhlolo lwam
evaluations.subtitle: Iithenda othunyelwe ukuba uzinike amanqaku
evaluations.none_hint: Uya kubona iithenda apha xa sele uthunyelwe kwikomiti yohlolo.
evaluations.declare_first: Gqibezela isibhengezo sakho songquzulwano lwemidla phambi kokunika amanqaku.
evaluations.conflict_blocked: Ubhengeze ungquzulwano. Ukunika amanqaku kumisiwe de umlawuli akusombulule.
evaluations.declaration_intro: Phambi kokunika amanqaku, bhengeza ukuba unawo na umdla kumnikezeli kule thenda.
evaluations.conflict_pending: Ungquzulwano olubhengezileyo lukumlawuli. Awunakunika amanqaku de lusonjululwe.
evaluations.price_hidden: Olu luhlolo lweemvulophu ezimbini, ngoko amaxabiso ezicelo ahlala evaliwe de inqanaba lobuchwephesha ligqityiwe.
evaluations.locked_body: Ingenisiwe nge-{date}. Olu luhlaziyo lwe-{revision}. Ulungiso lufuna ukuvulwa okugunyazisiweyo, okugcina amanqaku okuqala.
evaluations.submit_hint: Xa ungenisile amanqaku akho ayatshixwa kwaye abalelwa kwinqaku lekomiti.
evaluations.confirm_submit_body: Inqaku lakho elilinganisiweyo ngu-{score}. Emva kokungenisa, utshintsho lufuna ukuvulwa okugunyazisiweyo.

moderation.title: Ulungiso
moderation.subtitle: Thelekisa abahloli, sombulula umahluko, uvume amanqaku okugqibela

moderation.reevaluate_warning: Oku kuvula kwakhona amanqaku angenisiweyo omhloli. Amanqaku okuqala ayagcinwa.

deviations.title: Ukuphambuka
deviations.subtitle: Izicelo zokuphambuka kwindlela eqhelekileyo yokuthenga

deviations.motivation_hint: Yile nto umphicothi-zincwadi ayifunda kuqala. Chaza okwenzekileyo nokuba kutheni indlela eqhelekileyo ingasetyenziswanga.
deviations.draft_notice: Ukugcina kugcina oku njengoyilo. Imithetho yokuthobela iqhuba xa uyingenisela ukuvunywa.
deviations.no_rules: Umbutho wakho awukacwangcisi mithetho yokuthobela yokuphambuka.

deviations.accept_warnings: Ndiyazamkela ezi zilumkiso kwaye ndifuna ukuqhubeka
deviations.acceptance_reason_hint: Kubhalwa kuhlolo kwaye kubonwa nguye wonke umvumi.

fields.reason_hint: Ngesivakalisi esinye okanye ezibini, yintoni eyenza oku kufuneke.

fields.proposed_alternative_hint: Yintoni eyaqwalaselwayo endaweni yayo, nokuba kutheni ingasetyenziswanga.

records.title: Iirekhodi zokuthenga
records.subtitle: Konke ukuthenga, ukusuka ekuqaleni ukuya ekugqibeleni, kwirekhodi enye

records.no_tender: Akukho phononongo lwethenda luphakanyisiweyo kolu kuthenga.

documents.not_linked: Olu xwebhu aluqhotyoshelwanga nakuyiphi na into okwangoku.
documents.acknowledgement_required: Olu xwebhu kufuneka luvunywe phambi kokuba luthenjwe.

approvals.title: Ukuvunywa
approvals.subtitle: Konke okulinde isigqibo, kuyo yonke le modyuli

approvals.cannot_decide: Eli nyathelo alabelwanga kuwe, okanye nguwe owaphakamisa isicelo. Ukwahlulwa kwemisebenzi kufuna umvumi owahlukileyo.

compliance.title: Ideshbhodi yokuthobela
compliance.subtitle: Apho umbutho umi khona ngokuchasene nemithetho yawo yokuthenga

workload.trend_hint: Isalathiso somthwalo esiphakathi kwiintsuku ezingama-90 ezidlulileyo.
workload.summary: Amagosa angu-{officers}, ukuthenga okusebenzayo okungu-{active}, izenzo ezidlulelwe lixesha ezingu-{overdue}.

settings.title: Iisetingi zolawulo lokuthenga
settings.subtitle: Izakhono, imida, imithetho namakhonkco okuvuma
settings.capabilities_hint: Ukucima isakhono kufihla amaphepha aso, amakhadi nezikhumbuzo. Konke okunye kuyaqhubeka kusebenza.

capability.workload_hint: Umthwalo wamagosa, izilumkiso zamandla namaxesha okucwangcisa
capability.governance_hint: Injini yemithetho, iirekhodi ezingu-360°, amaxwebhu nomkhondo wophicotho

settings.fy_start_hint: Umisela ukuba ukuthenga kunikwa ingxelo kuwuphi unyaka.
settings.budget_warning_hint: Lumkisa xa isicwangciso sifika kweli sabelo lohlahlo-lwabiwo-mali olukhoyo.
settings.variance_hint: Phawula umlinganiselo xa abahloli behluka ngaphezu kweli sabelo lenani eliphezulu.
settings.workload_order: Kufuneka ibe ngaphezulu komda womthwalo ophezulu.
settings.escalation_days_hint: Ixesha ukuvunywa okunokuhlala ngalo phambi kokuba abaphathi baxelelwe.
settings.require_coi_hint: Uhlolo alunakuvulwa de lonke ilungu elivotayo libhengezile.
settings.allow_reopen_hint: Ukuvulwa kwakhona kubhala isizathu saso kwaye kugcina amanqaku okuqala.
settings.block_over_budget_hint: Kucinyiwe ngokuzenzekelayo: eminye imibutho icwangcisa ngabom ngaphezulu.
settings.rules_explainer: Akukho nto apha ibotshelelwe kuwo nawuphi na ummiselo. Amaxwebhu afunekayo, amanqanaba okuvuma, imida, iindawo ezinyanzelekileyo, izibhengezo, imida yexesha nokunyuswa konke kucwangciswa njengemithetho, ukuze inkqubo enye ikhonze izikhokelo ezahlukeneyo.
settings.no_rule_sets: Akukho seti zemithetho zicwangcisiweyo. Ukungenisa kuya kuphumelela kungekho mithetho ihloliweyo.
settings.severity_hint: Ukungaphumeleli kuthintela ukungenisa; isilumkiso siyaphawula kuphela.
settings.framework_hint: Yeerekhodi zakho kuphela — akukho nto ithathela kuyo isigqibo.
settings.message_hint: Amagama akho athatha indawo yalawo enkqubo.

rule_types.REQUIRED_DOCUMENT: Amaxwebhu achaziweyo kufuneka aqhotyoshelwe kwaye abe akhona

params.category_codes_hint: Iikhowudi ezahlulwe ngekoma, umz. TAX_CLEARANCE, BBBEE
params.tolerance_pct_hint: Vumela ukugqitha kude kufike kweli sabelo

settings.chains_explainer: Ikhonkco lichaza ukuba lisebenza nini. Umdibaniso ochanekileyo uyaphumelela, ukuze isicelo esinye sihambe ngendlela enye rhoqo.
settings.is_default: Sebenzisa xa lingekho elinye ikhonkco elihambelanayo
settings.is_default_hint: Elinye elisisiseko ngesihloko ngasinye lenza sonke isicelo sibe nendlela.
settings.retire_chain_body: Ikhonkco liyayeka ukuthumela izicelo ezitsha. Izigqibo esezithathiwe ngalo zigcina irekhodi lazo, kwaye akukho nto sele ivunyiwe itshintshayo.
settings.chain_edit_warning: Izicelo ezingu-{n} okwangoku zidlula kweli khonkco
settings.code_locked_hint: Ikhowudi ichonga eli khonkco kwaye ayinakutshintshwa.
settings.steps_hint: Ukuvunywa kwenzeka ngolu landelelwano. Tshintsha ulandelelwano ngeentolo.
settings.single_approver_hint: Umntu omnye ochongiweyo utyikitya eli nyathelo.
settings.preference_explainer: Izikhokelo zokukhetha zigqiba ukuba umnikezeli ufumana malini ngaphandle kwexabiso. Ifomula yexabiso imiselwe ngumthetho; amanqaku amiselwa ngumgaqo-nkqubo wakho, ngoko itheyibhile ehlwayelweyo sisiqalo de uyiqinisekise.
settings.fx_basis_hint: Lelaliphi ilanga izinga lotshintshiselwano elithelekisa izicelo kwiimali ezahlukeneyo.
settings.fx_basis_submission_warning: Ukuguqula isicelo ngasinye ngomhla waso wokungenisa kuthetha ukuba izicelo ezimbini ezifanayo zinokwahluka kulandelelwano ngenxa nje yokufika ngeentsuku ezahlukeneyo.
settings.fx_rate_type_hint: Ihambelana nohlobo olugcinwe kwiFinance, ngokuqhelekileyo yi-spot.
settings.framework_no_bands: Akukho mibhinqo imisiweyo. Akukho nto iya kunikezelwa phantsi kwesi sikhokelo de imiselwe.
settings.retire_framework_body: Isikhokelo siyeka ukunikezwa kwiithenda ezintsha. Iithenda ezisele zinikwe amanqaku ngaso zigcina irekhodi lazo.
settings.basis_hint: Amanqaku anika ibhaso; umda unika ithuba lexabiso endaweni yoko.
settings.framework_notes_hint: Oku kusekelwe phi, nayo nantoni na esafuna ukuqinisekiswa.
settings.bands_hint: Kujongwa ngokulandelelana; umbhinqo wokuqala umnikezeli ohambelana nawo ngowo usebenzayo.
settings.confirm_verified: Ndiyaqinisekisa ukuba la manani ahambelana nomgaqo-nkqubo wethu wokuthenga owamkelweyo
settings.confirm_verified_hint: Kubhalwa phantsi kwegama lakho. Ukuhlela amanani kamva kususa oku de kunikwe kwakhona.
settings.confirm_verified_note: Esi sikhokelo siza kuphawulwa njengesiqinisekisiweyo, egameni lakho, xa ugcina.

portal.local_content: Esi sicelo sihlangabezana nemfuno yomxholo wasekhaya
portal.confirm: Ndiyaqinisekisa ukuba esi sicelo silungile kwaye singeniswe egameni lenkampani echazwe ngasentla
portal.confirm_hint: Xa singenisiwe, isicelo sakho siyavalwa kwaye asinakutshintshwa. Qhagamshelana negosa lokuthenga ukuba ufuna ukusitshintsha.
portal.closed_warning: Le thenda sele ivaliwe. Usenako ukungenisa, kodwa isicelo sakho siza kubhalwa njengesemva kwexesha kwaye kukwikomiti ukugqiba ukuba singaqwalaselwa na.
portal.received_body: Sihlala sivaliwe de ithenda ivalwe, size sivulwe kunye nazo zonke ezinye izicelo ngamagosa amabini.
portal.received_late: Isicelo sakho samkelwa emva kwexesha lokuvala
portal.received_late_body: Sibhalwe njengesemva kwexesha. Ukuba isicelo esisemva kwexesha singaqwalaselwa na kugqitywa yikomiti ngokwemithetho yayo.
portal.receipt_hint: Yigcine. Ichonga isicelo sakho ngaphandle kokusityhila.
portal.footer: Kungeniswe nge-Mkhaya Hub. Eli khonkco lelakho wedwa — ungalabelani nabanye.

intake.explainer: Abanikezeli abamenyiweyo bangenisa ngekhonkco labo. Izicelo zihlala zivaliwe de ithenda ivalwe, zize zonke zivulwe kunye ngamagosa amabini.
intake.invite_hint: Yenza ikhonkco labucala lalo mnikezeli. Mthumele lona — kuphela indlela yakhe yokungena.
intake.link_once: Liboniswa kanye. Likhuphele ngoku — alisayi kuboniswa kwakhona.
intake.withdraw_body: Isicelo esivaliweyo siyasuswa ukuze lo mnikezeli akwazi ukungenisa kwakhona. Kokubini ukurhoxiswa nesicelo esitsha kuhlala kumkhondo wophicotho.
intake.opening_explainer: Zonke izicelo ezivaliweyo zivulwa ngaxeshanye, nguwe nengqina. Ukuvula kwenzeka kanye kwaye akunakubuyiselwa umva.
intake.open_warning: Sonke isicelo esivaliweyo siyafundeka ngalo mzuzu, kwaye akunakubuyiselwa umva. Qhubeka kuphela xa ingqina lakho likho.
intake.witness_hint: Umntu wesibini, okhoyo ekuvulweni, obhalwe kwithenda.

analytics.title: Uhlalutyo lokuthenga
analytics.subtitle: Indlela imodyuli iphela esebenza ngayo, kungekhona nje into eyichithileyo

analytics.pipeline_hint: Apho umsebenzi uwa khona phakathi kokucwangcisa nokuvala.
analytics.competition_hint: Ipateni yeethenda ezinesicelo esinye lelona phawu licacileyo kule datha.
analytics.bottlenecks_hint: Ngenyathelo, kuba ikhonkco licotha xa isihlalo esinye kuso sicotha.
analytics.awards_hint: Ngubani owaphumelela ukunikezelwa okungu-{n}, naphantsi kwemithetho ethile.
analytics.trend_hint: Isamba sithi uphi; uluhlu luthi uya ngaphi.

budgets_approvals.title: Ugunyaziso lwahlahlo-lwabiwo-mali
budgets_approvals.subtitle: Izigqibo ezikulindeleyo, noko ukulindeleyo wena.
budgets_approvals.reject_reason_hint: Umntu okungenisileyo uyakubona oku, ngoko chaza into ekufuneka itshintshile.
budgets_approvals.confirm_approve_body: Ukugunyazisa “{label}” kuhambisa imali yokwenene. Oku kubhalwa egameni lakho.
budgets_approvals.covering_notice: Ezinye zezi zilapha kuba umela ugunyaziso luka-{names}.
budgets_approvals.given_sub: Ngubani ophethe ugunyaziso lwakho lohlahlo-lwabiwo xa ungekho. Bongezwa njengomgunyazisi — usenako ukugqiba nantoni na wena.
budgets_approvals.received_sub: Ugunyaziso lukabani onokulugqiba, nokuba kude kube nini.
budgets_approvals.delegate_sub: Omnye umntu unokugqiba ugunyaziso lwakho lohlahlo-lwabiwo okwexeshana.
budgets_approvals.delegate_notice: Ukumela kongeza umgunyazisi endaweni yokudlulisa ilungelo, ngoko usenako ukugqiba nantoni na wena. Ukwahlulwa kwemisebenzi kusasebenza: akukho mntu unokugunyazisa oko ukungenisileyo.
budgets_approvals.no_cover: Akukho mntu ucele ukuba umele ugunyaziso lwakhe.
budgets_approvals.confirm_end_delegation_body: {to} akasakwazi ukugqiba ugunyaziso lwakho. Izigqibo asezenzile azitshintshi.
budgets_approvals.hint_from_user: Yishiye ingawe ngaphandle kokuba ulungiselela omnye umntu.
budgets_approvals.hint_ends_on: Yishiye ingenanto ukuze ingabi nasiphelo, umz. isithuba esingenamntu.

budgets_approval_setup.title: Ukudluliswa kogunyaziso lohlahlo-lwabiwo
budgets_approval_setup.subtitle: Ngubani otyikitya ntoni, kule nkampani.
budgets_approval_setup.default_notice: Ngaphandle kokudluliswa okuyilweyo, zonke izigqibo zohlahlo-lwabiwo zisema emgceni — kwaye nabani na onokugunyazisa iihlahlo-lwabiwo unokuzigqiba. Yila indlela apha xa ufuna ileli elithile, umthetho wemityikityo emibini, okanye umda apho ngaphantsi kwawo kungadluliswa nto.
budgets_approval_setup.no_hr_notice: Akukho modyuli ye-HR efakiweyo, ngoko inyathelo elisethwe ku-“umphathi wongenisayo” alinakuhlangatyezwa nangubani. Sebenzisa indima okanye umntu ochaziweyo endaweni yoko.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_adjustment: Ukunyusa, ukwehlisa okanye ukudlulisa kwabelo olukhoyo.
budgets_approval_setup.hint_reservation: Imali ebanjelwe uhlahlo-lwabiwo ngaphambi kokuba kubekho i-odolo yokuthenga.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_body: “{name}” ayisayi kudlulisa nto. Akukho nto sele igqityiwe itshintshayo.
budgets_approval_setup.confirm_delete_pending: “{name}” isenezigqibo ezingu-{count} emgceni. Ezo zigcina ileli lazo nembali yazo; akukho nto intsha eza kudluliswa ngayo.
budgets_approval_setup.steps_hint: Linyukwa ngokulandelelana. Chaza abantu ngomthetho apho unako — indima iyaphila nokuba umntu uyemka.
budgets_approval_setup.allow_self: Vumela umntu ongenisileyo agunyazise eli nyathelo

budgets_tracking.title: Ukulandelela iihlahlo-lwabiwo
budgets_tracking.subtitle: Apho imi khona yonke imihlahlo-lwabiwo, into ekhathazayo, noko kumisiweyo.
budgets_tracking.position_hint: Okuboshiweyo kuquka okubekelweyo nokutshixiweyo, kungekhona koko kuhlawulwe nge-invoyisi kuphela.
budgets_tracking.rules_subtitle: Xa le nkampani ifuna ukwaziswa, naxa ifuna ukumiswa.
budgets_tracking.block_notice: Ngumthetho oVimbayo kuphela owalayo nantoni na. Unyanzeliswa apho imali ibekelwa okanye ibotshwa khona, kungekhona kweli phepha kuphela.
budgets_tracking.no_rules: Akukho mithetho okwangoku. Iihlahlo-lwabiwo ezigqithayo zisaxelwa.
budgets_tracking.confirm_delete_rule_body: “{name}” uyeka ukubukela. Izilumkiso sele ziphakanyisiwe zicombululwa kukhangelo olulandelayo.
budgets_tracking.ack_hint: Okwenziwayo ngayo. Isilumkiso sihlala sisebenza de imeko iphele.

budgets_insights.analytics_sub: Indlela imali ebekwe ngayo, apho iya khona, noko kulinde isigqibo.
budgets_insights.truncated: Kubonisa imiqolo engu-500 yokuqala. Ukuthunyelwa kwe-CSV kunayo yonke.

report_sources.commitments: Kubhalwa xa i-odolo yokuthenga ikhutshwa, okanye kufakwe ngesandla kuhlahlo-lwabiwo.
report_sources.consumptions: Kubhalwa xa i-invoyisi okanye i-GRN ibhaliswa, okanye kufakwe ngesandla kuhlahlo-lwabiwo.
report_sources.adjustments: Kuphakanyiswa kuhlahlo-lwabiwo njengokunyusa, ukwehlisa okanye ukudlulisa.
report_sources.overrides: Kuphakanyiswa kuhlahlo-lwabiwo xa umntu ecela ukuchitha ngaphaya kwabelo.
report_sources.approvals: Zonke izigqibo ezidluliselweyo, zivela emgceni wogunyaziso.
report_sources.alerts: Kuphakanyiswa kukhangelo lwasebusuku ngokwemithetho yezilumkiso yale nkampani.
report_sources.phasing: Kubhalwe kwithebhu yeSigaba sohlahlo-lwabiwo ngalunye: amaxesha avaliweyo angaphezu komda womahluko wonyaka, nesizathu sokuba ngalinye liphose isicwangciso salo.

chart.spend_empty: Akukho nkcitho ibhaliweyo okwangoku. Ifika xa i-invoyisi ibhaliswa, okanye xa umntu eyibhala kuhlahlo-lwabiwo.
chart.cycle_sub: Iiyure eziphakathi ukusuka ekungeniseni ukuya kwisigqibo, kwiinyanga ezintandathu ezidlulileyo.

budgets_planning.title: Ukulungiselela uhlahlo-lwabiwo
budgets_planning.subtitle: Dlulisela unyaka, ngenisa omnye usuka kwispredishithi, uvale lowo ophelileyo.
budgets_planning.years_sub: Ukwabiwa ngamaxesha kufuna amaxesha; unyaka ongenawo awunacebo lokuthelekisa nenkcitho.
budgets_planning.no_periods_hint: Akukho maxesha achaziweyo. Wenze kwiiSetingi ukuze iihlahlo-lwabiwo zabiwe ngamaxesha.
budgets_planning.confirm_close_body: Iihlahlo-lwabiwo ku-{name} zivalwa kunye nawo. Ukubotshwa osele kwenziwe kusafuna ukuhlawulwa nge-invoyisi.
budgets_planning.mode_allocation_hint: Unyaka olandelayo uqala ngenani lalo nyaka — indawo eqhelekileyo yokuqala umjikelo omtsha.
budgets_planning.mode_unspent_hint: Unyaka olandelayo uqala ngoko bekusafumaneka. Iihlahlo-lwabiwo ezingenanto zitsitsiwe.
budgets_planning.carry_notice: Yonke into ifika njengeyilo. Akukho nto isebenzayo de kubekho umntu oyigunyazisayo.
budgets_planning.import_sub: I-CSV, ivela ngqo kwispredishithi umjikelo oqale kuso.
budgets_planning.import_notice: Imiqolo ijongwa nganye nganye. Umqolo ombi uxelwa ngenombolo yomgca; emihle isangeniswa, njengeeyilo.
budgets_planning.template_sub: Yona kanye ifayile efundwa ngumngenisi, kunye nemiqolo emibini yomzekelo egcwalisiweyo.
budgets_planning.hint_target_year: Zonke iihlahlo-lwabiwo kwifayile zenziwa kulo nyaka.
budgets_planning.hint_file: I-CSV kuphela, ukuya kuma-5 MB. Gcina njenge-“CSV UTF-8” kwi-Excel.
budgets_planning.how_1: Umqolo wokuqala kufuneka ube ngowesihloko. Amagama athelekiswa ngaphandle kokujonga oonobumba abakhulu kwaye izithuba ziba ngoo-underscore, ngoko “Allocated Amount” no-“allocated_amount” yikholam enye.
budgets_planning.how_2: Ulandelelwano lweekholam alunamsebenzi, kwaye iikholam ongazidingiyo zinokushiywa ngokupheleleyo kwifayile.
budgets_planning.how_3: Umqolo ngamnye ujongwa wodwa. Umqolo osilelayo uxelwa ngenombolo yawo kwifayile uze utsitsiwe — eminye isangeniswa.
budgets_planning.how_4: Yonke into ifika njengeyilo. Akukho nto isebenzayo, kwaye akukho nto ingena emgceni wogunyaziso de kubekho umntu oyingenisayo.
budgets_planning.how_5: Ixabiso umngenisi angalaziyo — ididi elibhalwe gwenxa okanye uhlobo lwenkcitho — alwenzi umqolo usilele. Libuyela kokuzenzekelayo lize libhalwe njengesilumkiso emva koko.
budgets_planning.how_6: Akukho nto ihluziweyo kabini. Ukulayisha ifayile enye kabini kwenza iihlahlo-lwabiwo kabini, ngoko ngenisa ifayile elungisiweyo kunyaka omtsha okanye ucime iiyilo kuqala.
budgets_planning.col_help_name: Igama lohlahlo-lwabiwo, umz. “Iinkonzo zeOfisi eNtloko”. Igama elingenanto lenza umqolo usilele.
budgets_planning.col_help_allocated_amount: Inombolo. Iimpawu zemali, izithuba nabahluli bamawaka bayasuswa, ngoko “R 1 850 000,00” no-“1850000” zombini ziyasebenza. Nantoni na engeyonombolo yenza umqolo usilele.
budgets_planning.col_help_expenditure_type: Ibuyela ku-opex xa ingenanto okanye ingaziwa.
budgets_planning.col_help_category: Kufuneka ihambelane nelinye lamagama amadidi angezantsi. Igama elingafumanekiyo lishiya uhlahlo-lwabiwo lungenadidi lize liphakamise isilumkiso.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_type: Ibuyela kokuqhelekileyo xa ingenanto okanye ingaziwa.
budgets_planning.col_help_scope_label: Umbhalo okhululekileyo ochaza isebe, iprojekthi okanye iziko leendleko, umz. “IOfisi eNtloko”.
budgets_planning.col_help_currency: Ikhowudi yoonobumba abathathu njenge-ZAR. Nantoni na enye iyatyeshelwa kuze kusebenze okuzenzekelayo kwenkampani.
budgets_planning.categories_hint: Upelo luthelekiswa ngaphandle kokujonga oonobumba abakhulu, kodwa igama kufuneka libe lelona ngaphandle koko.
budgets_planning.categories_none: Akukho madidi okwangoku. Wongeze phantsi kwe-Lungiselela › IiSetingi, okanye ushiye ikholam yedidi ingenanto.

document_management.subtitle: Indawo enye yamaxwebhu omibutho, nayo yonke inguqulelo igcinwe.
document_management.dropzone_label: Yehlisa iifayile apha okanye cofa ukukhetha iifayile
document_management.drop_here: Yehlisa iifayile apha, okanye cofa ukukhetha
document_management.drop_hint: Kude kube iifayile ezingama-{count} ngexesha, {max} MB nganye
document_management.notes_hint: Amanqaku angaphakathi. Akaboniswa mntu ngaphandle kwale moduli.
document_management.sensitivity_hint: Ukwenza iyimfihlo kuthintela ukuba ngubani onokuyibona. Ubuthathaka ngokwasemthethweni kuyibeka phantsi kokubanjwa — ayinakucinywa ngelixa oko kumiselwe.
document_management.search: Khangela — zama “i-inshorensi yomthengisi ephela kwiintsuku ezingama-30”
document_management.held_cannot_delete: Iphantsi kokubanjwa ngokwasemthethweni — ayinakucinywa de ukubanjwa kususwe.
document_management.versions_help: Ukutshintsha ifayile kugcina eli xwebhu nayo yonke into ekuyo. Iinguqulelo zangaphambili zihlala zifundeka.
document_management.history_help: Yonke into eyenzekileyo kweli xwebhu, kuquka ukuba ngubani olivulileyo.
document_management.sensitivity_help: Ukutshintsha nokuphi koku kubhalwa negama lakho.
document_management.sensitivity_note_hint: Kutheni iphawulwe — kuluncedo xa umntu ebuza kamva.
document_management.remove_help: Ukugcina kunokubuyiselwa. Ukucima kunokurhoxiswa de ixwebhu litshatyalaliswe ngokupheleleyo.
document_management.hold_explainer: Eli xwebhu liphantsi kokubanjwa ngokwasemthethweni. Alinakucinywa ngelixa oko kusekho.
document_management.archived_explainer: Eli xwebhu ligcinwe. Lisafundeka kwaye linokubuyiselwa.

settings_page.title: Izicwangciso zamaxwebhu
settings_page.subtitle: Okunokulayishwa apha, ubungakanani, nendlela amaxwebhu athiywa ngayo.
settings_page.max_size_hint: Isebenza kwifayile nganye, kungekhona kulo lonke ulayisho.
settings_page.types_help: Uluhlu lwemvume. Nantoni na engekho kulo yaliwa.
settings_page.blocked_hint: Zisuswa kuluhlu oluvumelekileyo nokuba zikhona kulo.
settings_page.never_help: Ezi zaliwa nokuba kumiselwe ntoni. Isikhangeli okanye iseva inokuzenza, kwaye ithala lamaxwebhu alinasizathu sokwamkela enye.
settings_page.categories_hint: Oko ixwebhu liyiyo, ngokwahlukileyo kokuba lifayilwe phi. Amacandelo akhelweyo anokuthiywa kwakhona okanye acinywe kodwa angasuswa — iingxelo nemithetho yokugcina zibhekisa kuwo.
settings_page.category_protected: Amacandelo akhelweyo angenakususwa. Yicime endaweni yoko.
settings_page.category_in_use: Isetyenziswa ngamaxwebhu angama-{n}. Yicime endaweni yoko.
settings_page.expiry_hint: Lumkisa abantu phambi kokuba ixwebhu liphele. Ukutshayela kusebenza qho kusasa kwaye kuthumela isikhumbuzo ngasinye kanye.
settings_page.expiry_days_hint: Cofa u-enter emva kwenani ngalinye. U-0 uthetha ngomhla wokuphela ngokwawo.
settings_page.expiry_roles_hint: Umnini wexwebhu uhlala eyaziswa. Iindima, kungekhona amagama, ukuze isikhumbuzo silandele nabani na ophethe umsebenzi.
settings_page.retention_hint: Isikhathi amadokhumenti akulesi sigaba agcinwa ngaso. Shiya isikhathi singenalutho uma kungekho uhlelo — akukho okubhujiswa ngokuzenzakalela.
settings_page.retention_note_hint: Kuboniswa eceleni kolayini wokulahla, ukuze umbuyekezi abone ukuthi umthetho umelani.
settings_page.sharing_warning: Uma kuvuliwe, noma ubani onesixhumanisi angavula lelo dokhumenti ngaphandle kokungena. Isixhumanisi ngasinye siyaphelelwa yisikhathi, singahoxiswa, futhi siyaqoshwa.
settings_page.sharing_enabled: Vumela amadokhumenti ukuthi abelwane ngaphandle kwenhlangano
settings_page.share_max_days_hint: Umkhawulo waso sonke isixhumanisi. Ocela okude uthola lokhu.
settings_page.ai_warning: Uma kuvuliwe, okuqukethwe kwedokhumenti kuthunyelwa kumhlinzeki we-AI leli pulatifomu elihlelwe ngaye, futhi kubalwa esabelweni senyanga senkampani.
settings_page.ai_include_confidential_hint: Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalela. Yiwo amadokhumenti inhlangano engathandi ukuwanikeza insizakalo yangaphandle.
settings_page.watermark_default: Faka uphawu lwamanzi kumakhophi abelwana ngokuzenzakalela
settings_page.watermark_default_hint: Ukwabelana ngakunye kusengashintshwa. Uphawu lwamanzi lwenza ikhophi evuzile ilandeleke; alukuvimbeli.
settings_page.auto_delete_warning: Uma kuvuliwe, amadokhumenti avunywe umbuyekezi ukuthi alahlwe ayasuswa ngaphandle kokuqinisekiswa futhi. Ukususa lapha kuyabuyiseka — ukubhujiswa unomphela kuhlala kungumsebenzi womuntu.
settings_page.disposal_grace_days_hint: Isikhathi imvume elinda ngaso ngaphambi kokusetshenzwa, ukuze iphutha libanjwe.
settings_page.automation_hint: Lokho lesi sigaba esikwenzayo ngokwaso uma izinsuku ezingenhla sezidlulile.
settings_page.auto_delete_hint: Kudinga nesilungiselelo senkampani yonke. Amadokhumenti abanjwe ngokomthetho awathintwa neze.
settings_page.categories_delete_consequence: Only possible while nothing is filed under it.
settings_page.category_fields_hint: Oko olu hlobo lwexwebhu lukuthwalayo ngaphandle kwesiqhelo. Isivumelwano sifuna elinye iqela; irisithi ayifuni nto.
settings_page.category_workflow_hint: Ukuze "imigaqo-nkqubo iya kwezomthetho" ibe yinto yemigaqo-nkqubo endaweni yokukhunjulwa kulo lonke ulayisho.
settings_page.numbering_next_hint: Yibeke ukuze uqhube usuka kwispredishithi endaweni yokuqala kwakhona ku-1.
settings_page.numbering_pattern_hint: Iindawo: {YYYY} {YY} {MM} kunye ne-#### yolandelelwano. Yishiye ingenanto ukuze usebenzise inkqubo yenkampani.
settings_page.watermark_previews_hint: Ukufunda kuphela kuthintela ukukhuphela kwaye akwenzi nto ngomfanekiso weskrini. Uphawu oluchaza ukuba ngubani obejongile lolo lodwa olwenzayo.
settings_page.downloads_days_hint: Ixesha umntu agcina ngalo ikopi avunyelweyo.
settings_page.lock_hours_hint: Emva koku uxwebhu luyazivula, ukuze kungabikho othintelwe ngumntu osekhefini.
