document_management.recycle_subtitle: Amadokhumenti asusiwe ahlala lapha izinsuku ezingu-{days} futhi angabuyiselwa noma nini
document_management.recycle_purge_warning: Lokhu kubhubhisa idokhumenti nazo zonke izinguqulo zalo. Irekhodi lokuthi lalikhona futhi labhujiswa ligcinwa, kodwa ifayela ngeke libuyiseleke.
document_management.recycle_empty_counts: Amadokhumenti angu-{purgeable} asedlulile isikhathi sawo. Angu-{held} abanjwe ngokomthetho ngeke athintwe.
document_management.recycle_empty_everything_hint: Kuvaliwe ngokuzenzakalela. Ukuthulula ngokujwayelekile kusho konke okudlulile isikhathi, hhayi lokho umuntu akususe namuhla ekuseni.
document_management.groups_subtitle: Nika ukufinyelela iqembu labantu kunohlu lwamagama
document_management.groups_expires_hint: Ngokuzikhethela. Uma liphela, konke ukufinyelela elikunikile kuphela nalo.
document_management.groups_folders_hint: Iqoqo elilodwa lezimvume kuwo wonke amafolda owakhethayo. Yilokho okwenza kube yisinqumo esisodwa.
document_management.groups_access_expires_hint: Ngokuzikhethela. Ukufinyelela okunosuku akudingi ukukhunjulwa bese kuhoxiswa.
document_management.downloads_read_only_hint: Olu xwebhu lunokufundwa apha kodwa alunakukhutshelwa.
document_management.downloads_read_only_folder: Le folda yeyokufunda kuphela, ngoko iikopi zoko kugcinwe kuyo aziphumi.
document_management.access_map_subtitle: Ngubani onokufikelela entweni, kutheni, kwaye yintoni ephelayo ngokwayo.
document_management.access_map_ending_hint: Injongo yofikelelo lwexeshana kukuba akukho mntu kufuneka alukhumbule. Kusekho umntu ekufuneka ekwazi ukulubona.
document_management.access_map_look_up: Kutheni lo mntu ebona oko akubonayo?
document_management.access_map_checked_out_hint: Kukho umntu osebenza kuwo. Akukho mnye onokulayisha inguqulelo entsha ade agqibe.
document_management.comments_none: Akukho nto ithethiweyo ngale nto okwangoku.
document_management.requests_what_hint: Yithi into, hayi ifayile — "Ikopi ye-ID eqinisekisiweyo" endaweni ye-"skena".
document_management.checklists_no_templates: Akukho zintlobo zamaphakethe zisetiweyo. Uhlobo lwephakethe luluhlu njengomthetho — "iphakethe lomqeshwa omtsha ngala maxwebhu asixhenxe".
document_management.checklists_no_folder: Akukho folda ikhethiweyo, ngoko akukho nto inokuzitikisha.
document_management.checklists_expects_anything: Akukho nto isetiweyo ukudibanisa — le itikishwa ngesandla
document_management.checklists_chase_hint: Yonke into esemi iba sisicelo, ngesenzo esinye. Ukucela nganye kukho apho eyokugqibela ilibaleka khona.
document_management.checklists_subject_hint: Umntu, umboneleli, ithenda — nantoni na eli phakethe elimalunga nayo.
document_management.checklists_folder_hint: Apho amaxwebhu ahlala khona. Izinto ziyazitikisha njengoko amaxwebhu adibanayo egcinwa apha.
document_management.checklists_template_hint: Nika iphakethe igama, hayi ityala — "Iphakethe lomqeshwa omtsha", hayi "uThandi".
document_management.checklists_category_hint: Into enodidi iyazitikisha xa uxwebhu lwaloo didi lugcinwa kwifolda. Engenalo lunokutikishwa ngesandla kuphela.
document_management.superseded_banner: Olu asilulo uxwebhu olusebenzayo. Lwatshintshwa nge-{date}.
document_management.share_require_code_hint: Igama lokugqitha lihamba kwi-imeyile efanayo nekhonkco. Ikhowudi ethunyelwe kwidilesi ingqina ukuba lowo uyivulayo unebhokisi leposi.
document_management.share_require_code_needs_email: Yongeza idilesi ye-imeyile yomamkeli ukuze usebenzise oku.
document_management.shared_code_hint: Singathumela ikhowudi ku-{email} ukuqinisekisa ukuba nguwe.
document_management.shared_code_sent_hint: Ikhowudi ithunyelwe ku-{email}. Ihlala imizuzu elishumi elinesihlanu.
document_management.quotas_subtitle: Ngaphantsi kweyenkampani. Isebe elinye eligcwalisa lonke uvumelo limisa wonke umntu, yonke indawo.
document_management.quotas_none: Akukho mida ibekiweyo. Kusebenza kuphela uvumelo lwenkampani.
document_management.quotas_warn_hint: Ukwaliwa ngaphandle kwesilumkiso kufana nenkqubo eyaphukileyo.
document_management.access_map_refusals_hint: Ukwaliwa kunye likhonkco elidala. Ukwaliwa okulithoba ngeveki yincoko.
document_management.access_map_downloads_hint: Ukukhuphela lixesha uxwebhu olungasalawulwa yile nkqubo.
document_management.access_map_heavily_granted_hint: Mhlawumbi bayakufuna, okanye kwaqokelelwa isikhethiwe ngasinye. Inani lelona ndlela yokwazi.
document_management.shortcuts_hint: Indawo yesibini yokufumana olu xwebhu — ayisiyo ikopi yesibini.
document_management.shortcuts_dialog_hint: Ihlala iluxwebhu olunye. Inguqulelo entsha ivela kuzo zonke iindawo egcinwe kuzo, kwaye iimvume zayo azitshintshi.
document_management.access_ask_hint: Khetha yonke into oyifunayo ngaxeshanye. Ukucela nganye kukho apho eyokugqibela ilibaleka khona.
document_management.access_ask_reason_hint: Lowo uphendulayo kufuneka agqibe into, kwaye "akukho sizathu sinikiweyo" iphantse ibe kukwaliwa.
document_management.checklists_people_hint: Khetha omnye okanye abaninzi — kuqaliswa iphakethe kumntu ngamnye.
document_management.perm_manage_explainer: Somebody who administers a folder decides who else may use it. They cannot move it, delete it, or reach any other folder.
document_management.folder_permissions_subtitle: A group survives somebody joining or leaving. A list of names has to be revisited every time either happens.
document_management.folder_permissions_none: Nobody has been given this folder. Whether it is open depends on the folder's own kind.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_body: This replaces every rule on {name} with what is on screen.
document_management.folder_permissions_save_consequence: Anybody whose row you removed loses access as soon as this is saved.
document_management.groups_delete_consequence: Everyone in it loses every folder the group opened. The folders and their documents are untouched.
document_management.groups_remove_member_title: Take this person out of the group?
document_management.groups_remove_member_consequence: They lose every folder this group opens, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_title: Take this folder off the group?
document_management.groups_revoke_folder_consequence: Everyone in the group loses it, unless something else gives it to them.
document_management.documents_delete_consequence: It goes to the recycle bin and can be restored until the bin is emptied.
document_management.templates_delete_consequence: Documents already generated from it are not affected.
document_management.quotas_remove_consequence: Storage there becomes unlimited again, up to the company's own allowance.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_body: {who} would no longer see this document.
document_management.share_revoke_internal_consequence: Unless they can reach it another way — through a folder, a role or a group.
document_management.share_revoke_link_consequence: It stops working immediately, including for anybody it was forwarded to.
document_management.access_map_revoke_body: {who} would lose it now rather than when it was due to end.
document_management.access_map_revoke_consequence: It cannot be undone from here — it would have to be granted again.
document_management.archive_contents_help: Vula ifayile enye ngaphandle kokukhuphela lonke ugcino.
document_management.archive_unreadable: Olu gcino alukwazanga ukuvulwa. Lusenokuba lonakele okanye lukhuselwe ngephasiwedi.
document_management.preview_failed: Le fayile ayikwazanga ukuboniswa apha. Yikhuphele endaweni yoko.

employee_reputation_dashboard.title: Ukubekwa Esweni Kodumo Nomngcipheko Womsebenzi
employee_reputation_dashboard.subtitle: Ukubekwa esweni okugunyazisiweyo kolwazi LWASESIDLANGALALENI kwiindaba, inkundla, umlawuli, izohlwayo, ezentlalo nemithombo yobungcali — kuhlolwa ngumntu.
employee_reputation_dashboard.disclaimer_body: Le modyuli ivelisa ulwazi LWASESIDLANGALALENI olunokubaluleka kunye nomxholo, ukuzithemba nomthombo ukuze umntu aluhlole. Ayenzi kwaye ayincomi iziphumo zokuqesha, ukugxotha okanye zengqeqesho. Ukungqamana kwegama asiyompazamo yesazisi. Sebenzisa kuphela ngemvume nangokungqinelana nomthetho wabucala nowengqesho.
employee_reputation_dashboard.by_domain_hint: Iimpawu zoluntu zihlanganiswe ngendawo. Iindawo ezijolise emngciphekweni zezokuhlolwa kuphela, kungekhona izigqibo.

employee_reputation_settings.title: Useto lokubekwa esweni kodumo nomngcipheko
employee_reputation_settings.subtitle: Cwangcisa ukubekwa esweni okugunyazisiweyo olusebenzisa ulwazi lwasesidlangalaleni kuphela. Konke okufunyanisiweyo kuhlolwa ngumntu.
employee_reputation_settings.compliance_body: Vula ukubekwa esweni kuphela apho ugunyazisiwe kwaye kuhambelana nomthetho wabucala nowengqesho. Kubekwa esweni ulwazi LWASESIDLANGALALENI kuphela — hayi ii-akhawunti zabucala. Okufunyanisiweyo kuyacaciseka, kunamanqaku okuzithemba nomthombo, kuhlonipha ithuba lokugcina elingezantsi, kulawulwa ukufikelela kwaye kuphicothwa ngokupheleleyo, kwaye akuze kusetyenziselwe izigqibo zengqesho ezizenzekelayo.
employee_reputation_settings.consent_required: Funa imvume / ugunyaziso lomsebenzi phambi kokubekwa esweni
employee_reputation_settings.consent_hint: Kubekwa esweni ulwazi lwasesidlangalaleni kuphela — hayi ii-akhawunti zabucala. Uhlolo lomntu luyafuneka phambi kwaso nasiphi na isenzo.
employee_reputation_settings.negative_spike: Lumkisa ngemvakalelo embi ku- okanye ngaphantsi kwa-
employee_reputation_settings.auto_reports: Velisa ngokuzenzekelayo iingxelo zophando lwe-AI (zokuhlolwa ngumntu) ngezilumkiso ezinzulu

recruitment_screening_show.title: Ukucwengwa kwabaviwa nge-AI
recruitment_screening_show.disclaimer_body: Ezi zalathiso ziveliswe yi-AI zilulwazi lokunceda isigqibo kuphela kwaye azimele zikhokele ukuqesha okanye ukwala okuzenzekelayo. Ukungqamana kwegama asiyompazamo yesazisi. Hlola ubungqina ngokwakho unike umviwa ithuba lokunika umxholo phambi kokugqiba.
recruitment_screening_show.confirm_rescreen: Phinda ucwengo lwe-AI kulo mviwa? Oku kuhlalutya ubukho babo bobungcali basesidlangalaleni kokuhlolwa ngumntu kuphela.
recruitment_screening_show.empty_body: Akukho cwengo lwe-AI lwenziweyo kulo mviwa. Qhuba olunye ukuze kuvele izalathiso zobungcali zasesidlangalaleni zokuhlolwa.
recruitment_screening_show.empty_no_consent: Lo mviwa akanikanga mvume yokusetyenzwa kwe-AI, ngoko ucwengo alunakwenziwa.
recruitment_screening_show.status_skipped_no_consent: Ucwengo lutsityhiwe kuba umviwa akanikanga mvume yokusetyenzwa kwe-AI.
recruitment_screening_show.questions_hint: Imibuzo engathathi cala evumela umviwa ukuba anike owakhe umxholo.
recruitment_screening_show.misidentification_caveat: Ukungachaneki okunokwenzeka: ezinye izinto ezifunyanisiweyo zisenokuba zezomnye umntu onegama elifanayo. Qinisekisa isazisi phambi kokuthembela koku kufunyanisiweyo.

bi.title: Ukuthumela kwi-Power BI nakwindawo yokugcina
bi.subtitle: Thumela idatha yakho kwindawo yakho yokugcina ye-Databricks, ukuze i-Power BI iyifunde apho.
bi.no_company: Akukho nkampani ikhethiweyo, ngoko akukho nto yokuqhagamshela.
bi.token_notice: Ithokheni yakho yokufikelela ifihliwe phambi kokuba igcinwe kwaye ayibuyiselwa kweli phepha.
bi.connection_sub: Khuphela ezi kwiinkcukacha zoqhagamshelo lwendawo yakho yokugcina ye-SQL.
bi.host_hint: Igama leseva elivela kwindawo yakho yokugcina ye-SQL, ngaphandle kwe-https://
bi.http_path_hint: Indlela yendawo yokugcina ye-SQL — sisazisi sasekugqibeleni esisisebenzisayo
bi.token_hint: Ithokheni yokufikelela ye-Databricks enamalungelo okudala iitheyibhile
bi.token_replace_hint: Yishiye ingenanto ukugcina ithokheni esele igciniwe
bi.remove_confirm: Oku kucima ithokheni egciniweyo. Akukho nto sele ikwindawo yakho yokugcina echukunyiswayo.
bi.datasets_sub: Nganye iba yitheyibhile enye kwindawo yakho yokugcina.
bi.replace_notice: Ukuthumela ngakunye kubuyisela itheyibhile, ngoko ukukwenza kabini akuphindi kabini imiqolo yakho.

contracts_settings.description: Iintlobo, iindidi neetemplate apho yonke ikhontrakthi ifayilwa phantsi kwazo.
contracts_settings.confirm_message: {name} iza kususwa. Iikhontrakthi esele zifayilwe phantsi kwayo zigcina irekhodi lazo lalonto.

types.help: Luhlobo luni lwesivumelwano — uqeshiso, isivumelwano senkonzo, isivumelwano sokugcina imfihlo. Ifom yekhontrakthi inika ezi.
types.empty: Akukho hlobo lwekhontrakthi okwangoku. Yongeza olunye lube lufumaneka kwifom yekhontrakthi.

categories.help: Indlela iikhontrakthi zihlanganiswa ngayo kwiingxelo — ngecandelo, ngeziko leendleko, nangayiphi indlela ozifayila ngayo.

templates.help: Amagama aqhelekileyo apho ikhontrakthi entsha inokuqala, ukuze kungabikho mntu obhala izigaba ezifanayo kabini.

form.name: Igama
form.content_hint: Amagama ikhontrakthi eqala ngawo. Angahlelwa kwikhontrakthi ngokwayo.

survey_360_results.title: Iziphumo ze-360°
survey_360_results.explainer: Umbuzo ngamnye uboniswa ngokobudlelwane, kuba umndilili wabo bonke ufihla kanye into i-360 ekhoyo ngenxa yayo — apho umphathi anika umntu amanqaku aphezulu kodwa abo basebenza phantsi kwakhe bengamniki.
survey_360_results.question: Umbuzo
survey_360_results.empty_body: Iziphumo zibonakala apha xa umvavanyi engenisa. Okunikezwe okusalindile akubalwa.

whistleblower_case_log.empty: Akukho nto ibhaliweyo ngeli tyala okwangoku.

disposition_hint.CONDITIONAL_ACCEPT: Ibuyela kwisitokhwe nangona ingaphumelelanga; chaza isizathu.
disposition_hint.RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER: Ibekwe ecaleni njengeyaliweyo ukuze ibuyiselwe kumhlinzeki.
disposition_hint.REWORK: Ihlala ibanjiwe kwaye iphinda ihlolwe emva kokulungiswa.

losses.title: Ilahleko
losses.subtitle: Ukucinywa okuqinisekisiweyo nelahleko ekrokrelwayo azize zidityaniswe.
losses.confirmed_hint: Ukucinywa okuvunyiweyo nesitokhwe esilahlwe ngenxa yohlolo, iimbuyiselo nokurhoxiswa kweemveliso.
losses.suspected_hint: Ayikabi yilahleko: ilinde imvume, uphononongo lobalo okanye ukubala kwakhona.
losses.claims_hint: Amabango avulwa kwilahleko ethunyelweyo kwiscreen sohlengahlengiso.

loss_risk.HIGH: Liphezulu: ilahleko ihlala ifuna umntu wesibini

recalls.title: Ukurhoxiswa kweemveliso
recalls.subtitle: Ukurhoxiswa kufumana yonke iyunithi echaphazelekayo, kuyibambe, kuze kubhale okwenziweyo de kuvalwe.
recalls.close_hint: Ukurhoxiswa kuvalwa kuphela xa kungekho nto ibanjiweyo phantsi kwako engekagqitywa.
recalls.no_lots: Akukho bhetshi: imveliso yonke iyarhoxiswa, kwaye imeko yayo iyithintela ukuba ishukume.

recall_scope_hint.LOT: Ibhetshi nayo yonke into eyasetyenziswa kuyo.
recall_scope_hint.SERIALS: Yonke inombolo yesiriyeli phakathi kwezi zimbini, kubandakanya zona.
recall_scope_hint.ITEM: Yonke ibhetshi yemveliso; imveliso ivaliwe de kuvalwe ukurhoxiswa.

batches.title: Iibhetshi neenombolo zesiriyeli
batches.subtitle: Yintoni ibhetshi nganye, ikuphi iyunithi nganye yayo, nayo yonke into eyenzekileyo kuyo.

expiry.title: Umngcipheko wokuphelelwa
expiry.subtitle: Iibhetshi ngomhla wokuphelelwa, imfuno elindelekileyo phambi koko, nexabiso eliza kulahleka mhlawumbi.
expiry.method: Ukusetyenziswa okulindelekileyo kungumyinge wemihla ngemihla wokukhutshwa nokuthunyelwa kweentsuku ezingama-90 ezidlulileyo, kusetyenziswa kuqala kwezo ziphelelwa kuqala. Iimveliso ezingenambali ziboniswa njengezingaziwayo, hayi njengezingenamngcipheko.

accounting.title: Ubalo-mali lwendawo yokugcina
accounting.subtitle: Isiganeko ngasinye sesitokhwe sinomnini omnye nendlela enye yokuphathwa, evunywe ngabezemali; ukulungelelanisa kufumana okungavumelaniyo.
accounting.no_issues: Akukho nto ingavumelaniyo. Ukulungelelanisa kwenziwa rhoqo ebusuku nangalo naliphi na ixesha ucela ngalo.
accounting.rules_hint: Iziganeko ezithunyelwa yenye imodyuli ziyaboniswa ukuze kungabikho nto ithunyelwa kabini. Iindlela ezintsha zokuphatha zilinda imvume phambi kokuba kuthunyelwe nantoni na.
accounting.landed_hint: Yabela intlawulo yokuthutha, irhafu yempahla nezinye iindleko kwiimpahla ezaziziswe zizo. Okusele kuthengisiwe kuthatha isabelo sako kwiindleko zentengiso.
accounting.reval_hint: Ukuxabisa kwakhona kutshintsha ixabiso lesitokhwe esikhoyo. Umntu wesibini uyakuvuma, kwaye kuthunyelwa kanye.
accounting.grn_hint: Okanye uyishiye ingenanto uze udwelise izinto.

costs.title: Iindleko zesitokhwe
costs.subtitle: Ixabiso nendleko yesitokhwe, nalapho ixabiso libambekileyo okanye livuza khona. Uqikelelo luphawulwe njengoqikelelo.

protection.title: Ukukhusela inzuzo
protection.subtitle: Izixhobo zokubona ziphakamisa izikhokelo; abaphandi baziqinisekisa okanye bazichithe ngobungqina; amanyathelo okulungisa ayalinganiswa.
protection.lead_not_proof: Into efunyenweyo sisikhokelo sophando, ayibobungqina bobusela okanye bokuziphatha kakubi. Okufunyenweyo kuchaza inkqubo, into okanye indawo, hayi umntu.
protection.not_summed: Inani ngalinye livela kumthombo walo kwaye alize lidityaniswe nelinye, ngoko isiganeko esinye asize sibalwe kabini.
protection.rule_then: Umthetho xa kuphakanyiswa: umda {threshold}, ubuncinci {count}, kwiintsuku ezingu-{days}
protection.rules_hint: Into nganye efunyenweyo igcina umthetho njengoko wawunjalo xa yaphakanyiswa, ngoko ukutshintsha umda akubhali kwakhona nto.

forecast.title: Uqikelelo lwemfuno
forecast.subtitle: Kusuka koko kuphume ngokwenene kwindawo yokugcina. Imbali encinci kakhulu ayiniki nani endaweni yokuqashela.
forecast.none: Akukabikho qikelelo. Qhuba olunye ukuze ubone imfuno ngokwento.
forecast.one_off: {period}: {was} iphathwe njengeyenzeke kanye; kusetyenziswe {used} endaweni yayo.
forecast.reason_hint: Intengiso ekhethekileyo, ikhasimende elilahlekileyo, i-oda eyaziwayo -- ihlala nenani.

buying.title: Iingcebiso zokuthenga
buying.subtitle: Ii-oda ezicetyiswayo ngokwemfuno eqikelelweyo, ixesha lokulinda, isitokhwe sokhuseleko noko sele kusiza.
buying.approvals: Iingcebiso ziba sisicelo sokuthenga esiyisayila. Iimvume zokuthenga, uhlahlo-lwabiwo-mali nolawulo lwabahlinzeki zisebenza njengakwesinye isicelo.
buying.compare_hint: Amaxabiso aguqulelwe kwi-{uom} enye; iindleko zokufika zongezwe apho zithunyelwe khona. Esona sitshiphu ukufika apha kuqala.
buying.no_suppliers: Akukho kuthenga okanye miqathango ibhaliweyo yale nto.

excess.title: Isitokhwe esigqithileyo nesiphelelwe lixesha
excess.subtitle: Imida yeyakho; amaxabiso akwiindleko. Inyathelo ngalinye elicetyiswayo lidlula kwimvume yalo.
excess.none: Akukho nto icothayo, engashukumiyo okanye ephelelwe lixesha ngokwale mida.
excess.line: {qty} {uom} igciniwe, ayishukumanga iintsuku ezingu-{days}; {excess} ngaphezu kwemfuno ({value})

work.board_subtitle: Ifundwa kwiirisithi, ukubekwa endaweni, ukuzaliswa kwakhona, amaza, ii-oda nobalo olungumnini womsebenzi.
work.labour_subtitle: Iiyure zomsebenzi ngokuchasene nabantu abakwirosta abanesakhono ngasinye, ngokwamaxesha emisebenzi alinganisiweyo okanye amiselweyo.
work.travel: Ukuhamba i-oda nganye yodwa kugubungela iindawo ezingu-{now}; njengoko kucetyiswa, {advised} ({pct}% ngaphantsi).
work.slotting_subtitle: Izindululo zisondeza iimveliso ezithathwa kakhulu ekuqaleni kwendlela yokuthatha. Ukushukuma okungaphezu kwe-{n} kufuneka kulingiswe phambi kwemvume.
work.sim_result: Uhambo oluqhelekileyo nge-oda: {now} m ngoku, {then} m emva ({pct}% mfutshane).
work.sim_range: Emva kotshintsho, i-80% yee-oda ihamba phakathi kwe-{lo} ne-{hi} m.
work.fairness: Akukho kulandelelaniswa kwabantu apha: ubunzima bomsebenzi, izixhobo, ukhuseleko nomgangatho wedatha ziyahluka, kwaye amanani angazihoyiyo awanabulungisa.
work.sim_subtitle: Nganye iqhutywa amakhulu amaxesha kusuka kwimbali yale ndawo yokugcina ize ibonise uluhlu olunokwenzeka, kunye neengcinga zayo nembewu.
work.repl_result: {item}: {chance}% ithuba lokuphelelwa ubuncinci kanye; iintsuku ingekho {days}; isitokhwe esiqhelekileyo {stock}; ii-oda ezenziweyo {orders}.

assistant.title: Umncedisi wendawo yokugcina
assistant.subtitle: Iimpendulo zibalwa kwiirekhodi zenkampani yakho, zinqunyelwe koko unokukubona. I-AI izibhala ngamagama kuphela kwaye ayinakongeza nani.
assistant.ask: Buza nge-oda, isitokhwe, ukuphelelwa, abahlinzeki, umahluko okanye ilahleko
assistant.quality_subtitle: Kukangaphi iimpendulo zichanekile kwaye ziluncedo, izilumkiso zobuxoki nezingabonwanga, isantya neendleko.

floor.title: Umgangatho
floor.offline_scope: Ukuthatha, ukubala nokubeka endaweni kuyasebenza ngaphandle komqondiso. Yimisebenzi yakho kuphela egcinwa kwesi sixhobo, ifihliwe, kwaye ayizize igcine iibhalansi zesitokhwe.
floor.recorded_offline: Kugcinwe kwesi sixhobo; kuza kuthunyelwa xa umqondiso ubuya.
floor.camera_denied: Ikhamera ayivunyelwanga. Yivumele kwibhrawuza, okanye uchwetheze ikhowudi.
floor.conflicts_subtitle: Umsebenzi obhalwe ngaphandle komqondiso ongasalinganiyo xa ufika. Wusebenzise njengoko izinto zinjalo ngoku, okanye uwulahle.

labels_setup.title: Iileyibhile neeprinta
labels_setup.subtitle: Oko kuboniswa yileyibhile nganye, ubungakanani bayo nebhakhowudi, neeprinta zeeleyibhile kuthungelwano lwendawo yokugcina.
labels_setup.private_only: Iiprinta zifikelelwa kuthungelwano lwabucala lwendawo yokugcina kuphela.
labels_setup.browser_note: Xa ishicilelwa kwibhrawuza, ixabiso yikhowudi ye-QR; iiprinta zeeleyibhile zishicilela uhlobo lwebhakhowudi olumiselwe yitemplate.

production.title: Izinto zemveliso
production.subtitle: Amacandelo afunwa yi-oda yemveliso nganye, ngokuchasene noko kugciniweyo nokukhululekileyo. Ukusetyenziswa okwahluke ngaphezu kwe-{pct}% kuluhlu lwezinto (BOM) kuyaphawulwa.
production.none: Akukho ii-oda zemveliso ezivunyiweyo okanye eziqhubekayo.

carriers.title: Abathwali
carriers.subtitle: Umthwali ngamnye usebenza ngomqhubi. Abathwali abenziwa ngesandla bathatha amazinga abo kwikhadi elilapha; ukulandelela nobungqina bokuhanjiswa kubhalwa ngabantu.
carriers.none: Akukabikho bathwali. Yongeza omnye ukuze ufumane amaxabiso uze ubhukishe ukuthunyelwa.
carriers.name: Igama
carriers.tracking_url_hint: Sebenzisa {'{'}tracking{'}'} apho kungena khona inombolo yokulandelela.

events.title: Iziganeko nee-webhook
events.subtitle: Iirisithi, ukushukuma, ukugcinwa, ukuthunyelwa, iimbuyiselo nokungaqhelekanga, kupapashwe kwi-API feed nakwizixhobo ezibhalisileyo.
events.secret_once: Kopa le mfihlo yokusayina ngoku. Ayizukuboniswa kwakhona:
events.api_text: Iinkqubo zifunda i-feed yeziganeko zize zibize i-API ngethokheni yomsebenzisi wale nkampani. Isivumelwano esingezantsi sibhala zonke ii-endpoint, imida yesantya ne-idempotency.
events.subject: Irekhodi
events.only_warehouses_hint: Shiya kungenanto kuzo zonke iindawo zokugcina.

systems.title: Iinkqubo ezidityanisiweyo
systems.subtitle: Iinkqubo ze-ERP nezorhwebo, ngonxibelelwano olufanayo, ukudibanisa, ukuzama kwakhona nomgca weempazamo osetyenziswa yiManufacturing.
systems.none: Akukho nkqubo ye-ERP okanye yorhwebo idityanisiweyo.
systems.messages_in: Imiyalezo engenayo: WMS_ORDER (i-oda emele izalisekiswe) kunye ne-WMS_STOCK_LEVELS (isitokhwe sabo, silungelelaniswe neleja).
systems.validation_hint: Uhlelo nelayisensi yekhasimende, nokuba le ndlela yofikelelo ivumelekile (ubuncinci boonobumba abangama-20).
systems.no_mappings: Akukho nto idityanisiweyo. Ngaphandle kokudibanisa, ii-SKU neekhowudi zeendawo zokugcina zithelekiswa njengoko zinjalo.
systems.add_hint: Iinkcukacha zokungena nedilesi zimiselwa kunxibelelwano kwiManufacturing; esi screen siphatha oko kutshintshiselwana yindawo yokugcina.

standards.title: Ukudibanisa i-GS1 ne-EPCIS
standards.subtitle: Ukushukuma, imveliso nokupakisha kuchazwe njengeziganeko ze-EPCIS 2.0 ezinezichongi ze-GS1, ukuze kutshintshiselwane namaqabane orhwebo.
standards.no_gaps: Yonke imveliso nendawo yokugcina kweli xesha inesitshixo sayo se-GS1.

inventory.title: Ideshibhodi yesitokhwe
inventory.subtitle: Isitokhwe kwiindawo zokugcina eziqhutywa yimodyuli, ngokwemeko, indawo yokugcina, imveliso, ubudala nokuphelelwa.

suppliers.title: Ideshibhodi yabahlinzeki
suppliers.subtitle: Indlela abahlinzeki abahambisa ngayo, okuseemva kwexesha, okuhlala kungahambi kakuhle nokufuna ukuodolwa.

protection.title: Ideshibhodi yokukhusela inzuzo
protection.subtitle: Oko kunokulahleka, oko kulahlekileyo, ixesha elithathwa luphando nokuba amanyathelo asebenzile na.

executive.title: Ideshibhodi yabaphathi abaphezulu
executive.subtitle: Oko kuthethwa yindawo yokugcina ngemali: isitokhwe esigciniweyo, esigqithileyo, ilahleko, inkonzo nomngcipheko.

insights.no_values: Amaxabiso aboniswa kubantu abanemvume yobalo-mali lwendawo yokugcina.
insights.stockout_top: Apho isitokhwe siphelayo phambi kohanjiso olulandelayo

reports.title: Iingxelo nokukhupha
reports.subtitle: Konke okukhutshwayo kugcina izihluzi zako nexesha lokwenziwa. Okukhutshwayo okungaphezu kwemigca engu-{n} kwakhiwa ngasemva kwaye uyaziswa.
reports.sensitive: Oku kukhutshwayo kuquka amaxabiso esitokhwe okanye idatha yophando; ukukhuphela kuyabhalwa.

alerts.title: Izilumkiso
alerts.subtitle: Ingxaki enye engasonjululwanga iyabalwa, ayiphindwa; iyakhunjuzwa emva kwexesha lokuthula kwaye inyuselwe ukuba ihlala ingasonjululwanga.
alerts.quiet_hint: Isilumkiso esinye esingasonjululwanga asiphindwa kumntu ngeli xesha.

threshold.days_short: Iintsuku ezingaphantsi kwexesha lokulinda phambi kokuxelela

approvals.title: Iimvume
approvals.subtitle: Izicelo zidlula kumanqanaba afunwa lixabiso lazo, linye ligqitywa ngumntu owahlukileyo, ingaze ibe ngumceli.
approvals.levels_hint: Inqanaba 1 lihlala lisebenza; inqanaba ngalinye elongezelelweyo lisebenza ukusuka kwixabiso lalo. Izicelo esele zenziwe zigcina amanqanaba azo.

governance.title: Uphicotho nolawulo
governance.subtitle: Kwenzeke ntoni nokuba ngubani okwenzileyo, kugcinwe kwileja ebonisa nakuphi na ukuphazanyiswa; ukugqithisa kwexesha likaxakeka nokuba idatha igcinwa ixesha elingakanani.
governance.break_glass_text: Ikuvumela ukuba ugqibe izicelo zakho iiyure ezimbalwa xa kungekho mntu unokukwenza. Konke ukusetyenziswa kuyabhalwa, abaphathi baxelelwa kwangoko, kwaye omnye umntu kufuneka akuphonononge.
governance.retention_text: Ixesha indawo yokugcina egcina ngalo izinto. Iinkcukacha zobuqu zithathelwa indawo luphawu xa ixesha lazo liphelile; imbali yesitokhwe nezemali azichukunyiswa. Akukho nto inokumiselwa ngaphantsi kobuncinci bayo.
governance.roles_text: Iitemplate zokunikwa njengoko zinjalo okanye zikopishwe. Imida yemvume imiselwa phantsi kweeMvume; iindawo zokugcina umntu anokusebenza kuzo zimiselwa luluhlu lwabasebenzi lwendawo yokugcina nganye nomgaqo-nkqubo wayo othi “abasebenzi bayo kuphela”.

policies.title: Imigaqo-nkqubo ye-{code}
policies.subtitle: Jonga utshintsho phambi kokuba lusebenze, lugcine njengesayila, uze ulusebenzise. Uguqulelo ngalunye luyagcinwa kwaye lunokubuyiselwa; iintengiselwano ezithunyelweyo zigcina isiphumo somgaqo-nkqubo obusebenza xa zenzeka.
policies.no_history: Akukabikho nguqulelo; utshintsho lokuqala lubhala indawo yokuqala.

health.title: Impilo
health.subtitle: Nokuba oomatshini bendawo yokugcina bayasebenza na, nokuba oko kuboniswa kwiiscreen kuyavumelana na neleja yesitokhwe.
health.ledger_ok: Yonke ibhalansi, indawo nokugcinwa kuyavumelana neleja (iibhalansi zezinto nezindawo zokugcina ezingu-{n} zihloliwe).
health.ledger_bad: Umahluko ongu-{n} phakathi kweleja noko kuvela kuyo:

kpis.title: Ii-KPI zendawo yokugcina
kpis.subtitle: Inani ngalinye lichazwe ngokuchanekileyo -- yintoni ebalwayo, ngaphezu kwantoni, nento eshiyiweyo -- ukuze lingaphucuki ngokutshintsha idinomineyitha. Iinkcazelo zoguqulelo {v}.
kpis.no_baseline: Khetha inyanga yesiseko oza kulinganisa ngayo uphuculo. Qala ubhale inyanga, xa sele iphelile.
kpis.this_month: Le nyanga ({m}, ukuza kuthi ga ngoku)

layout.title: Uyilo lwendawo yokugcina
layout.subtitle: Iindawo zokugcina, iindawo ezingaphakathi kuzo, iilebheli nembali yotshintsho.

products.title: Iimveliso
products.subtitle: Uluhlu olusisiseko lweemveliso njengoko indawo yokugcina iludinga: iiyunithi, ukupakishwa, iibhakhowudi nemeko.

inventory.title: Uluhlu lwempahla neemveliso
inventory.subtitle: Yintoni ephi, ikweyiphi imeko, yintoni enokuthenjiswa, nendlela lonke inani elifike ngayo apho. Uluhlu olusisiseko lweemveliso njengoko indawo yokugcina iludinga: iiyunithi, ukupakishwa, iibhakhowudi nemeko.

inbound.title: Okungenayo nokuphumayo
inbound.subtitle: Okulindelekileyo, idayari yedokhi, ukwamkela, umahluko, ukubuyisa nokusebenza kwabahlinzeki. Ii-oda ezivela kuyo yonke imithombo, zabiwe, zithathwe, zipakishwe zathunyelwa ngokwemihla yazo yokugqibela.

floor.title: Umsebenzi womgangatho
floor.subtitle: Imigca abantu abasebenza kuyo ngeskena: ukubeka endaweni ngoku, emva koko ukuhambisa, ukuzalisa, ukuthatha nokupakisha.

outbound.title: Okuphumayo
outbound.subtitle: Ii-oda ezivela kuyo yonke imithombo, zabiwe, zithathwe, zipakishwe zathunyelwa ngokwemihla yazo yokugqibela.

insights.title: Ulwazi noyilo
insights.subtitle: Isitokhwe, abahlinzeki, ilahleko nemali, kunye neengxelo ezingemva kwalo lonke inani. Iindawo zokugcina, iindawo ezingaphakathi kuzo, iilebheli nembali yotshintsho.

warehouses.title: Iindawo zokugcina
warehouses.subtitle: Uhlobo, iiyure, ikhalenda, umthamo, imigaqo-nkqubo nabantu abasebenza apho.

locations.title: Iindawo
locations.subtitle: Imimandla, iindlela, iirakhi, iishelufu nemigqomo, kunye noko nganye ikugcinayo nokuba ivulekile na.

labels.title: Iilebheli zeendawo
labels.subtitle: Shicilela iilebheli ze-QR zemigqomo, iirakhi needokhi.

location_history.title: Imbali yeendawo
location_history.subtitle: Lonke utshintsho kwindawo yokugcina okanye kwindawo, kunye nokuba ngubani olwenzileyo nokuba kutheni.

items.title: Izinto
items.subtitle: Yonke into esesitokhweni kunye neeyunithi zayo, ukupakishwa, iibhakhowudi, iikhowudi nemeko yobomi bayo.

scan.title: Isivavanyi sokuskena
scan.subtitle: Skena okanye uchwetheze nayiphi na ibhakhowudi ukuze ubone ukuba ithetha yiphi into, isixa, iqela nomhla wokuphelelwa.

barcode_duplicates.title: Iibhakhowudi eziphindiweyo
barcode_duplicates.subtitle: Iibhakhowudi ezibhaliswe kwizinto ezingaphezu kwesinye, nokuba kutheni nganye yavunyelwa.

stock.title: Isitokhwe nokufumaneka
stock.subtitle: Esibonakalayo, esibanjiweyo, esisendleleni, esibekelwe bucala nesifumanekayo ukuthenjiswa, ngento nangendawo yokugcina.

movements.title: Imbali yesitokhwe
movements.subtitle: Yonke intshukumo kunye nesizathu sayo, uxwebhu lwayo, ngubani oyenzileyo nebhalansi eqhubekayo.

adjustments.title: Uhlengahlengiso
adjustments.subtitle: Izilungiso ezineekhowudi zezizathu; ezinomngcipheko zilinda umntu wesibini.

stock_states.title: Iimeko zesitokhwe
stock_states.subtitle: Oko imeko nganye ibalelwa kuko: esibonakalayo, esifumanekayo, ukufezekiswa noqingqo-xabiso.

reason_codes.title: Iikhowudi zezizathu
reason_codes.subtitle: Kutheni isitokhwe sitshintsha, nokuba zeziphi izizathu ezifuna imvume.

clients.title: Ufikelelo lwabaxhasi
clients.subtitle: Ngubani onokubona isitokhwe somxhasi ngamnye wenkampani yesithathu.

expected.title: Iirisithi ezilindelekileyo
expected.subtitle: Imigca evulekileyo yee-oda zokuthenga esazokufika, kunye nokudlulelwe lixesha.

receipts.title: Iirisithi
receipts.subtitle: Yonke inowuthi yeempahla ezifunyenweyo, umahluko wayo, uhlolo nokubekwa endaweni.

receive_without_order.title: Yamkela ngaphandle kwe-oda
receive_without_order.subtitle: Iimpahla ezifike zingenayo i-oda yokuthenga; zifakwa xa umntu ezivumile.

appointments.title: Amaxesha edokhi
appointments.subtitle: Amaxesha ohanjiso ngedokhi, ukufika, ukothula nezithuthi ezifike emva kwexesha.

supplier_returns.title: Ukubuyiselwa kubahlinzeki
supplier_returns.subtitle: Iimpahla ezibuyiswayo: imvume, ukuthunyelwa, ukwamkelwa nekhredithi.

scorecards.title: Ukusebenza kwabahlinzeki
scorecards.subtitle: Ngexesha, ukuchaneka, umonakalo, ukwaliwa, uhlolo, ixabiso nexesha lokuhanjiswa kwiirisithi zenyani.

putaway.title: Ukubeka endaweni
putaway.subtitle: Hambisa isitokhwe esifunyenweyo uye nako apho sihlala khona, ukhokelwa kwaye uqinisekiswe ngokuskena.

capacity.title: Umthamo
capacity.subtitle: Ukuzaliswa ngendawo yokugcina, imigqomo ekufutshane okanye ngaphezu kwemida yayo, nezinto ezingathathwa yimigqomo embalwa.

bin_move.title: Hambisa isitokhwe
bin_move.subtitle: Skena umgqomo, ukhethe into oza kuyihambisa, uskene apho iya khona.

transfers.title: Ukudlulisela
transfers.subtitle: Isitokhwe phakathi kweendawo zokugcina: kuvunyiwe, kuthathiwe, kusendleleni, kufunyenwe kwaye kungqinelanisiwe.

replenishment.title: Ukuzalisa kwakhona
replenishment.subtitle: Ukongezwa kweendawo zokuthatha neendawo zokugcina, ngokokubaluleka, neengcebiso zokuphinda u-ode zomthengi.

fulfilment_orders.title: Ii-oda
fulfilment_orders.subtitle: Ii-oda zentengiso, izicelo zezinto, ukukhutshwa kwangaphakathi nee-oda zewebhu okanye ze-API, kumgca omnye.

picking.title: Ukuthatha
picking.subtitle: Khulula umsebenzi wokuthatha ngokwesicwangciso uze uthathe, uskena nganye nganye, ngolandelelwano lokuhamba.

service_levels.title: Amanqanaba enkonzo
service_levels.subtitle: Amaxesha okuthatha, ukupakisha nokuthumela, izinga lokufika ngexesha, ukuchaneka nee-oda ezisemngciphekweni.

counts.title: Ukubala isitokhwe
counts.subtitle: Ukubala isitokhwe sonke nokubala ngemijikelo: cwangcisa, bala, phonononga kwaye ufake.

count_accuracy.title: Ukuchaneka kokubala
count_accuracy.subtitle: Kukangaphi iincwadi zihambelana neshelufu, nalapho zingahambelaniyo khona.

losses.title: Ilahleko
losses.subtitle: Ukucinywa okuqinisekisiweyo kugcinwe kwahlukile kwilahleko ekrokrelwayo, noko kufunyenweyo kwakhona.

recalls.title: Ukubuyiswa kweemveliso
recalls.subtitle: Fumana, ubambe kwaye uphendule ngayo yonke iyunithi echaphazelekayo, uxelele iikhasimende ezinayo.

quality_setup.title: Ulungiselelo lomgangatho
quality_setup.subtitle: Izicwangciso zohlolo zokugcina, ukubuyisa nokuthumela, kunye neekhowudi zeziphene.

customer_returns.title: Ukubuyisa kweekhasimende
customer_returns.subtitle: Gunyazisa, yamkela, hlola kwaye unike ikhredithi yeempahla ezibuyisiweyo.

inspections.title: Uhlolo
inspections.subtitle: Rekhoda iziphumo uze ugqibe ukuba kwenzeka ntoni kwisitokhwe esihloliweyo.

batches.title: Iibhetshi neenombolo zesiriyali
batches.subtitle: Yonke ibhetshi nenombolo yesiriyali: apho ikhona, imeko yayo nembali yayo yonke.

expiry.title: Umngcipheko wokuphelelwa
expiry.subtitle: Isitokhwe esiza kuphelelwa lixesha ngaphambi kokuba sisetyenziswe, nexabiso laso.

accounting.title: Ubalo-mali lwendawo yokugcina
accounting.subtitle: Indlela isiganeko ngasinye sesitokhwe esifika ngayo ezincwadini, nalapho iincwadi nesitokhwe zingavumelaniyo khona.

stock_costs.title: Iindleko zesitokhwe
stock_costs.subtitle: Ixabiso, iindleko zokugcina, okucinyiweyo, iindleko zokufika, umahluko wexabiso nesitokhwe esihamba kancinci.

protection.title: Ukukhusela inzuzo
protection.subtitle: Imikhondo yelahleko enokuthintelwa, ephandwe ngobungqina yaze yalinganiswa ngokunyanisekileyo.

forecast.title: Uqikelelo lwemfuno
forecast.subtitle: Uqikelelo ngendlela, ukuchaneka kwalo, nokutshintshwa ngabacwangcisi.

buying.title: Iingcebiso zokuthenga
buying.subtitle: Into ekufuneka i-odwe, ingakanani kwaye ivela kubani, kuboniswa yonke into esetyenzisiweyo.

excess.title: Okugqithisileyo nokuphelelwe lixesha
excess.subtitle: Isitokhwe esingahambiyo okanye esigcinwe ngaphezu kwemfuno, nento ekufuneka yenziwe ngaso.

task_board.title: Ibhodi yemisebenzi
task_board.subtitle: Wonke umsebenzi womgangatho kumgca omnye: okubalulekileyo, ngubani onawo, uza kuphela nini, ulinde ntoni.

labour.title: Abasebenzi necebo lokukhetha
labour.subtitle: Umthwalo womsebenzi uthelekiswa nabantu abanezakhono ezifanelekileyo, nendlela yokudibanisa ukukhetha kwanamhlanje.

slotting.title: Ukwabela iindawo
slotting.subtitle: Sondeza izinto ezihamba ngokukhawuleza, emva kokulingisa nemvume yomntu wesibini.

performance.title: Ukusebenza
performance.subtitle: Ukuchaneka, isixa esigqityiweyo, ixesha lomjikelo, ukwenziwa kwakhona nalapho umsebenzi uqokelelana khona.

simulations.title: Ukulingisa
simulations.subtitle: Zama utshintsho kubasebenzi, kwimfuno nakuzaliso ngaphambi kokuba uluphumeze.

assistant.title: Buza umncedisi
assistant.subtitle: Imibuzo iphendulwa ngeerekhodi zendawo yakho yokugcina, kunye nemithombo.

floor_screen.title: Isikrini somgangatho
floor_screen.subtitle: Khetha, bala uze ubeke endaweni ngeskena okanye ngefowuni, nokuba akukho sinyithi.

label_setup.title: Iilebhile neeprinta
label_setup.subtitle: Iitemplate zeelebhile zeemveliso, iibhini, iipalethi, iikhathoni nokuthunyelwa, kunye neeprinta zeelebhile.

production.title: Izixhobo zemveliso
production.subtitle: Oko kufunwa zii-odolo zemveliso, okunqongopheleyo, neempahla ezigqityiweyo ekufuneka zibekwe endaweni.

carriers.title: Abathwali
carriers.subtitle: Abathwali, iinkonzo zabo namakhadi amaxabiso, nento enokwenziwa ngumntu ngamnye.

events.title: Iziganeko nee-webhook
events.subtitle: Oko ezinye iinkqubo zikuva kwindawo yokugcina, nokuba kufikile na kuzo.

systems.title: Iinkqubo ezidibanisiweyo
systems.subtitle: Unxibelelwano lwe-ERP nolwezorhwebo: ukudibanisa, imiyalezo, iimpazamo nokuhambelanisa.

standards.title: Ukudibanisa i-GS1 ne-EPCIS
standards.subtitle: Ukulandeleka okuchazwe ngemigaqo ye-GS1, nezitshixo ezisengekhoyo.

inventory_dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi yoluhlu lwempahla
inventory_dashboard.subtitle: Isitokhwe ngemeko, indawo yokugcina nemveliso; ixabiso, ubudala, ukuphelelwa nokugcinelwa.

supplier_dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi yabahlinzeki
supplier_dashboard.subtitle: Ukusebenza kohanjiso, ii-oda ezigqithileyo, iingxaki eziphindaphindayo nento yokuthenga.

protection_dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi yokukhusela inzuzo
protection_dashboard.subtitle: Ilahleko enokubakho neqinisekisiweyo, ubudala bophando nento ezifezekiswe zizenzo.

executive_dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi yolawulo oluphezulu
executive_dashboard.subtitle: Ixabiso loluhlu lwempahla, okugqithisileyo, okucinyiweyo, inkonzo nomngcipheko wokuphela kwesitokhwe.

reports.title: Iingxelo nokukhupha
reports.subtitle: I-CSV, i-Excel ne-PDF, izihluzi nexesha zishicilelwe kuyo yonke ifayile.

approvals.title: Iimvume
approvals.subtitle: Izicelo ezikulindileyo, amanqanaba emvume ngexabiso, nokugunyazisa omnye xa abantu bengekho.

alerts.title: Izilumkiso
alerts.subtitle: Ngubani oxelelwa ngantoni, kangaphi, nokuba kufikile na kubo.

governance.title: Uphicotho nolawulo
governance.subtitle: Incwadi yophicotho ebonisa ukuphazanyiswa, ukutshitshiswa kwengxakeko, ukugcinwa kwerekhodi needempleyithi zeendima.

health.title: Impilo
health.subtitle: Nokuba umsebenzi ocwangcisiweyo, imigca, iziganeko nencwadi zisemgangathweni na.

kpis.title: Ii-KPI
kpis.subtitle: Ukuchaneka, isantya, ilahleko nomngcipheko uthelekiswa nenyanga yakho esisiseko, kunye nayo yonke inkcazelo.

dashboard.title: Ideshibhodi yendawo yokugcina
dashboard.subtitle: Oko indawo nganye yokugcina ikuphetheyo nento efuna ingqwalasela emgangathweni.
dashboard.no_bins: Iindawo zokugcina ezi-{n} azikabi nazibhini, ngoko isitokhwe apho asinakubekwa endaweni okanye sikhethwe ngendawo.
dashboard.unbinned: Iiyunithi ezi-{qty} zisezincwadini kodwa azinabhini. Zamkelwa ngaphambi kokuba iindawo zibekho okanye ngaphandle kwendawo; zifake ezibhinini ukuze zifumaneke.

critical.findings: Iziphumo zelahleko ezingxamisekileyo okanye ezibaluleke kakhulu ezivulekileyo: {n}
critical.integration_failures: Imiyalezo eya okanye evela kwinkqubo edibanisiweyo engaphumelelanga: {n}

policy.putaway_hours: Ukubeka endaweni kufuneka kwenziwe kwisithuba se (iiyure)

warehouses.title: Iindawo zokugcina
warehouses.subtitle: Indawo nganye yokugcina yirekhodi enye leyo iZezimali ezixabisa isitokhwe ngokuchasene nayo — imiselwe apha kumgangatho.
warehouses.none: Akukabikho ndawo zokugcina. Yongeza eyokuqala ukuze uqalise ukucwangcisa iindawo.
warehouses.site_hint: Kuyazikhethela. Dibanisa nesayithi ye-SHEQ ukuze ummandla wexesha uhambelane nayo; indawo yokugcina ihlala iyirekhodi yayo.
warehouses.categories_hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuze uvumele zonke iindidi.
warehouses.is_wms_managed_hint: Xa ivuliwe, isitokhwe siyaphuma xa sithunyelwa endaweni yokuphuma xa kukhutshwa i-invoyisi.
warehouses.retire_confirm: Yekisa i-{name}? Akufuneki ibe nesitokhwe. Imbali iyagcinwa.
warehouses.no_people: Akukabikho mntu wabelweyo — nabani na onemvume yendawo yokugcina angasebenza apha.
warehouses.activities_hint: Xa kukho umntu owabelweyo, ngabantu ababelweyo kuphela abanokwenza imisebenzi yendawo yokugcina apha.

locations.title: Iindawo
locations.subtitle: Isicwangciso somgangatho njengomthi. Ziibhini kuphela ezigcina isitokhwe; ukuvala umendo kuvala zonke iibhini ezikuwo.
locations.generate_hint: Iikhowudi ziqhubeka ukusuka kwinombolo ephezulu ekhoyo, ngoko ukuphinda oku kwandisa uthotho.
locations.prefix_hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuze usebenzise ikhowudi yomzali elandelwa ngumgca omfutshane.
locations.search: Fumana indawo ngekhowudi, igama okanye ibhakhowudi
locations.unbinned: Iiyunithi ezi-{qty} kule ndawo yokugcina azikho kuyo nayiphi na ibhini.
locations.barcode_hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuze usebenzise ikhowudi yendawo yokugcina nekhowudi yendawo.
locations.retire_confirm: Yekisa i-{code}? Kufuneka ingabi nanto kwaye ingabi neendawo ezisebenzayo ngaphakathi.
locations.cascades: Yonke indawo engaphakathi kule nayo iya kusala isitokhwe.
locations.until_hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuze uthintele de umntu ayivule kwakhona.

labels.title: Iilebhile zeendawo
labels.subtitle: Iilebhile ze-QR eziphethe ibhakhowudi yendawo nganye, nekhowudi ngoonobumba abakhulu.
labels.capped: Kuboniswa iilebhile ezingama-500 zokuqala. Hluza ngenqanaba ukuze uprinte ezishiyekileyo.

history.title: Imbali yendawo
history.subtitle: Lonke utshintsho kwindawo yokugcina okanye kwindawo. Amangeno akanakuhlelwa okanye acinywe.

item_status_rule.DISCONTINUED: Akukho sitokhwe sitsha sinokwamkelwa. Esishiyekileyo sisenokuthengiswa, sikhutshwe size sihanjiswe.
item_status_rule.BLOCKED: Akukho nto inokwamkelwa, ikhutshwe okanye ihanjiswe. Ukubala nokulungisa kusavumelekile.
item_status_rule.RECALLED: Akukho nto inokwamkelwa, ikhutshwe okanye ihanjiswe, kwaye isitokhwe esibanjiweyo asinakukhululwa de kuphele ukubuyiselwa.
item_status_rule.QUARANTINED: Akukho nto inokwamkelwa, ikhutshwe okanye ihanjiswe, kwaye isitokhwe esibanjiweyo asinakukhululwa de into leyo ikhululwe.
item_status_rule.OBSOLETE: Akukho nto inokwamkelwa, ikhutshwe okanye ihanjiswe. Isitokhwe sisenokucinywa.

products.title: Izinto
products.subtitle: Izinto ezifanayo ezixatyiswa ziZezimali nezisetyenziswa kuMveliso — zichazwe apha kwindawo yokugcina.
products.add_hint: Yenza into yesitokhwe kanye, yeZezimali, uMveliso nendawo yokugcina ngokufanayo.
products.base_unit_locked: Isitokhwe sihambile ngale yunithi, ngoko ayisakwazi ukutshintsha.
products.search: Khangela nge-SKU, igama, ibhakhowudi okanye ikhowudi yomhlinzeki
products.duplicates_found: Iibhakhowudi ezi-{n} zibhaliswe kwinto engaphezu kwenye.
products.quarantine_stock: Kwakhona hambisa sonke isitokhwe esikhoyo siye kwindawo yokwahlula ngoku
products.costing: Ukubala iindleko: {method}, iindleko eziqhelekileyo {cost}. Uxabiso lulawulwa kwiZezimali.
products.packaging_hint: Inqanaba ngalinye libonisa ukuba liphethe ii-{base} ezingaphi. Le yinguqulo esetyenziswa sisamkelo ngasinye, ukukhetha nohlengahlengiso.
products.no_packaging: Akukabikho manqanaba okupakisha — into iphathwa ngeyunithi yayo esisiseko kuphela.
products.no_barcodes: Akukabikho bhakhowudi. Yongeza ibhakhowudi yomhlinzeki okanye wenze eyangaphakathi.
products.barcode_scan_hint: Yiskene okanye uyichwetheze kanye njengoko iprintiwe.
products.duplicate_reason: Kutheni le bhakhowudi inokuba yeyezinto ezimbini?
products.codes_hint: Iikhowudi ezisetyenziswa ngabahlinzeki namakhasimende kule nto. Ikhowudi eskeniweyo okanye echwethezwayo nayo ithelekiswa nezi.
products.bundle_hint: Into ethengiswa okanye ekhutshwa njengeseti yezinye izinto. Shiya kungenanto ukuba le ayiyonyanda.
products.substitutes_hint: Izinto ezinokusetyenziswa endaweni yale. Imigca ye-oda igcina into ebi-odiwe.
products.owner_hint: Shiya kungenanto kwisitokhwe senkampani ngokwayo. Iimpahla zomthengi ziyabalwa kodwa azixatyiswa.
products.owner_locked: Isitokhwe sihambile, ngoko umnini akasakwazi ukutshintsha.
products.rotation_hint: Akukho nto: kusebenza umgaqo wendawo yokugcina.
products.expiry_alerts_hint: umz. 90, 60, 30, 7. Akukho nto: okungagqibekanga kwendawo yokugcina.

scan.title: Isivavanyi sokuskena
scan.subtitle: Skena okanye uchwetheze nayiphi na ibhakhowudi ukuze ubone kanye oko indawo yokugcina iya kukuqonda ngayo.
scan.hint: Iikhowudi ze-GS1 ziyaqondwa kunye nebhetshi, isiriyali nemihla yazo. Xa uchwetheza ngesandla, bhala isahluli seqela njenge-[GS].

product_labels.title: Iilebhile zeemveliso
product_labels.subtitle: Iilebhile zeshelufu, zekhathoni nezepalethi eziphethe ibhakhowudi yento nganye.
product_labels.none: Khetha izinto kuluhlu lwezinto, uze uprinte iilebhile zazo.

stock.title: Isitokhwe nokufumaneka
stock.subtitle: Inani ngalinye linenkcazelo enye, esetyenziswa kuyo yonke indawo. Vula into ukuze ubone apho isitokhwe sayo sikhoyo nendlela esifike ngayo apho.
stock.reconcile_hint: Ibhalansi ithelekiswa nesixa sazo zonke iintshukumo. Kufuneka zivumelane.
stock.atp_rule: Okukhoyo ukuthenjiswa = okukhoyo esandleni − okugcinelweyo. Isitokhwe esabelweyo kodwa singakhethwanga siyinxalenye yokugcinelweyo kwaye asisoze sithatyathwe kabini.

movements.title: Imbali yesitokhwe
movements.subtitle: Yonke intshukumo ethunyelweyo. Akukho nto apha inokuhlelwa; impazamo ilungiswa ngokubuyisela umva, okuvela ecaleni kwayo.

states.title: Iimeko zesitokhwe
states.subtitle: Zeziphi izixa ezibalwa yimeko nganye. Lonke inani kuso sonke isikrini sendawo yokugcina libalwa kule theyibhile.

meaning_of.DAMAGED: Sonakele; silinde ukucinywa, ukulungiswa okanye ukubuyiswa.
meaning_of.REJECTED: Asiphumelelanga kuhlolo; silinde ukubuyiswa okanye ukulahlwa.
meaning_of.IN_TRANSIT: Isitokhwe esikwindawo esendleleni, phakathi kweendawo ezimbini.
meaning_of.EXPIRED: Isitokhwe esikhoyo kwilothi egqithe umhla wokuphelelwa.

adjustments.title: Uhlengahlengiso lwesitokhwe
adjustments.subtitle: Lonke ulungiso lunekhowudi yesizathu. Ezo zingaphezu kwemida yesizathu, okanye ezinomhla odlulileyo kakhulu, zilinda omnye umntu ukuba azivume.
adjustments.pick_position: Isitokhwe sale nto apha — khetha enye ukuze uyihlengahlengise:
adjustments.negative: Faka inani elingaphantsi kweqanda: esi sizathu sisusa isitokhwe.
adjustments.positive: Faka inani elingaphezu kweqanda: esi sizathu songeza isitokhwe.
adjustments.signed: Elingaphezu kweqanda longeza isitokhwe, elingaphantsi liyasisusa.
adjustments.occurred_hint: Shiya kungenanto ngoku. Umhla kwixesha eliviwe ziZezimali uyaliwa.
adjustments.evidence_hint: Kuyazikhethela: iifoto zomonakalo, ingxelo, ileta yebango.

reasons.title: Iikhowudi zezizathu
reasons.subtitle: Kutheni isitokhwe sitshintsha. Ikhowudi nganye ibonisa ukuba yongeza okanye isusa isitokhwe, nokuba umntu wesibini kufuneka ayivume nini.
reasons.approve_high_risk: Izinto ezinomngcipheko ophezulu zifuna umntu wesibini

clients.title: Ukufikelela kwabathengi
clients.subtitle: Abathengi beqela lesithathu abaneempahla ezigcinwe apha, nabantu abavumelekileyo ukuzibona.
clients.how: Isitokhwe somthengi siboniswa kuphela kubantu abanikwe loo mthengi, okanye abanemvume yokubona bonke abathengi. Isitokhwe senkampani ngokwayo asichaphazeleki.
clients.none: Akukabikho zinto zingabathengi. Misela umnini wento kwithebhu yayo yeMboniselo Jikelele.

expected.title: Izamkelo ezilindelekileyo
expected.subtitle: Imigca evulekileyo yee-oda zokuthenga esalindele ukufika. Umgca kufuneka uchaze into yesitokhwe ngaphambi kokuba iimpahla zawo zibekwe eshelufini.
expected.link_hint: Idibanisa lo mgca we-oda nento ewuthengayo, ukuze ukuyamkela kufake loo nto esitokhweni.

receive.title: Yamkela i-{po}
receive.no_stock_item: akukho nto yesitokhwe — ukuyamkela akuhambisi sitokhwe
receive.serials_hint: Enye ngomgca okanye zahlulwe ngeekhoma — enye kwiyunithi nganye.
receive.allow_duplicate: Ngokwenene olu luhanjiso lwesibini kwinowuthi enye

nonpo.title: Yamkela ngaphandle kwe-oda
nonpo.subtitle: Kwiimpahla ezifike ngaphandle kwe-oda yokuthenga. Akukho nto ithunyelwayo de umntu ongenguwe ayivume.

receipts.title: Izamkelo
receipts.subtitle: Iinowuthi zeempahla ezamkelweyo — ezifanayo neziboniswa kuThengo — kunye noko indawo yokugcina ikwenzileyo kumgca ngamnye.
receipts.pending_explain: Yamkelwe ngaphandle kwe-oda: {reason}. Akukho nto ithunyelwe esitokhweni.
receipts.not_yours: Omnye umntu kufuneka avume isamkelo osenzileyo.
receipts.inspection_pending: Esinye isitokhwe sibanjelwe uhlolo lokungena. Siza kufumana umsebenzi wokubekwa endaweni xa uhlolo lusamkela.

appointments.title: Amadinga edokhi
appointments.subtitle: Amaxesha ohanjiso ngedokhi. Idokhi yindawo yokwamkela; iinqwelo ezimbini azinakuyisebenzisa ngaxeshanye.
appointments.overdue: Iinqwelo ezibhukishiweyo ezi-{n} ziphose ixesha lazo: {list}
appointments.no_docks: Le ndawo yokugcina ayinazidokhi zokwamkela. Yongeza indawo yohlobo lweDokhi yokwamkela ukuze ubhukishe amaxesha kuyo.

scorecards.title: Ukusebenza kwabahlinzeki
scorecards.subtitle: Kulinganiswa ngezamkelo, hayi ngezimvo. Umhlinzeki onohanjiso olungama-{min} ubuncinci kwiintsuku ezingama-90 ongaphantsi kwe-{on_time}% ngexesha, okanye ongaphezu kwe-{defects}% eyonakeleyo okanye eyaliweyo, uyaphawulwa kuLawulo lwaBahlinzeki.

returns.title: Okubuyiselwa kubahlinzeki
returns.subtitle: Isitokhwe siyaphuma xa okubuyisiweyo kuthunyelwa, nokuba sibanjwe kweyiphi imeko. Inowuthi yekhredithi yomhlinzeki ifakwa kwiZezimali.
returns.dispatch_hint: Ukuthumela kukhupha isitokhwe kwindawo yokugcina ngoku.

putaway.title: Ukubeka endaweni
putaway.subtitle: Wonke umsebenzi ubonisa apho isitokhwe sikhoyo, apho simele siye khona nesizathu. Iingxaki ziya kumgca wezinto ezingaqhelekanga.
putaway.no_fit: Akukho bhini ihambelana nayo yonke imigaqo
putaway.directed_hint: Le ndawo yokugcina ithumela ukubeka endaweni kwibhini ecetyiswayo.

policy.SUGGESTED: Ecetyiswayo: nayiphi na ibhini ephumelela imigaqo inokusetyenziswa.
policy.DIRECTED: Eyalelweyo: yibhini ecetyiswayo kuphela, ngaphandle kokuba umphathi agqithise.
policy.FREE: Ekhululekileyo: nayiphi na ibhini ephumelela imigaqo.

capacity_page.title: Umthamo
capacity_page.subtitle: Imida emiselweyo ithelekiswa noko kubanjiweyo. Iibhini ezingenamida ziyabalwa kodwa azilinganiswa.
capacity_page.restricted_hint: Izinto ezinzima, eziyingozi okanye ezilawulwa ngobushushu, nokuba zingaphi iibhini ezivulekileyo ezinokuzithatha.

binmove.title: Hambisa isitokhwe
binmove.subtitle: Ukusuka kwibhini ukuya kwibhini ngaphakathi kwendawo yokugcina. Iilothi neenombolo zesiriyali zihamba nesitokhwe.
binmove.scan_from: Skena okanye uchwetheze ibhini ofuna ukuhambisa kuyo

transfers.title: Ukudluliselwa
transfers.subtitle: Isitokhwe phakathi kweendawo zokugcina. Xa sithunyelwa sihlala kwindawo esendleleni yendawo eyiwayo, apho kungekho mntu unokusithembisa okanye asikhethe.
transfers.dispatch_hint: Ukuthumela kukhupha isitokhwe esikhethiweyo kwindawo yokugcina esisuka kuyo ngoku.

replenishment.title: Ukuzalisa
replenishment.subtitle: Iindawo zokukhetha neendawo zokugcina zigcinwa phakathi kobuncinci nobuninzi bazo, ezingxamisekileyo kuqala; nento ekufuneka umthengi ayi-odole.
replenishment.reorder_hint: Imeko = okukhoyo ukuthenjiswa + oku-odiweyo − ii-oda ezisalindile. Inqanaba lokuphinda u-odole = eliphezulu phakathi kwenqanaba lokuphinda u-odole nesitokhwe sokhuseleko kunye nemfuno ngexesha lokulinda.
replenishment.no_suggestions: Akukho nto ikwinqanaba layo lokuphinda u-odole.
replenishment.source_bulk: Ukusuka kugcino olukhulu ukuya kwibhini yokukhetha

strategy_hint.DISCRETE: Uluhlu olunye lokukhetha nge-oda nganye: yeyona ilula, ilungele ii-oda ezinkulu.
strategy_hint.BATCH: Uhambo olunye kuzo zonke ii-oda ezikhethiweyo, ngolandelelwano lweebhini; zahlulwe ngee-oda xa kupakishwa.
strategy_hint.ZONE: Uluhlu lokukhetha ngommandla ngamnye, ukuze umkhethi ngamnye ahlale kwindawo enye.
strategy_hint.WAVE: Khulula ii-oda ezikhethiweyo kunye -- ukuze zithathwe ngumthwali okanye ngexesha lokuvala.
strategy_hint.CLUSTER: Umkhethi omnye, ii-oda ezininzi ngaxeshanye, nganye kwindawo yayo yetoti.

outbound.title: Ii-oda zokuzalisekisa
outbound.subtitle: Yonke i-oda ethunyelwa yindawo yokugcina, nokuba ivela phi. I-oda enye ayisoze yamkelwe kabini.
outbound.cancel_hint: Isitokhwe esibanjiweyo siyakhululwa kwaye nantoni na esele ikhethiwe ifumana umsebenzi wokubuyiselwa endaweni yokugcina.
outbound.override_hint: Khetha apho ivela khona. Isitokhwe esiphelelwe lixesha, esivaliweyo nesibanjiweyo asinakukhethwa, kwaye isizathu sigcinwa kulwabelo.

picking.title: Ukukhetha
picking.subtitle: Khetha ii-oda, khetha indlela yokuzikhetha, uze usebenze uluhlu ngolandelelwano lokuhamba. Ukukhetha ngakunye kukuhambisa okuskeniweyo ukuya ekupakisheni.

sla.title: Amanqanaba enkonzo
sla.subtitle: Kulinganiswa ngokwenyani okwenzeke kwi-oda nganye phakathi kokukhululwa nokuthunyelwa.

counts.title: Ukubalwa kwesitokhwe
counts.subtitle: Bala okusesheluleni, ukuthelekise neencwadi ngexesha lokubala, uze ulungise kuphela oko kuvunyiweyo.
counts.none: Akukabikho kubala. Vula enye, okanye usete icebo lokuziqhuba ngeshedyuli.
counts.no_plans: Akukho macebo okubala. Icebo livula ukubala ngeshedyuli: yonke into ye-A ngeveki, yonke ibhini kanye ngonyaka.
counts.why_hint: Kuboniswa kubabali, umz. "Ukuphela kwenyanga" okanye "Umonakalo uxelwe kumendo 4".
counts.max_lines_hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuze kubalwe konke. Xa kukho umda, iindawo ezibalwe kudala kakhulu ziza kuqala.
counts.thresholds_hint: Umahluko ongaphaya kwayo nayiphi na kwezi uya kumbali wesibini. Shiya zonke zingenanto ukuze ubale kwakhona wonke umahluko.
counts.found_hint: Isitokhwe esikwibhini engadweliswanga kukubala. Songezwa njengomgca ongalindelekanga size sibalwe ngoku.
counts.accept_hint: Uhlengahlengiso olunesizathu soMahluko wokubala luyenziwa xa ukubala kuthunyelwa. Ngaphezu kwemida yohlengahlengiso lulinda imvume.
counts.dismiss_hint: Yitsho ukuba yintoni eyichazileyo. Akukho nto ihlengahlengiswayo, kwaye inkcazelo ihlala kukubala.

count_scope_hint.ITEMS: Izinto ozikhethayo, naphi na apho zikhoyo.
count_scope_hint.ABC: Izinto zodidi olunye lwe-ABC. Hlela kuqala ukuze umisele iindidi.
count_scope_hint.RISK: Izinto ezinemahluko, ukukhetha okunqongopheleyo okanye ilahleko kwiintsuku ezingama-90 ezidlulileyo.

accuracy.title: Ukuchaneka kokubala
accuracy.subtitle: Kangaphi ukubala kokuqala kuhambelana neencwadi, nexabiso lento engahambelananga.

returns_page.title: Okubuyiswa ngamakhasimende
returns_page.subtitle: Iimpahla zibuya ngokuchasene ne-oda, i-invoyisi okanye isalathiso esigunyazisiweyo, kwaye ziyahlolwa ngaphambi kokuba zibe sisitokhwe kwakhona.
returns_page.reference_hint: Irekhodi yomnxeba, i-imeyile okanye inombolo yetyala, xa kungekho oda okanye i-invoyisi.
returns_page.receive_hint: Iimpahla ezivuliweyo, ezonakeleyo okanye ezibuyisiweyo zigcinwa kwindawo yokwahlula zize zihlolwe.
returns_page.credit_hint: Inowuthi yekhredithi ngokuchasene ne-invoyisi {invoice} (esalindileyo {outstanding}). Iimpahla zibuye ngeendleko ze-{cost}; oku kufaka ikhredithi kwikhasimende kuphela.

quality.title: Uhlolo
quality.subtitle: Isitokhwe sihlolwa kwibhini yaso, okubuyisiweyo nee-oda ngaphambi kokuba zihambe, kwiirekhodi zohlolo ezifanayo nezemveliso.
quality.hold_hint: Isitokhwe sihlala apho sikhoyo, sibanjiwe, de uhlolo lugqibe.
quality.setup_subtitle: Okufuna ukuhlolwa, zingaphi iisampulu, namagama okuchaza okungahambi kakuhle.
quality.no_plans: Akukabikho macebo ohlolo endawo yokugcina. Ngaphandle kwecebo uhlolo lulolunye uhlolo lokuphumelela okanye lokungaphumeleli.
quality.product_hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuze kusebenze kuyo yonke imveliso kweli nqanaba.

requests.title: Izicelo
requests.subtitle: Qala isicelo, landela oko ukucelileyo, uze umisele ukuba ngubani oza kukusebenzela xa ungekho.

design.title: Uyilo
design.subtitle: Yakha, vavanya uze upapashe ukuhamba komsebenzi neefomu zako, okanye uqale kwitemplate esemgangathweni.

operations.title: Imisebenzi
operations.subtitle: Ukusebenza, yonke into eqhubekayo, nomsebenzi ofuna ingqwalasela yomntu.

admin.title: Ulawulo
admin.subtitle: Umgaqo-nkqubo wokuhamba komsebenzi wale nkampani, iikhalenda zeshishini nomkhondo wophicotho.

my_requests.title: Izicelo zam
my_requests.subtitle: Oko ukucelileyo, apho isicelo ngasinye sikhona nokuba silinde bani.

delegations.title: Ukugunyazisa abanye
delegations.subtitle: Vumela umntu osebenza naye enze imisebenzi yakho ixesha elithile, ngaphandle kofikelelo olubanzi.

definitions.title: Ukuhamba komsebenzi
definitions.subtitle: Yila kwikhanvasi, qinisekisa, phonononga uze upapashe iinguqulelo.

forms.title: Iifomu
forms.subtitle: Iifomu zezicelo nezemisebenzi ezineenguqulelo, ezinemihlaba enemiqathango nemigca yezinto.

templates.title: Iitemplate
templates.subtitle: Iinkqubo ezingama-31 ezilungileyo kwi-Ezemali, HR, Ukuthenga, IT, Ulawulo, SHEQ neMisebenzi.

form_library.title: Ithala leefomu
form_library.subtitle: Iifomu ezingama-46 ezilungileyo (HR, Ezemali, Ukuthenga, IT, Ezomthetho, SHEQ nezinye) zokongeza nokulungelelanisa.

dashboard.title: Ukusebenza
dashboard.subtitle: Isantya somsebenzi, ukuthobela i-SLA, izithintelo nomthwalo womsebenzi.

instances.title: Izicelo ezikwinkqubo
instances.subtitle: Sonke isicelo onokusibona, sihluzwe ngokwemeko, ukuhamba komsebenzi ne-SLA.

exceptions.title: Okungaqhelekanga

Incwadi yethu yeencwadi iyaqhubeka isebenza nangayiphi na indlela: kunye nenkqubo yangaphandle iba yincwadi encinci yefama, kwaye ii-invoyisi zefama, iibhili neejenali zilindiswa ukuze zikhutshelwe apho; iintlawulo ezibhalwe apho ziyabuya kwaye ziphawula ezethu njengezihlawulweyo.

Faka igama lomsebenzisi nephasiwedi oyisebenzisayo kwi-Sage, hlola uqhagamshelwano, uze ukhethe inkampani. Iphasiwedi igcinwa ifihliwe kwaye ayiboniswa kwakhona.

machine_data.approval: Uqhagamshelwano oluphilayo lufuna i-app yomphuhlisi yeli qonga ivunywe yi-John Deere (developer.deere.com, emva koko umbutho ngamnye uyinika ukufikelela kwi-Operations Center) nayi-CNH (iportal yayo yabaphuhlisi, ekwakhupha isitshixo somrhumo). Kude kube ngoko iqonga libonisa "kufuneka imvume yomphuhlisi" kwaye akukho nto ibizwayo.

registration.cnh: I-CNH ayikayivumi i-app yeli qonga (okanye i-client id nemfihlo yayo azimiselwanga). Faka isicelo kwiportal yabaphuhlisi ye-CNH Industrial yokufikelela kwi-FieldOps, ubhalise i-redirect URI engezantsi uze umisele isitshixo somrhumo.

fields.intro: Amasimi abo adityaniswa nawethu ngekhowudi okanye ngegama; dibanisa ashiyekileyo ngesandla, okanye wenze intsimi ukusuka kweyabo. Umda otshintshe kwicala labo kuphela uba yinguqulelo entsha yowethu, iphawulwe njengevela kubo. Xa utshintshe kumacala omabini, ulinda phantsi kweeNgxabano.

machines.intro: Oomatshini babo badityaniswa noomatshini bethu beFleet ngenombolo yesiriyeli okanye nge-VIN. Iiyure zeenjini zomatshini odityanisiweyo zingena njenge-telematics, ngoko imitha yeeyure, ukusetyenziswa nenkonzo efanelekileyo zilandela umatshini ngokwawo.

operations.intro: Wonke umsebenzi ofundwe koomatshini, ugcinwa nedatha yawo ekrwada. Ukusetyenziswa okanye ukuhlwayela kuba (okanye kugcwalisa) umsebenzi wasentsimini negalelo lawo; ukuwungenisa kwakhona kuyawuhlaziya, akuze kuwuphindaphinde. Isivuno sizisa umthamo waso, obhalwa njengesivuno xa isityalo silinganisiwe.
operations.products_intro: Dibanisa igama lemveliso nganye nenye yezinto zethu zesitokhwe; imisebenzi elindileyo iyafundwa kwakhona.

conflicts.intro: Umda otshintshe apha nakwiqonga loomatshini ukusukela oko bavumelana okokugqibela. Akukho nanye ebhalwa ngaphezulu: gcina owethu (uwuthumele kubo) okanye uthathe owabo (njengenguqulelo entsha yowethu).
conflicts.keep_confirm: Gcina umda wethu uwuthumele kwiqonga loomatshini?
conflicts.take_confirm: Thatha umda wabo njengenguqulelo entsha yentsimi?

log.intro: Konke ukuhambelanisa, umsebenzi nefayile ethunyelweyo kudlula kwilog yoqhagamshelwano: okusileleyo kugcina umyalezo weqonga kwaye kuphinda kuzanywe ngokulinda okwandayo; ukuzama kwakhona akuze kungenise okanye kuthumele kabini.

prescriptions.title: Imiyalelo yamazinga ahlukeneyo
prescriptions.subtitle: Isixa semveliso esiya kwinxalenye nganye yentsimi: ukusuka kwiindawo zolawulo zentsimi okanye kwi-NDVI yayo yamva nje, sihlolwe ngumntu wesibini, emva koko sikhutshelwe imonitha okanye sithunyelwe kwi-John Deere Operations Center okanye kwi-CNH FieldOps.
prescriptions.new_intro: Khetha intsimi, imveliso nalapho iindawo zivela khona. Izinga lendawo nganye lingatshintshwa emva koko.

f.per_stock_unit_hint: Zingaphi ii-kg, ii-l okanye imbewu ekwiyunithi enye yesitokhwe (umz. imbewu engama-80000 ngengxowa).
f.name: Igama
f.preview_note: (iklasi 1 yeyona ibuthathaka; iindawo eziphawulwe ukuba zingaqukwa azifumani nto)

prescriptions.settings_intro: Ukutshintsha ezi kwenza iindawo namazinga kwakhona. Umyalelo ovunyiweyo ubuyela kuyilo njengenguqulelo entsha.
prescriptions.four_eyes: Nguwe oyile okanye wangenisa lo myalelo: omnye umntu kufuneka awuvume phambi kokuba uye kumatshini.
prescriptions.new_version: Le yinguqulelo entsha yomyalelo ovunyiweyo: kufuneka uvunywe kwakhona phambi kokuthunyelwa.
prescriptions.flat_vs: Xa kuthelekiswa nezinga elilinganayo le-{rate} {unit} kwindawo ephathiweyo:
prescriptions.rates_note: Ukugcina amazinga kwenza inguqulelo entsha ukuba le ibivunyiwe.
prescriptions.files_intro: Zenzelwe le nguqulelo kwaye zigcinwa nayo. I-shapefile iphethe izinga kuphawu lwe-RATE; i-ISO-XML inendawo yonyango enye ngezinga ngalinye.
prescriptions.machines_intro: Umyalelo ovunyiweyo uya kwiifayile zombutho kwiqonga, ulungele isikrini.
prescriptions.compare_intro: Ukusuka kumsebenzi womatshini: iisampuli zawo zezinga ngaphakathi kwendawo nganye apho uzibhale khona, kungenjalo izinga lawo eliphakathi.
prescriptions.compare_none: Akukabikho msebenzi woomatshini unxulunyaniswe nalo myalelo.

floor.escalations_subtitle: Izicelo zoncedo ezivela emgangathweni womsebenzi. Ezingaphendulwanga zinyuka inqanaba emva kwexesha elibekwe yifektri.
floor.title: Umgangatho womsebenzi
floor.scan: Skena ikhadi lomsebenzi, i-oda okanye ilothi
floor.offline: Ngaphandle kwe-intanethi: ucofo luyagcinwa luthunyelwe kamva
floor.pause_hint: Nika isizathu ukuba umsebenzi ume ngenxa yokuba kukho into engahambanga kakuhle; kubhalwa njengexesha lokuma.
floor.time_measured: Ixesha lomatshini nelabasebenzi lithathwa kwixesha obusebenza ngalo lo msebenzi.
floor.queued: Akukho qhagamshelwano: kugciniwe, kuya kuthunyelwa xa inethiwekhi ibuyile.
floor.downtime_subtitle: Konke ukuma, ngeziko lomsebenzi nangesizathu, noko kubize kona ngemizuzu

trace.title: Ukulandeleka
trace.subtitle: Khangela ilothi, uze uyilandele ubuyele kwimvelaphi yayo okanye uye phambili kuyo yonke into eyangena kuyo
trace.recalls_subtitle: Konke ukubuyiswa, oko kwakuquka nendlela okwagqitywa ngayo
trace.open_recall_hint: Kuquka le lothi kunye neelothi ezingu-{n} efikelela kuzo iya phambili.
trace.backward_hint: Izinto, iilothi nee-oda le lothi eyenziwe ngazo, ukuya kwiirisithi zomhlinzeki
trace.forward_hint: Iilothi ezingu-{n} zifikelelwe, kunye nokuseskitokhweni nokuphumileyo
trace.close_hint: Kuphela xa sonke isixa esibanjwe phantsi kokubuyiswa sele sikhululiwe okanye silahliwe.
trace.affected_hint: Zitshixelwe ngaphakathi ngokokuba zikude kangakanani emva kwelothi yemvelaphi

costing.standards_subtitle: Oko imveliso nganye ifanele ukuxabisa ukuyenza, nge-{currency}
costing.calculate_hint: Ukusuka kwi-BOM evunyiweyo nendlela yokwenza esebenzayo namhlanje; isiphumo siyisayila de sivunywe
costing.lot_size_hint: Ukulungiselela nokujikelezwa kweqela kwabiwa kwesi sixa
costing.approved_locked: Kuvunyiwe: lo mgangatho uyirekhodi. Bala inguqulelo entsha ukuze uwutshintshe; ii-oda esele zenziwe zigcina lo.
costing.output_line: Kubalwe iindleko ze-{qty}, kulindeleke imveliso elungileyo engu-{out}; iiyure zabasebenzi ezingu-{labour}, iiyure zomatshini ezingu-{machine}.
costing.variances_subtitle: Ii-oda ezenziwe kweli xesha xa zithelekiswa nomgangatho wazo, nge-{currency}. Inani elingaphezulu kweqanda alilunganga.
costing.profit_subtitle: Intengiso efakiweyo xa ithelekiswa noko imveliso ibize ukuyenza, nge-{currency}
costing.margin_not_final: Ezinye iindleko apha zezethutyana okanye ziqikelelwe, ngoko umda wenzuzo awukagqitywa.
costing.excluded: Ii-invoyisi ezingu-{n} kwenye imali azibandakanywanga; kuxelwa kuphela i-{currency}:

maint.machines_subtitle: Oomatshini bemveliso abavela kwirejista yee-asethi, njengoko isityalo-mveliso sibabona
maint.preventive_subtitle: Ii-odolo zomsebenzi ezenziwe ngekhalenda, ngeeyure umatshini osebenze ngazo, okanye ngokwaphuka okuphindaphindiweyo
maint.no_machines: Akukho matshini uncanyathiselwe kwiziko lomsebenzi okwangoku. Bancamathisele phantsi kweSeto → Amaziko omsebenzi.
maint.overdue_n: Ii-odolo zomsebenzi wokulungisa ezingu-{n} zidlulelwe lixesha
maint.fault_codes_hint: Ukwaphuka kurekhodwa ngekhowudi ukuze ukusilela okuphindaphindiweyo kubalwe
maint.held_since: Ibanjiwe ukususela {at}: {reason}. Abasebenzi abanakuqala umsebenzi kwiziko apho bonke oomatshini bebanjiwe.
maint.rules_hint: Nganye yenza i-odolo yomsebenzi we-asethi xa kufike ixesha, kwaye ayizenzi yesibini xa enye isavulekile
maint.hold_hint: Umatshini obanjiweyo awunakusetyenziswa ngabasebenzi de ubuyiselwe emsebenzini.
maint.release_hint: Qinisekisa uhlolo olwenziweyo phambi kokuba umatshini uphinde usebenze. Ukulungisa okuvulekileyo kufuneka kugqitywe kuqala.
maint.breakdown_hint: Imisa iziko lomsebenzi ngesizathu sokwaphuka kwaye yenza i-odolo yomsebenzi wokulungisa.
maint.tasks_hint: Umsebenzi omnye ngomgca; iba yimisebenzi ye-odolo yomsebenzi
maint.oee_subtitle: Ukufumaneka × ukusebenza × umgangatho, ngeziko lomsebenzi. Nantoni na engenakubalwa iboniswa njengengekhoyo, ingaze ibe yi-0% okanye i-100%.
maint.oee_inputs: Imizuzu engu-{planned} icwangcisiwe, imizuzu engu-{run} isebenza, imizuzu engu-{stops} yokuma okungacwangciswanga; {good} ezilungileyo kwezingu-{total}.
maint.ideal_from_routing: Sebenzisa ixesha lokusebenza lendlela yokwenza yemveliso nganye njengomjikelo ofanelekileyo
maint.exclude_planned: Ukuma okucwangcisiweyo kuthatyathwa kwixesha lemveliso elicwangcisiweyo

plan.mrp_subtitle: Qhuba isicwangciso, uphonononge oko sikucebisayo, uvume oko kufanele kwenzeke. Akukho nto i-odwayo de uyivume.
plan.old_run: Oku kukuqhutywa okudala. Izigqibo zenziwa kokwangoku.
plan.recommendations_hint: Ukuvuma kwenza ii-oda zemveliso eziyisayila nezicelo zokuthenga eziyisayila zenkqubo yesiqhelo yokuvuma.
plan.nothing_needed: Akukho nto ifuna ukuthengwa okanye ukwenziwa kweli xesha.
plan.items_hint: Cofa into ukuze ubone uqikelelo lwayo lweveki ngeveki noko kwenza imfuno yayo.
plan.approve_hint: Ii-oda zokwenza ziba ziisayila kwifektri oyikhethayo; iingcebiso zokuthenga ziba zizicelo zokuthenga eziyisayila, esinye ngomhlinzeki ngamnye.
plan.demand_subtitle: Uqikelelo ecaleni kwee-oda eziqinisekisiweyo, imveliso ngokwemeko, izinto eziphambili nomthwalo kwiziko lomsebenzi ngalinye
plan.products_legend: F luqikelelo, O zii-oda eziqinisekisiweyo, P yimveliso efunekayo. Isitokhwe esiqikelelweyo sicwangciselwa esona sikhulu phakathi koqikelelo nee-oda inyanga nganye; uqikelelo aluze longeze kwii-oda eziqinisekisiweyo.
plan.no_demand: Akukho mveliso inemfuno, isitokhwe okanye imveliso.
plan.forecast_note: Kucwangciswa kuphela ngoqikelelo oluvunyiweyo, kwaye kuphela apho ii-oda eziqinisekisiweyo zingalugubunganga. Uqikelelo aluze lwenze i-oda yentengiso.
plan.suppliers_subtitle: Ukuthembeka kohanjiso, ukusilela komgangatho namaxabiso, kwii-oda zokuthenga, iirisithi nohlolo
plan.prices_hint: Oko umhlinzeki ngamnye akubizileyo, utshintsho xa kuthelekiswa nonyaka wabo ophelileyo, nexesha lokuhanjiswa abalifikeleleyo
plan.no_purchases: Akukabikho oda zokuthenga ezichaza le nto.
plan.params_subtitle: Indlela i-MRP ephatha ngayo into nganye
plan.params_legend: * kuthathwe kwiprofayili yento yendawo yokugcina. Ngokuzenzekelayo: iyenziwa ukuba ine-BOM evunyiweyo, kungenjalo iyathengwa.
plan.schedule_subtitle: Ishedyuli eya phambili enomthamo onomda ngosuku: iishifti, ulandelelwano lwendlela yokwenza, izinto, ukulungiswa nezinye iindlela
plan.adherence_detail: Imisebenzi engu-{n} igqityiwe; ukulibaziseka okuphakathi kweentsuku ezingu-{slip}
plan.gantt_hint: Imivalo ebomvu igqiba emva komhla wayo; ⇄ ibonisa elinye iziko lomsebenzi.
plan.what_if_hint: Tshintsha umhla 'hayi phambi' okanye okuphambili, ubone kwangaphambili impembelelo, uze usebenzise.

labour.roster_subtitle: Abasebenzi abacwangcisiweyo: abantu abakwiishifti kumaziko omsebenzi
labour.gaps_n: Iintsuku ezingu-{n} apho ishedyuli ifuna abasebenzi abangaphezulu kwabo bakwirosta
labour.qual_subtitle: Oko imisebenzi ikufunayo kubaqhubi bayo, kufundwe kwizakhono ze-HR, izatifikethi zokufunda nobuchule be-SHEQ
labour.training_hint: Abantu abakwirosta apho ezi zifunekayo, abangenazo okanye eziphelelwa lixesha kwiintsuku ezingama-30
labour.no_training: Akukho mntu ongenayo okanye oza kuphulukana nemfuneko.
labour.or_centre: Okanye yawo wonke umntu kwiziko lomsebenzi
labour.source_note: Igcinwe kwi-HR, kwinkqubo yokufunda okanye kwi-SHEQ; akukho nto ikopishwayo. Imfuneko enyanzelekileyo engekhoyo okanye ephelelwe lixesha iyakuthintela ukwabelwa nokuqalisa umsebenzi.
labour.labour_subtitle: Iiyure ezicwangcisiweyo xa zithelekiswa nezenyani, ngubani osebenze ntoni, nabasebenzi ishedyuli esabafunayo
labour.gaps_hint: Abasebenzi abafunwa yishedyuli egciniweyo xa bethelekiswa nabakwirosta

fulfilment.customer_subtitle: Imigca ye-oda yentengiso yeemveliso ezenziwa apha: isitokhwe esibanjelwe zona, imveliso eyenzelwe zona, nokuba isithembiso siyabambeka na. I-oda yentengiso ngokwayo ihlala kwi-Finance.
fulfilment.eligible_hint: Imigca ye-oda yentengiso evulekileyo yeemveliso ezenziweyo. Ukuzibophelela kubamba isitokhwe esikhululekileyo kwaye, kwiimveliso ezenziwa ngokwe-oda, kwenza i-oda yemveliso eyisayila yokuseleyo.
fulfilment.no_eligible: Akukho migca ye-oda yentengiso evulekileyo yeemveliso ezenziwa apha.
fulfilment.progress_hint: Inkqubela xa ithelekiswa noko ikhasimende nganye yathenjiswa kona.
fulfilment.cancel_confirm: Uyeke ukubamba isitokhwe salo mgca? Ii-oda zawo zemveliso ziyahlala ukuze umcwangcisi agqibe.
fulfilment.quote_line: {stock} inokuvela esitokhweni; {make} yokwenza. Ilungile kwiintsuku ezingu-{days} ({finish}).
fulfilment.quote_split: Iintsuku ezingu-{material} kulindwe izinto, iintsuku ezingu-{production} kwimveliso.
fulfilment.quote_short: {item} isilela ngo-{short}; ixesha lokuhanjiswa ziintsuku ezingu-{days}.

commit_explains.MTS: Yenzelwe isitokhwe: isitokhwe esikhululekileyo sibanjelwa ikhasimende kwaye i-MRP izalisa okuseleyo, ngaphandle kokuba wenze i-oda ngoku.
commit_explains.MTO: Yenziwa ngokwe-oda: isitokhwe esikhululekileyo siyabanjwa kwaye kwenziwa i-oda yemveliso eyisayila yokuseleyo.
commit_explains.CTO: Ilungiselelwe ngokwe-oda: i-oda yemveliso eyisayila ithwala olu lungiselelo.

fulfilment.subcontract_subtitle: Umsebenzi othunyelwe kubahlinzeki: umsebenzi onikwe abanye, okanye i-oda yonke eyenziwe ngezinto esizithumelayo. Okubuyayo kuyahlolwa phambi kokuba kusetyenziswe.
fulfilment.new_subcontract_hint: Khetha umsebenzi indlela yokwenza ewunika abanye, okanye uyishiye ingenanto ukuze umhlinzeki enze i-oda yonke.
fulfilment.operation_hint: Akukho nto: umhlinzeki wenza i-oda yonke.
fulfilment.supplier_hint: Akukho nto: ikontraka esezantsi yendlela yokwenza.
fulfilment.materials_hint: Zikhutshelwe i-oda yemveliso; izinto ezingasetyenziswanga zibuyela esitokhweni.
fulfilment.receipts_hint: Irisithi nganye iyahlolwa phambi kwenyathelo elilandelayo okanye phambi kokuba isitokhwe sisetyenziswe.
fulfilment.receive_operation_hint: Umsebenzi ubuya kanye: nantoni na engabuyiswanga irekhodwa njengelahlekileyo kumhlinzeki.

loss.title: Iziphumo zelahleko
loss.subtitle: Isiphumo ngumahluko obonakeleyo. Siba yilahleko kuphela xa umphandi esiqinisekisa ngobungqina, kwaye ukonga kubalwa kuphela xa ubungqina bako buvunyiwe.
loss.subject: Okuchaphazelekayo
loss.no_findings: Akukho ziphumo. Qhuba izibonisi, okanye wandise isihluzi.
loss.evidence_hint: Iirekhodi isibonisi esizifundileyo; zijonge kwimvelaphi yazo.
loss.needs_approval: Kufuna imvume yabaphathi phambi kokuba kuvalwe.
loss.rules_subtitle: Ubuntununtunu besibonisi ngasinye. Isiphumo senziwa kuphela xa umda ugqithiwe kwaye impembelelo eqikelelweyo ifikelela kubuncinci.

about.executive: Imveliso, iindleko nomda wenzuzo, inkunkuma, ukulibaziseka nokonga kweli xesha.
about.planning: Ingaba isicwangciso siyagcinwa, siwugqithisile phi umthwalo, kwaye yintoni esilelayo okanye esemva kwexesha.
about.inventory: Yintoni ekhoyo nesebenzisekayo, yintoni ebekelwe bucala, kwaye yintoni esemngciphekweni.
about.costs: Okuqhelekileyo xa kuthelekiswa nokwenyani, nalapho umahluko uvela khona.

reports.nothing_visible: Iimvume zakho azibandakanyi manani kule deshibhodi.

kpi.count_adjustment_percent: Uhlengahlengiso lokubala xa luthelekiswa nexabiso lesitokhwe

alerts.rules_subtitle: Kuhlobo ngalunye lwesiganeko: ngubani oxelelwayo, njani, kwangethuba elingakanani, nangubani oviyo xa kungenzeki nto. Ifektri inokuba nomthetho wayo; kungenjalo kusebenza umthetho wenkampani yonke.
alerts.factory_hint: Akukho nto: yonke ifektri engenamthetho wayo
alerts.log_subtitle: Umgca omnye ngomntu ngamnye kwisilumkiso ngasinye. Ukuphinda ngaphakathi kwexesha lokuthula kuyabalwa, akuthunyelwa; isilumkiso siyazicima xa unobangela waso uphelile.

assistant.title: Umncedisi wemveliso
assistant.subtitle: Lonke inani libalwa kwiirekhodi zenkampani yakho, kunye nexesha nemithombo yalo. I-AI ibhala impendulo kuphela; ayize inike inani.
assistant.placeholder: Buza ngomahluko, ii-oda ezisemva kwexesha, ukuma, izinto, abahlinzeki, inkunkuma, imida yenzuzo okanye iindleko…
assistant.worded_by_ai: Kubhalwe yi-AI kusetyenziswa amanani angezantsi; kujongiwe ukuba akukho amanye amanani.
assistant.start: Khetha umbuzo ongentla okanye uchwetheze owakho.
assistant.needs_approval: Oku kutshintsha ukuthenga okanye imveliso. Kuphakanyiswa nje apha, kwaye omnye umntu onemvume efanelekileyo kufuneka akuvume.
assistant.recommendations_subtitle: Yonke into umncedisi ayicebisileyo, oko kwasayilwa kuyo, ngubani owakuvumayo, nendlela umlinganiselo ohambe ngayo emva koko.

accounting.rules_subtitle: Isiganeko ngasinye semveliso noko sikwenzayo kwiincwadi. Akukho nto ifakwa ngokuzenzekelayo phantsi kwendlela engavunywanga; indlela enqunyanyisiweyo iyasimisa isiganeko.
accounting.change_hint: Utshintsho lubuyela kwisayila de omnye umntu aluvume.
accounting.recon_subtitle: Imveliso xa ithelekiswa neleja jikelele ngomhla we-{date}.
accounting.tx_subtitle: Sonke isiganeko semveliso esichaphazela ubalo-mali, intshukumo yaso yesitokhwe nejenali yaso. Ukubuyisela umva yimigca emitsha; akukho nto ihlelwayo.
accounting.reverse_hint: Kufakwa intshukumo nejenali echasene nayo; eyokuqala ihlala kwirekhodi. Ii-oda ezivaliweyo zilungiswa ngohlengahlengiso endaweni yoko.

audit.title: Umkhondo wophicotho
audit.subtitle: Lonke utshintsho kwirekhodi yemveliso: ngubani okanye yeyiphi inkqubo yesistim eyenzileyo, nini, kunye namaxabiso ngaphambili nasemva. Kule nkampani kuphela, nakwiifektri onokuzibona kuphela.

multi.transfers_subtitle: Isitokhwe esihamba phakathi kweefektri zale nkampani. Xa sisendleleni sibanjwa kwindawo esiya kuyo, ukuze kungabikho mntu usebenzisa oko kungekafiki. Ukuhambisa isitokhwe phakathi kweendawo zokugcina akufaki jenali.
multi.suggestions_hint: Izinto ezifunwa yifektri enye ezibanjwe yenye ngaphezu kweemfuno zayo.
multi.balances_hint: Izinto ezisalindileyo kwii-oda ezivulekileyo xa zithelekiswa nesitokhwe esisebenzisekayo kwiindawo zokugcina zefektri nganye.
multi.in_transit: Isendleleni: ibanjwe kwindawo yokugcina eyamkelayo de ifunyanwe.
multi.network_subtitle: Zeziphi iindawo zokugcina ezezeyiphi ifektri, nokuba zeziphi iimveliso ezinokwenziwa phi. Imveliso yabelwana ngayo zizo zonke iifektri ngaphandle kokuba idwelisiwe kwezithile.
multi.product_scope_hint: Iimveliso ezingadweliswanga apha zinokwenziwa kuyo yonke ifektri.
multi.all_shared: Yonke imveliso yabelwana ngayo zizo zonke iifektri.

integrations.title: Unxibelelwano
integrations.subtitle: Ezinye iinkqubo ezidityaniswe nge-API zazo, ukutshintshiselana ngeefayile okanye ii-webhook ezisayiniweyo -- zingaze zibhale kwiidatabase zazo. Umyalezo ngamnye usetyenzwa kanye; ukusilela kuyaphinda kuzanywe kuze kulinde apha.
integrations.name: Igama
integrations.failures_hint: Imiyalezo engakwazanga ukusetyenzwa. Lungisa unobangela (kaninzi kukudibanisa), uze uphinde uzame.
integrations.no_db_writes: Unxibelelwano lusebenzisa i-API, iifayile okanye ii-webhook zenye inkqubo. Ukubhala ngqo kwidatabase yenye inkqubo akunikezelwa.
integrations.connection_hint: Iimfihlo zigcinwa zifihliwe kwaye azize ziboniswe kwakhona; shiya intsimi ingenanto ukuze uyigcine.
integrations.webhook_hint: Isixhobo sisayina umzimba wesicelo ngasinye nge-HMAC-SHA256 sisebenzisa imfihlo yonxibelelwano, kwi-header ethi X-Mkhaya-Signature.
integrations.settings_hint: Iindawo zokuphela zohlelo lwale khasimende: health_path, pull_path, push_paths, export. Akukho mfihlo apha.
integrations.validation_hint: Rekhoda oko kujongiweyo ngokuchasene nohlelo lwekhasimende, ilayisensi nofikelelo oluvunyelweyo phambi kokuba ulayite.
integrations.mappings_hint: Irekhodi yethu nesalathiso senye inkqubo sento enye.
integrations.files_hint: Ngenisa i-CSV ekhutshwe yenye inkqubo (ifuna ikholamu ethi "id"), okanye ukhuphele oko kulindele ukuya kuyo.
integrations.receipts_exported: Iirisithi zemveliso ezingu-{done} kwezingu-{total} ukususela ekuqaleni zithunyelwe.
