routings.title: Iindlela zokwenza
routings.subtitle: Indlela imveliso nganye ehamba ngayo kwisityalo-mveliso: imisebenzi, amaziko omsebenzi, amaxesha namasango
routings.none_hint: Yila indlela yokwenza imveliso ukuze uqale.

routing.operations_hint: Ngokulandelelana. Umsebenzi awunakugqitywa de kudlule imisebenzi enyanzelekileyo engaphambi kwawo, namasango ayo.
routing.alt_run_hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuze usebenzise ixesha lokuqhuba lomsebenzi ngokwawo
routing.machine_type_hint: Endaweni yeziko lomsebenzi: naliphi na iziko elinolu hlobo lomatshini
routing.locked_approved: Le ndlela yokwenza ivunyiwe kwaye ayinakuhlelwa. Yihlaziye ukuze utshintshe indlela imveliso eyenziwa ngayo — ii-oda esele zikhutshiwe ziqhubeka zisebenzisa olu hlaziyo.
routing.discard_body: Le ndlela yokwenza eyiyilwayo nemisebenzi yayo iya kususwa. Uhlaziyo oluvunyiweyo aluchaphazeleki.
routing.estimate_hint: Oko kuthathwa kukwenza isixa esithile, kubalwe ngekhalenda yefektri.

orders.title: Ii-oda zemveliso
orders.subtitle: Yonke i-oda, ukusuka kuyilo ukuya ekuvalweni
orders.new_hint: Ibotshelelwe kwi-BOM nakwindlela yokwenza esebenzayo ngomhla wayo wokuqala
orders.none_hint: Phakamisa enye kwimveliso enoluhlu lwezixhobo-ziqulatho oluvunyiweyo.
orders.start_hint: Igqiba ukuba loluphi uhlaziyo lwe-BOM nolwendlela yokwenza olusetyenziswa yi-oda
orders.material_warehouse_hint: Apho imathiriyeli ikhutshwa khona; indawo yokugcina imveliso ukuba akukho nto
orders.allow_below_min_batch: Vumela isixa esingaphantsi kwebhetshi encinci yendlela yokwenza
orders.locked_closed: Le oda ivaliwe. Iirekhodi zayo zitshixiwe; ulungiso lwenziwa njengohlengahlengiso.
orders.checks_hint: Oko imvume ikuqinisekisayo, njengoko kunjalo ngoku
orders.checks_clear: Imathiriyeli, i-BOM, indlela yokwenza nomthamo konke kulungile.
orders.receive_output_hint: Ingena kwisitokhwe ngexabiso eliqhelekileyo lemathiriyeli; kwindawo yokuvalelwa ukuba ifektri ihlola phambi kokubeka endaweni
orders.output_hint: Imveliso nelahleko zibhalwa ngumgangatho womsebenzi ngoxa i-oda iqhubeka.
orders.approve_override_hint: Imathiriyeli inqongophele okanye umthamo ugqithisiwe. Ukuvuma noko kubhalwa njengokungaqhelekanga nesizathu sakho.
orders.rescale_hint: Isixa esitsha siphinda silinganise iimathiriyeli, imisebenzi noqikelelo
orders.lot_hint: Shiya kungenanto ukuze kuthathwe kuqala ephelelwa kuqala
orders.over_issue: Oku kungaphezu koko kusafunwa yi-oda. Ukukhupha ngokugqithisileyo kufuna ukugqitha okugunyazisiweyo nesizathu ngaphandle kokuba ifektri iyakuvumela.
orders.lot_number_hint: Ngokuzenzekelayo yinombolo ye-oda ({n}) kwimveliso elandelwa ngelothi
orders.quality_hold: Imveliso imisiwe de umgangatho ugqibe nge-{list}.

quality.inspections_subtitle: Lonke uhlolo olusafuna ukubhalwa okanye ukugqitywa, nolo sele luvaliwe
quality.receive_hint: Ingena kwindawo yokuvalelwa, kuvulwe uhlolo lwayo lokungena
quality.hold_hint: Ibamba isitokhwe esisebenzisekayo; akukho nto inokusikhupha okanye isithumele de kugqitywe
quality.supplier_hint: Ukhetho: icebo lemathiriyeli yalo mhlinzeki kuphela

disposition_hint.CONDITIONAL_ACCEPT: Iyasisebenzisa nangona kukho okufunyenweyo. Kubhalwa njengemvumelwano nesizathu sakho.
disposition_hint.REJECT: Ihambisa isitokhwe esibanjiweyo kwesaliweyo; asinakuze sikhutshwe okanye sithunyelwe.
disposition_hint.RETURN_TO_SUPPLIER: Yala isitokhwe ngokuchasene nomhlinzeki ne-oda yakhe yokuthenga.
disposition_hint.REWORK: Ibuyisela umsebenzi; uphinda uhlolwe emva koko.

quality.held_alert: {qty} ibanjwe kwi-{status} de olu hlolo lugqitywe.
quality.blocking_alert: Olu hlolo lusileleyo lumisa imveliso kwi-oda yalo de umntu ogunyazisiweyo agqibe ukuba kwenzeka ntoni ngomsebenzi.
quality.record_hint_plan: Uhlolo ngalunye lugwetywa ngokuzenzekelayo ngokwemida yalo. Iisampuli ezi-{n} kuhlolo ngalunye.
quality.record_hint_adhoc: Akukho cebo lisebenzayo, ngoko thiya uhlolo ngalunye uze ulugwebe.
quality.decide_hint: Sisigqibo kuphela esihambisa isitokhwe okanye esivumela imveliso iqhubeke.
quality.certificate_required: Eli cebo lifuna isatifikethi esifakwe ngezantsi phambi kokuba isitokhwe sikhululwe.
quality.plans_subtitle: Yintoni ehlolwayo, ngeyiphi imida, kwaye ukusilela kumisa ntoni
quality.checks_hint: Umlinganiselo onemida, okanye uphawu lokuphumelela/lokusilela. Uhlolo lugcina ikopi yemida olubhalwe ngayo.
quality.operation_hint: Akukho nto: nayiphi na indawo yohlolo yale mveliso
quality.critical_hint: Kubalulekile: ukusilela apha kuphakamisa ukungahambelani okukhulu
quality.ncrs_subtitle: Yintoni engahambanga kakuhle, kutheni, kwaye yintoni eyithintela ingaphindi
quality.search_ncrs: Khangela inombolo, ikhowudi yesiphene okanye umbhalo
quality.repeat_defects_hint: Iikhowudi zeziphene eziphakanyiswe ngaphezu kwesinye kunyaka ophelileyo
quality.due_hint: Akukho nto: iintsuku ezi-3, ezi-7 okanye ezingama-21 ngokobunzulu
quality.not_effective: Uqinisekiso lokugqibela lufumanise ukuba inyathelo alisebenzi. {notes}
quality.investigation_hint: Kubambe, fumana unobangela, uze uthathe inyathelo
quality.actions_hint: Ukubamba, ukulungisa nokuthintela, nganye inomnini nomhla wokugqibela
quality.repeats_hint: Ikhowudi yesiphene efanayo kule mathiriyeli okanye evela kulo mhlinzeki kunyaka ophelileyo
quality.no_code: Nika i-NCR ikhowudi yesiphene ukuze kubalwe iimpinda.
quality.verify_hint: I-NCR enkulu okanye ebalulekileyo iqinisekiswa ngumntu ongenzanga nalinye lamanyathelo ayo.
